# kumo_flutter

> Unofficial Flutter port of Kumo, Cloudflare's design system: OKLCH-accurate light and dark themes, 1,530 Phosphor icons, and accessible, spring-driven components. Not affiliated with Cloudflare.

Import `package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart`, wrap the app in `KumoThemeProvider`, read the theme with `context.kumo`. Widgets are prefixed `Kumo`; props follow Kumo names; colors are `KumoColor` tokens; spacing follows the Tailwind 4px grid (`KumoSpace.s3` is 12px); content text is 14px.

## Guides

- [Accessibility](doc/guides/accessibility.md): - **Semantics.** Every control exposes its role, label and state (button, checked, toggled, selected, expanded, slider value). Icon-only buttons require a `semanticLabel` (an assert enforces it for `KumoButton`).
- [For AI agents](doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md): This page is for coding agents that build Flutter apps with kumo_flutter.
- [Getting started](doc/guides/getting-started.md): Install the package, wrap your app in `KumoThemeProvider`, and build with `Kumo*` widgets.
- [Mobile](doc/guides/mobile.md): Kumo is designed for wide dashboards. kumo_flutter keeps Kumo's dense look and adapts the behavior for phones.
- [Motion](doc/guides/motion.md): Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.
- [Theming](doc/guides/theming.md): `KumoThemeProvider(mode: ...)` takes `KumoThemeMode.system` (default, follows the platform), `.light` or `.dark`. Mode changes cross-fade every token over 300ms, instantly under reduced motion.
- [Tokens](doc/guides/tokens.md): Kumo defines 54 semantic tokens in OKLCH. `tool/generate_theme.dart` converts them to sRGB with CSS Color 4 gamut mapping (the same result a browser shows on an sRGB screen) into `KumoColorSchemes.light`, `.dark`, `.fedrampLight` and `.fedrampDark`.

## Components

- [KumoAccordion](doc/components/KumoAccordion.md): A stack of collapsible sections separated by hairlines, for FAQs and grouped settings where people open one or a few sections at a time. Shaped after shadcn's accordion and drawn with Kumo tokens; Kumo has no accordion of its own.
- [KumoAnchoredOverlay](doc/components/KumoAnchoredOverlay.md): The positioning primitive behind popovers, tooltips, menus, selects and comboboxes. Use it to build custom floating panels.
- [KumoAppShell](doc/components/KumoAppShell.md): The responsive frame a Kumo app is built on: a `KumoSidebar`, a sticky top bar and the page, switching between a persistent sidebar, an icon rail and a phone drawer.
- [KumoAutocomplete](doc/components/KumoAutocomplete.md): A free-text field with a list of suggestions. Reach for it when any value is valid but common ones are worth offering: route patterns, hostnames, dates.
- [KumoAvatar](doc/components/KumoAvatar.md): A person's or account's picture, with initials while it loads or when there is none, optional live presence, and `KumoAvatarGroup` for stacks.
- [KumoAvatarGroup](doc/components/KumoAvatarGroup.md): Overlapping `KumoAvatar`s with a "+3" chip for the ones that do not fit.
- [KumoBadge](doc/components/KumoBadge.md): Kumo's `Badge`: a small label for status, categories or metadata, such as "Active", "Beta" or "Proxied".
- [KumoBanner](doc/components/KumoBanner.md): A full-width inline message for information, warnings and errors that belong to a page or a section, with optional accent-tinted actions.
- [KumoBottomNavigation](doc/components/KumoBottomNavigation.md): A tab bar for phone layouts of Kumo apps: three to five destinations, each an icon over a label, pinned to the bottom with room for the home indicator.
- [KumoBreadcrumbs](doc/components/KumoBreadcrumbs.md): The trail from the account root to the current page, for dashboards with nested resources (account, zone, DNS, record).
- [KumoButton](doc/components/KumoButton.md): Kumo's `Button`: the control for actions, in six variants and four sizes, with icon-only shapes, a loading state and an optional tooltip.
- [KumoButtonGroup](doc/components/KumoButtonGroup.md): Kumo's `ButtonGroup`: a few tightly coupled buttons joined into one control, most often a split button (an action next to a menu trigger for related actions).
- [KumoCalendar](doc/components/KumoCalendar.md): The month grid of Kumo's `DatePicker`, for picking one day, a run of days or a set of days, inline on a page or inside your own panel.
- [KumoChartColors](doc/components/KumoChartColors.md): Kumo's chart palette (`ChartPalette`): categorical colors for series, semantic colors for status data, a sequential scale for density and map fills, each tuned for light and dark mode.
- [KumoChartLegend](doc/components/KumoChartLegend.md): A legend item for a chart series: a colored dot, the series name and its value. Kumo's `ChartLegend.SmallItem` and `ChartLegend.LargeItem`.
- [KumoCheckbox](doc/components/KumoCheckbox.md): Kumo's `Checkbox`: a 16px box with a label for a single yes or no choice, or the "select all" control above a list (with `indeterminate`).
- [KumoCheckboxGroup](doc/components/KumoCheckboxGroup.md): Kumo's `Checkbox.Group`: a legend over a set of checkboxes, with an error and a description below, controlled with the list of checked values.
- [KumoClipboardText](doc/components/KumoClipboardText.md): Kumo's `ClipboardText`: a read-only, input-like field holding a value with a copy button at its end.
- [KumoCode](doc/components/KumoCode.md): Kumo's `Code` and `Code.Block`: monospace code without syntax colors, in `text-kumo-subtle` at 13px on 20px lines.
- [KumoCodeHighlighted](doc/components/KumoCodeHighlighted.md): Kumo's `CodeHighlighted`: a syntax-colored code block with optional line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button.
- [KumoCollapsible](doc/components/KumoCollapsible.md): A trigger that shows and hides a panel, for optional detail (advanced settings, an explanation) that most people skip.
- [KumoCombobox](doc/components/KumoCombobox.md): A text field that filters a list of options as you type, for one value or several shown as chips. Reach for it when the list is long enough that searching beats scrolling.
- [KumoCommandPalette](doc/components/KumoCommandPalette.md): A searchable list of commands, opened with Cmd+K or Ctrl+K. Reach for it to let keyboard users jump to any page or action without the navigation.
- [KumoContextMenu](doc/components/KumoContextMenu.md): A menu that opens where the user right-clicks a widget, or long-presses it on touch screens. It takes the same items as `KumoDropdownMenu`.
- [KumoDateInput](doc/components/KumoDateInput.md): Typed date entry with validation and a calendar button. Separators are inserted as you type, impossible or unavailable days show an inline error, and the button opens a `KumoCalendar`.
- [KumoDatePicker](doc/components/KumoDatePicker.md): A date field that opens a `KumoCalendar`: Kumo's `DatePicker` composed with a `Popover`, as the Kumo docs show it, for single days, ranges with presets and sets of days.
- [KumoDateRangePicker](doc/components/KumoDateRangePicker.md): Deprecated. Kumo replaced `DateRangePicker` with `DatePicker mode="range"`; this alias forwards every argument to `KumoDatePicker.range` so code can move over gradually.
- [KumoDeleteResource](doc/components/KumoDeleteResource.md): A confirmation dialog for deleting a resource: the destructive button stays disabled until the user types the resource's name.
- [KumoDialog](doc/components/KumoDialog.md): A modal panel near the top of the screen over a recessed backdrop, for focused tasks and confirmations that block the page behind them.
- [KumoDialogRoute](doc/components/KumoDialogRoute.md): The route behind Kumo dialogs: Kumo's backdrop (recessed surface at 80%), a scale-from-0.9 entry, focus trap, Escape and backdrop dismissal. `showKumoDialog` uses it; push it directly for a custom modal.
- [KumoDrawer](doc/components/KumoDrawer.md): A panel attached to a screen edge, for details, settings and filters that sit beside the page instead of over its center.
- [KumoDropdownMenu](doc/components/KumoDropdownMenu.md): A list of actions anchored to a trigger, with checkbox items, radio groups and submenus. Reach for it for row actions, account menus and "Add" buttons.
- [KumoEmpty](doc/components/KumoEmpty.md): Kumo's `Empty`: what a list, table or page shows when it has nothing to show, with an optional copyable command and actions.
- [KumoField](doc/components/KumoField.md): Kumo's `Field`: a label above a control, with a description or an error message below it. Use it to give a custom or bare control the same layout as Kumo's form components.
- [KumoFieldBox](doc/components/KumoFieldBox.md): The chrome of every Kumo text field, and `KumoEditable`, the bare text-editing core that goes inside it. Use them to build custom fields that match `KumoInput`.
- [KumoFlowAnchor](doc/components/KumoFlowAnchor.md): Marks where connectors attach inside a [KumoFlowNode](KumoFlowNode.md), so they meet a header or leave from a footer instead of the node's center.
- [KumoFlowDiagram](doc/components/KumoFlowDiagram.md): A directed step diagram: nodes joined by connectors with rounded elbows, plus parallel branches and custom anchor points. Use it when the order of steps matters, as in a request path, a deploy pipeline or a set of routing rules.
- [KumoFlowList](doc/components/KumoFlowList.md): A sequence of connected steps inside a [KumoFlowParallel](KumoFlowParallel.md), for a branch with more than one step.
- [KumoFlowNode](doc/components/KumoFlowNode.md): One step in a [KumoFlowDiagram](KumoFlowDiagram.md). By default it is Kumo's node card. It can show custom content, be pressable and selected, or be disabled.
- [KumoFlowParallel](doc/components/KumoFlowParallel.md): Parallel branches in a [KumoFlowDiagram](KumoFlowDiagram.md). The step before the group fans out to every branch, and every branch joins the step after it.
- [KumoFocusTrap](doc/components/KumoFocusTrap.md): Keeps keyboard focus inside a subtree while it is on screen and hands it back when it goes away. Dialogs, sheets and focus-trapping popovers already use it.
- [KumoGrid](doc/components/KumoGrid.md): Kumo's `Grid`: a responsive column grid with a gap, whose columns collapse at Kumo's breakpoints.
- [KumoHoverCard](doc/components/KumoHoverCard.md): A preview card that opens while the pointer rests on a link or name: a Worker's last deployment, a zone's status.
- [KumoIcon](doc/components/KumoIcon.md): Renders a Phosphor glyph from `KumoIcons` (or any `IconData`) at Kumo's 16px default size.
- [KumoInlineCopyText](doc/components/KumoInlineCopyText.md): Kumo's `InlineCopyText`: a compact, borderless copy control for IDs and other short values in text and dense table cells.
- [KumoInput](doc/components/KumoInput.md): Kumo's `Input`: a single-line text field with a built-in label, description and error message. Use it for names, hostnames, emails, URLs, search boxes and any other short text.
- [KumoInputArea](doc/components/KumoInputArea.md): Kumo's `InputArea`: a multi-line text field (a textarea) with a built-in label, description and error message. Use it for notes, descriptions, messages and pasted config or scripts.
- [KumoInputGroup](doc/components/KumoInputGroup.md): Kumo's `InputGroup`: one field built from an input and the parts around it (icons, text addons, an inline suffix, buttons), drawn inside a single ring with a single focus ring.
- [KumoInputOtp](doc/components/KumoInputOtp.md): A one-time code field drawn as a row of cells, for verification codes sent by SMS, email or an authenticator app.
- [KumoKbd](doc/components/KumoKbd.md): Keyboard key chips: one key ("K") or a shortcut ("⌘ K" on a Mac, "Ctrl K" elsewhere), named the way each platform names it.
- [KumoLabel](doc/components/KumoLabel.md): Kumo's `Label`: the medium-weight 14px text above a form control, with an optional "(optional)" marker and an info tooltip.
- [KumoLayerCard](doc/components/KumoLayerCard.md): Kumo's `LayerCard`: the standard container for a block of content, plain or layered with a header strip.
- [KumoLayerDialog](doc/components/KumoLayerDialog.md): A strict responsive dialog with a sticky title frame and one primary action: a centered panel from 640px up, a bottom sheet that follows the finger on phones.
- [KumoLink](doc/components/KumoLink.md): A styled text link: link blue with a soft underline, or inheriting the surrounding color, or plain. Flutter has no `href`, so navigation happens in `onPress`.
- [KumoLoader](doc/components/KumoLoader.md): Kumo's `Loader`: a spinner for work of unknown length.
- [KumoMapChart](doc/components/KumoMapChart.md): A choropleth map: Kumo's `ChoroplethMap`, drawn over region shapes you provide. Each region is filled from a continuous color scale by its value; regions without a value keep the neutral no-data fill.
- [KumoMenuPanel](doc/components/KumoMenuPanel.md): The shared parts of every menu and option list: `KumoMenuPanel` (surface), `KumoMenuRow` (row), `KumoMenuSeparator`, `KumoMenuGroupLabel` and `KumoMenuKeyboard` (arrow-key movement).
- [KumoMenubar](doc/components/KumoMenubar.md): A horizontal bar of menus (File, View, Deploy) in Kumo's `MenuBar` look: a recessed track where the open menu's trigger is raised onto the base surface.
- [KumoMeter](doc/components/KumoMeter.md): Kumo's `Meter`: a labeled bar for a measured value within a known range, such as storage used or request quota.
- [KumoNumberInput](doc/components/KumoNumberInput.md): A numeric field with minus and plus steppers, bounds, decimals and keyboard stepping, in Kumo's input style. Use it for counts, ports, rates and durations.
- [KumoPageHeader](doc/components/KumoPageHeader.md): The top of a page: breadcrumbs, a title and description, then segmented tabs with the page's actions.
- [KumoPagination](doc/components/KumoPagination.md): Page navigation under a table or list: "Showing 1-25 of 500" on one side, joined first, previous, page number, next and last buttons on the other.
- [KumoPopover](doc/components/KumoPopover.md): Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger: a notification list, a small settings form, a confirmation with buttons.
- [KumoPressable](doc/components/KumoPressable.md): The interaction primitive under every tappable Kumo component. Use it for custom rows, tiles and chips.
- [KumoProgress](doc/components/KumoProgress.md): Linear and circular progress for work that finishes: an upload, a deployment, a migration.
- [KumoRadio](doc/components/KumoRadio.md): Kumo's `Radio.Item`: one option of a `KumoRadioGroup`. It is only valid as an item of a group, which supplies its selection, focus and appearance.
- [KumoRadioGroup](doc/components/KumoRadioGroup.md): Kumo's `Radio.Group`: a legend over mutually exclusive `KumoRadio` items, as circles, choice cards or a compact segmented bar.
- [KumoResourceList](doc/components/KumoResourceList.md): The page for a list of resources (Workers, buckets, namespaces): a title with an icon and description, resource cards with metadata, status and actions, an aside for usage notes, and loading, empty and error states.
- [KumoSankeyChart](doc/components/KumoSankeyChart.md): A Sankey diagram: flows between nodes, each link as wide as its value. Kumo's `SankeyChart`, laid out with the d3/ECharts Sankey algorithm and drawn with `CustomPainter`.
- [KumoSelect](doc/components/KumoSelect.md): A field-styled trigger that opens a list of options. Reach for it when the user picks one value (or a few) from a known list: a region, a plan, an environment.
- [KumoSensitiveInput](doc/components/KumoSensitiveInput.md): Kumo's `SensitiveInput`: a field for secrets (API tokens, signing keys, passwords) that shows a mask until it is tapped, with a hide toggle and a copy button.
- [KumoSeparator](doc/components/KumoSeparator.md): A 1px hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centered label.
- [KumoSheet](doc/components/KumoSheet.md): A sheet attached to a screen edge that follows the finger. Open one with `showKumoSheet`.
- [KumoSidebar](doc/components/KumoSidebar.md): App navigation: a header, scrolling groups of rows with icons, badges and nested collapsible sections, and a footer with the collapse button. Collapses to a 57px icon rail.
- [KumoSkeletonLine](doc/components/KumoSkeletonLine.md): Kumo's `SkeletonLine`: a placeholder bar that stands in for a line of text while it loads.
- [KumoSlider](doc/components/KumoSlider.md): Kumo's `Slider`: pick a number, or a range between two numbers, by dragging a thumb along a recessed track. The value shows in a badge under each thumb, with the min and max at the ends.
- [KumoSparkline](doc/components/KumoSparkline.md): A compact trend line for table cells, stat tiles and list rows: no axes, no tooltip, just the shape of the data. Kumo has no sparkline; this one follows its chart styling.
- [KumoStepper](doc/components/KumoStepper.md): A multi-step flow: `KumoSteps`, the current step's content and Back / Continue buttons, with a named final action. For onboarding flows such as adding a zone or creating a Worker.
- [KumoSteps](doc/components/KumoSteps.md): A progress indicator for multi-step flows: numbered markers joined by connectors, horizontal on wide layouts and vertical on narrow ones. Shaped after shadcn's steps and drawn with Kumo tokens; Kumo has no steps component.
- [KumoStrings](doc/components/KumoStrings.md): All built-in copy (labels, announcements, month names) in one place, provided by `KumoLocale`.
- [KumoSwitch](doc/components/KumoSwitch.md): Kumo's `Switch`: an on/off control for a setting that takes effect at once, with a thumb you can tap or drag.
- [KumoSwitchGroup](doc/components/KumoSwitchGroup.md): Kumo's `Switch.Group`: a legend over related `KumoSwitch`es, each with its own value, with an error and a description below.
- [KumoTable](doc/components/KumoTable.md): Kumo's `Table`: rows of data under a header, with sorting, row selection, pinned columns, lazy rows and a card layout for phones.
- [KumoTableOfContents](doc/components/KumoTableOfContents.md): "On this page" navigation beside a long page: section links with a brand rule on the active one, which follows the scroll position. It combines Kumo's `TableOfContents` with its `useTableOfContentsActiveId` hook.
- [KumoTabs](doc/components/KumoTabs.md): A row of tabs with a moving active indicator, for switching between views of one resource (a Worker's overview, metrics and settings). `KumoTabPanels` adds content pages that swipe with the finger.
- [KumoTagInput](doc/components/KumoTagInput.md): A field that collects short values as removable tags. Reach for it for lists the user types: email recipients, allowed origins, labels.
- [KumoText](doc/components/KumoText.md): Kumo's `Text`: every string in a Kumo UI, with Kumo's variants and sizes.
- [KumoThemeProvider](doc/components/KumoThemeProvider.md): The root of a Kumo app: resolves light or dark mode, applies a theme variant and typography, provides `context.kumo`, and cross-fades a mode change.
- [KumoTimeInput](doc/components/KumoTimeInput.md): A typed time field: hours, minutes and optionally seconds as separate parts in one Kumo field, with an AM/PM toggle in 12-hour mode. Kumo has no time component; this follows shadcn's time input in Kumo's field style.
- [KumoTimePicker](doc/components/KumoTimePicker.md): A time field that opens a picker: scrolling columns in a popover on wide screens, snapping wheels in a bottom sheet on phones. Kumo has no time component; this follows shadcn's time picker in Kumo's field style.
- [KumoTimeline](doc/components/KumoTimeline.md): A vertical list of events, each with a status marker, title, time and description: deployment history, audit logs, rollout steps.
- [KumoTimeseriesChart](doc/components/KumoTimeseriesChart.md): Lines, area fills or stacked bars over time, with nice value ticks, time labels that adapt to the range, thresholds, reference markers and a crosshair tooltip. Kumo's `TimeseriesChart`, drawn with `CustomPainter` (no ECharts).
- [KumoToast](doc/components/KumoToast.md): Brief, non-blocking notifications that stack in a corner of the screen, pause while the user looks at them and swipe away.
- [KumoToggle](doc/components/KumoToggle.md): A two-state button that stays pressed: a filter, a view option, a formatting style. Not a Kumo component; it follows shadcn's Toggle with Kumo's segmented styling, where the pressed state fills with `contrast` and inverse text.
- [KumoToggleGroup](doc/components/KumoToggleGroup.md): A row of toggles that act together: one pressed at a time (a view mode, a log level) or any number (HTTP methods, text formatting). Not a Kumo component; it follows shadcn's ToggleGroup and draws Kumo's segmented bar by default.
- [KumoToolbar](doc/components/KumoToolbar.md): Controls grouped into one compact card, with shared borders between items and only the outer corners rounded. Items that do not fit move into a "More" menu.
- [KumoTooltip](doc/components/KumoTooltip.md): Kumo's `Tooltip`: a short label for a control, shown on hover after a delay, at once on keyboard focus, and on long press with touch.
- [KumoTracker](doc/components/KumoTracker.md): An uptime tracker: a row of day bars colored by status, a tooltip per bar with the date and status, a legend, and a spoken summary.
- [KumoTree](doc/components/KumoTree.md): A nested list of expandable items with selection, keyboard arrows and lazy children: files in a Worker bundle, objects in an R2 bucket, zones by account.
- [showKumoAlertDialog](doc/components/showKumoAlertDialog.md): Asks the user to confirm one action and returns `true` only when they pick it; Cancel, Escape and the back gesture return `false`.

source: doc/guides/accessibility.md

# Accessibility

- **Semantics.** Every control exposes its role, label and state (button, checked, toggled, selected, expanded, slider value). Icon-only buttons require a `semanticLabel` (an assert enforces it for `KumoButton`).
- **Keyboard.** Tab order follows visual order. Enter and Space activate. Arrow keys move within groups (radio groups, tabs, menus, option lists, calendars, toolbars). Escape closes popovers, menus, sheets and dialogs. Modal overlays trap focus and return it to the trigger on close.
- **Focus ring.** Keyboard focus shows Kumo's 2px brand ring, painted outside the control so layout never shifts. Fields show a 1.5px focus ring.
- **Hit areas** are at least 44x44 on touch platforms.
- **Contrast.** Tokens pass WCAG AA in both modes for text on the surfaces Kumo puts it on; `test/foundation/oklch_test.dart` checks the main pairs. Check custom pairs with `KumoColorUtils.contrastRatio`.
- **Status is never color alone.** Errors carry an icon and text, badges carry text, chart series have names in their semantics summary.
- **Announcements.** Toasts, field errors and "Copied" confirmations are live regions.
- **Text scale** up to 2x, RTL layouts, and reduced motion are supported and tested.
- **Headings.** `KumoText(headingLevel: n)` marks headings for screen reader navigation.

source: doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md

# For AI agents

This page is for coding agents that build Flutter apps with kumo_flutter.

## Install the skills

```sh
dart run kumo_flutter:install_skill            # into .claude/skills
dart run kumo_flutter:install_skill --agents   # also add a pointer to AGENTS.md
```

This installs two skills: `kumo-flutter` (components, tokens, recipes) and `kumo-flutter-craft` (the design, accessibility, motion and copy standard, with a delivery checklist). Read both before UI work.

## Where to look

- `llms.txt`: an index of every guide and component page. `llms-full.txt`: all of them in one file.
- `doc/components/<Name>.md`: one page per component with parameters, defaults, examples and the Kumo React mapping.
- The Kumo docs at https://kumo-ui.com describe the same components for React; prop names carry over (`variant`, `size`, `open`/`onOpenChange`, `value`/`onValueChange`).

## Rules that keep output on-brand

1. Wrap the app in `KumoThemeProvider`; read colors from `context.kumo`, never hardcode hex values.
2. Content text is 14px (`KumoText`), headings are sentence case and semibold. Never bold (w700).
3. Use `KumoButton` variants: one `primary` per view, `secondary` by default, `ghost` in toolbars, `destructive` for delete.
4. Controls are controlled: hold the value in your state and pass it back.
5. Build tappable custom surfaces on `KumoPressable`.
6. Every data view has empty, loading and error states.
7. Test at 390px wide, in dark mode, and with 2x text.

---
source: doc/guides/getting-started.md
---

# Getting started

Install the package, wrap your app in `KumoThemeProvider`, and build with `Kumo*` widgets.

## Install

```sh
flutter pub add kumo_flutter
```

Flutter 3.38 or newer. Inter, JetBrains Mono and the Phosphor icon fonts are bundled; there is nothing else to set up.

## Wrap the app

`KumoThemeProvider` resolves light or dark mode, provides `context.kumo` and sets the default text style. Put it above `MaterialApp` and use `kumoMaterialTheme` so the Material widgets you still use (Scaffold, scroll bars, text selection) match Kumo.

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

void main() => runApp(const App());

class App extends StatelessWidget {
  const App({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoThemeProvider(
      mode: KumoThemeMode.system,
      child: Builder(
        builder: (context) => MaterialApp(
          theme: kumoMaterialTheme(context.kumo),
          home: const WorkersPage(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class WorkersPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const WorkersPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KumoSpace.s4),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            spacing: KumoSpace.s4,
            children: [
              const KumoText('Workers', variant: KumoTextVariant.heading, size: KumoTextSize.lg, headingLevel: 1),
              KumoLayerCard(
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    const Expanded(child: KumoText('image-resizer')),
                    KumoButton(label: 'Deploy', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## Read the theme

```dart
final kumo = context.kumo;
final surface = kumo.colors.base;            // a token as a field
final danger = kumo.color(KumoColor.danger); // a token by enum
final body = kumo.text();                    // 14px Inter, text-kumo-default
final muted = kumo.text(size: KumoTextSize.sm, color: KumoColor.textSubtle);
```

- [Tokens](tokens.md): colors, spacing, radii, shadows, breakpoints.

- [Mobile](mobile.md): how a desktop-first system adapts to phones.

# Mobile

Kumo is designed for wide dashboards. kumo_flutter keeps Kumo's dense look and adapts the behavior for phones.

- **Hit areas.** On touch platforms every control's hit area is at least 44x44 (`KumoTapTargetSize.padded`) while the visual keeps Kumo's size.
- **Floating panels become sheets.** Below 768px (`context.kumoIsNarrow`), dropdown menus, selects, date pickers and the command palette open in a bottom sheet that follows the finger, instead of an anchored popover. Components that do this take `presentation: KumoPresentation.auto | popover | sheet`.
- **Dialogs** take the full width minus 16px gutters; long content scrolls between a sticky header and footer.
- **App shell.** `KumoAppShell` shows a persistent sidebar on wide screens, an icon rail on medium screens and a drawer with a labeled menu button on phones, with an optional `KumoBottomNavigation`.
- **Tables** scroll horizontally with an edge affordance, or render rows as cards with `layout: KumoTableLayout.cards`.
- **Text scale.** Components use minimum heights, never fixed heights around text, and are tested at 2x.
- **Keyboard.** Focused fields scroll above the on-screen keyboard.
- **Safe areas.** Sheets, toasts and bottom navigation respect the system insets.

---
source: doc/guides/motion.md
---

# Motion

Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.

## Press feedback

Every tappable surface is a `KumoPressable`. Its state changes on pointer-down: the surface scales to 0.98 with a spring and hover and pressed colors switch instantly (Kumo never animates a hover color).

## Springs

Anything a finger touches moves on a spring that starts from the current value and carries velocity, so it can be grabbed and reversed mid-flight.

| Spring | Damping | Response | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KumoSprings.standard` | 1.0 | 0.35s | Things that move on their own |
| `KumoSprings.press` | 1.0 | 0.2s | Press down and release |
| `KumoSprings.popup` | 1.0 | 0.22s | Popovers, menus, tooltips scaling from their trigger |
| `KumoSprings.sheet` | 0.86 | 0.32s | Sheets settling after a drag |
| `KumoSprings.momentum` | 0.8 | 0.35s | Only after a flick that carried momentum |

```dart
var controller = AnimationController.unbounded(vsync: tickerProvider, value: 0);
KumoMotion.springTo(controller, 1, spring: KumoSprings.standard, velocity: controller.velocity);
```

## Gestures

Drags follow the finger 1:1. On release the finger's velocity goes into the spring, `KumoMotion.project(velocity)` predicts where the gesture was heading so the snap target matches the throw, and `KumoMotion.rubberband` resists past the bounds. Sheets dismiss by velocity direction, not only distance.

## Popups

`KumoAnchoredOverlay` opens popovers, menus, selects and tooltips with Kumo's popup motion: scale from 0.9 plus a fade, with the transform origin on the trigger. They close along the same path.

## Fixed durations

Fades and expand/collapse use `KumoDurations` (`fast` 100ms is Kumo's default transition, `quick` 150ms popups, `moderate` 200ms, `slow` 300ms) with `KumoCurves.standard`, `.enter`, `.exit`. Wrap durations in `KumoMotion.duration(context, d)` so reduced motion collapses them.

## Loops

A repeating animation runs only while a real state is true (a spinner while loading) and pauses off screen. Kumo's web skeleton shimmer loops forever; here skeletons are static unless `animate: true` is passed while loading.

## Reduced motion

`KumoMotion.reduceMotion(context)` follows the platform setting. Under it, slides, scales and springs become instant changes or short cross-fades; color and opacity changes that help comprehension stay.

---
source: doc/guides/theming.md
---

# Theming

## Modes

`KumoThemeProvider(mode: ...)` takes `KumoThemeMode.system` (default, follows the platform), `.light` or `.dark`. Mode changes cross-fade every token over 300ms, instantly under reduced motion.

Force a mode for one subtree, the way Kumo's `data-mode` attribute does:

```dart
KumoTheme(
  data: KumoThemeData.dark(),
  child: const KumoText('Always dark'),
)
```

## Theme variants

Kumo ships two themes on top of the modes: `KumoThemeVariant.kumo` (default) and `KumoThemeVariant.fedramp`, which recolors the canvas, base and hairline tokens.

```dart
KumoThemeProvider(variant: KumoThemeVariant.fedramp, child: const SizedBox())
```

## Brand overrides

Every color is a `KumoColor` token. Override tokens with `copyWith` and pass full themes to the provider:

```dart
final light = KumoThemeData.light().copyWith(
  colors: KumoColorSchemes.light.copyWith({KumoColor.brand: const Color(0xFF0A66C2)}),
);
final dark = KumoThemeData.dark().copyWith(
  colors: KumoColorSchemes.dark.copyWith({KumoColor.brand: const Color(0xFF3B8FE0)}),
);
KumoThemeProvider(light: light, dark: dark, child: const SizedBox());
```

Check new pairings with `KumoColorUtils.contrastRatio`: 4.5 for text, 3 for control boundaries.

## Fonts

Inter (400, 500, 600) and JetBrains Mono (400, 500) are bundled under the SIL OFL. To use your own faces, declare them in your app's pubspec and pass their family names with `package: null`:

```dart
KumoThemeProvider(
  typography: const KumoTypography(sans: 'BrandSans', mono: 'BrandMono', package: null),
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

The OFL and Phosphor MIT license texts are registered with Flutter's license page automatically by the provider (`registerKumoLicenses`).

## Tap targets

Kumo's controls are dense (36px buttons). On touch platforms the provider pads hit areas to 44x44 without changing the visuals (`KumoTapTargetSize.padded`); with a mouse they match the visual (`shrinkWrap`). Override with `tapTargetSize:`.

## Material bridge

`kumoMaterialTheme(context.kumo)` builds a `ThemeData` from the Kumo theme (colors, text theme, no ink splashes). `KumoMaterialTheme` does the same as a widget for a subtree.

## Copy and locale

Built-in strings ("Close", "(optional)", month names, pagination text) come from `KumoStrings`. Provide your own with `KumoLocale`:

```dart
KumoLocale(
  strings: const KumoStrings(close: 'Tutup', cancel: 'Batal', optional: '(opsional)', firstDayOfWeek: DateTime.monday),
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

source: doc/guides/tokens.md

# Tokens

## Colors

Kumo defines 54 semantic tokens in OKLCH. `tool/generate_theme.dart` converts them to sRGB with CSS Color 4 gamut mapping (the same result a browser shows on an sRGB screen) into `KumoColorSchemes.light`, `.dark`, `.fedrampLight` and `.fedrampDark`.

| Group | Tokens |
| --- | --- |
| Text | `textDefault`, `textStrong`, `textSubtle`, `textInactive`, `textPlaceholder`, `textInverse`, `textLink`, `textInfo`, `textSuccess`, `textDanger`, `textWarning`, `textBrand` |
| Surfaces | `canvas` (app background), `elevated`, `recessed`, `base` (cards, inputs, popovers), `tint` (hover), `contrast`, `overlay`, `control` (field fill), `fill`, `fillHover` |
| Lines | `line` (rings), `hairline` (dividers), `interact` (control borders), `focus` |
| Accent | `brand` (primary blue), `brandHover` |
| Status | `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` and their `...Tint` backgrounds, `bannerInfo`, `bannerWarning` |
| Badges | `badgeRed`, `badgeGreen`, `badgeOrange`, `badgePurple`, `badgeTeal`, `badgeBlue`, `badgeNeutral`, `badgeInverted` and the `textBadge...` tokens |
| Shadows | `shadowEdge`, `shadowDrop`, `arrowEdge`, `arrowStroke` |

Surface hierarchy: `canvas` < `elevated` < `recessed`; components sit on `base`.

```dart
Container(color: context.kumo.colors.base, child: const KumoText('Deleted', color: KumoColor.textDanger))
```

`textBrand` is Cloudflare orange and exists for parity only; no component uses it.

## Spacing

Tailwind's 4px grid, named by Tailwind step: `KumoSpace.s1` 4, `s1_5` 6, `s2` 8, `s3` 12, `s4` 16, `s5` 20, `s6` 24, `s8` 32. Any step: `KumoSpace.step(7)` is 28.

Kumo's spacing rule: related text sits closer together than the content around it, and vertical padding around text is slightly smaller than horizontal (`px-5 py-4`).

## Radius

`KumoRadius.sm` 4, `md` 6, `lg` 8 (buttons, inputs, cards), `xl` 12 (dialogs), `full`. Nested shapes are concentric:

```dart
final inner = KumoRadius.concentric(KumoRadius.xl, 4); // 8
```

## Shadows and rings

Most surfaces are flat with a 1px ring. `KumoRing.border(color)` draws a CSS-style ring outside the box without taking layout space. Floating surfaces add a shadow: `KumoShadow.xs` (resting controls), `.lg` (menus, popovers, toasts), `.xl` (dialogs). Never combine a border with a shadow; use a ring.

```dart
DecoratedBox(
  decoration: BoxDecoration(
    color: context.kumo.colors.base,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(KumoRadius.lg),
    border: KumoRing.border(context.kumo.colors.line),
    boxShadow: KumoShadow.lg.boxShadows,
  ),
)
```

## Typography

| Use | API | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All content text | `kumo.text()` / `KumoText('...')` | 14px, line height 1.5 |
| Secondary rows | `KumoTextSize.sm` | 13px |
| Captions | `KumoTextSize.xs` | 12px |
| Headings | `KumoTextVariant.heading` | 16px semibold, 20px with `size: lg` |
| Page titles | `kumo.heading(size: KumoHeadingSize.h2)` | 24px |
| Code | `KumoTextVariant.mono` | 13px JetBrains Mono (14px with `size: lg`) |

Weights: 400, 500 (`bold: true`, buttons, labels), 600 (headings). Never 700. Never change letter spacing. Headings are sentence case.

## Breakpoints

`KumoBreakpoints.sm` 640, `md` 768, `lg` 1024, `xl` 1280. `context.kumoIsNarrow` is true below `md`, where floating panels become sheets. `context.kumoWindowSize` gives `compact`, `medium` or `expanded`.

## Icons

`KumoIcons` holds all 1,530 Phosphor icons in regular and fill weights (`KumoIcons.star`, `KumoIcons.starFill`). They are const `IconData`, so release builds tree-shake unused glyphs. `package:kumo_flutter/kumo_icon_catalog.dart` adds a searchable list with tags and categories for icon pickers (importing it turns tree shaking off).

---
source: doc/components/KumoAccordion.md
---

# KumoAccordion

A stack of collapsible sections separated by hairlines, for FAQs and grouped settings where people open one or a few sections at a time. Shaped after shadcn's accordion and drawn with Kumo tokens; Kumo has no accordion of its own.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/collapsible (the building block)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoAccordion(
  value: open,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  items: const [
    KumoAccordionItem(value: 'cache', title: 'Cache rules', child: KumoText('3 rules apply to example.com')),
    KumoAccordionItem(value: 'waf', title: 'WAF custom rules', child: KumoText('1 rule blocks /wp-admin')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for three or more related sections that are too long to show at once. For a single block, use `KumoCollapsible`; for views that replace each other, use `KumoTabs`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoAccordionItem>` | required | |
| `value` | `Set<String>` | required | Values of the open items |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<Set<String>>?` | required | The next set. Null makes it read-only |
| `type` | `KumoAccordionType` | `single` | `single` closes the others; `multiple` opens independently |
| `collapsible` | `bool` | `true` | For `single`: whether the open item can be closed |
| `keepMounted` | `bool` | `false` | Keep closed panels alive |

`KumoAccordionItem`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | |
| `title` | `String` | required | Medium 14px |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Panel content; plain `Text` is shown in subtle 14px |
| `description` | `String?` | | Second line under the title |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading 16px icon; the panel indents to line up |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Multiple open

```dart
KumoAccordion(
  type: KumoAccordionType.multiple,
  value: open,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  items: const [
    KumoAccordionItem(value: 'routes', title: 'Routes', icon: KumoIcons.globe, child: Text('example.com/api/*')),
    KumoAccordionItem(value: 'logs', title: 'Logs', icon: KumoIcons.listBullets, child: Text('Workers Logs')),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Each header is a header and a button with an expanded state. Tab moves between headers; Up and Down also move (wrapping, skipping disabled items), Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space toggles. Closed content is out of the focus order and hidden from screen readers.

## Motion

Panels open with `KumoCollapsiblePanel`: 200ms height and fade, content clipped at full size, reversible mid-flight. The caret is a `KumoDisclosureCaret` on the same timing, so it turns in step with its panel while another item closes. Reduced motion is instant.

## Mobile

Headers are full width with at least 44px of height on touch; titles and descriptions wrap at 2x text.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo builds accordions from controlled `Collapsible` roots (see its "Controlled Accordion Pattern"). Here:

| Kumo pattern | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `activeIndex` state + `open={activeIndex === i}` | `value` (a set) + `type: single` |
| several independent `Collapsible.Root`s | `type: multiple` |
| `Collapsible.DefaultTrigger` | the section header |
| `Collapsible.DefaultPanel` | the section panel (no accent rule) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoAnchoredOverlay.md
---

# KumoAnchoredOverlay

The positioning primitive behind popovers, tooltips, menus, selects and comboboxes. Use it to build custom floating panels.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class FilterButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const FilterButton({super.key});

  @override
  State<FilterButton> createState() => _FilterButtonState();
}

class _FilterButtonState extends State<FilterButton> {
  bool _open = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoAnchoredOverlay(
      open: _open,
      onDismiss: () => setState(() => _open = false),
      side: KumoSide.bottom,
      align: KumoAlign.start,
      overlayBuilder: (context, placement) => KumoPopupSurface(
        placement: placement,
        showArrow: true,
        child: const KumoText('Filters'),
      ),
      child: KumoButton(label: 'Filter', icon: KumoIcons.funnel, onPress: () => setState(() => _open = !_open)),
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Reach for the finished components first (`KumoPopover`, `KumoDropdownMenu`, `KumoSelect`, `KumoTooltip`). Use this primitive for a panel those do not cover.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Owned by the parent; changes animate |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The anchor (trigger) |
| `overlayBuilder` | `KumoPopupBuilder` | required | Builds the popup for a `KumoPopupPlacement` |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Outside tap or Escape; set `open` to false |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | Flips to the opposite side when there is not enough room |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `center` | `start`/`end` follow text direction |
| `sideOffset`, `alignOffset` | `double` | `8`, `0` | |
| `collisionPadding` | `double` | `8` | Distance kept from the screen edges and safe area |
| `preferredExtent` | `double` | `200` | Room wanted before flipping |
| `matchAnchorWidth` | `bool` | `false` | Popup at least as wide as the anchor |
| `dismissOnOutsideTap`, `closeOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `trapFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Move focus inside and cycle Tab within the popup |
| `restoreFocus` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `focusPopupWhenUnfocused` | `bool` | `true` | When nothing is focused at open, focus the popup so Escape reaches it |
| `useRootOverlay` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `onClosed` | `VoidCallback?` | | After the close animation finishes |
| `tapRegionGroupId` | `Object?` | | Share outside-tap grouping with other widgets |

`KumoPopupPlacement` gives the resolved `side`, `align`, `anchorRect`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight`, and `popupRect` (a listenable for painters).

## KumoPopupSurface

The floating surface: `bg-kumo-base`, 1px `line` outline, `shadow-lg`, rounded `lg`, 12px padding, and an optional arrow that points at the anchor.

| Name | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required |
| `placement` | `KumoPopupPlacement?` | needed for the arrow |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `false` |
| `borderRadius` | `double` | `KumoRadius.lg` |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `all(12)` |
| `shadow` | `KumoShadow` | `lg` |
| `clip` | `bool` | `true` |

## Accessibility

Escape closes from the anchor, from inside the popup, or when nothing is focused. With `trapFocus`, focus moves in and returns to the anchor on close.

## Motion

Opens with a critically damped spring from scale 0.9 plus a 150ms fade, transform origin on the anchor side; closes the same way. Reopening mid-close turns around from the current scale. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

The popup stays inside the safe area and shifts along its edge to fit. Components built on it switch to `showKumoSheet` on narrow screens.

---
source: doc/components/KumoAppShell.md
---

# KumoAppShell

The responsive frame a Kumo app is built on: a `KumoSidebar`, a sticky top bar and the page, switching between a persistent sidebar, an icon rail and a phone drawer.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/sidebar (Kumo has no shell component; this is the Flutter frame around Kumo's sidebar and its mobile drawer)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoAppShell(
  sidebar: KumoSidebar(
    header: const KumoSidebarHeader(children: [Expanded(child: KumoText('Acme Inc', bold: true)), KumoSidebarClose()]),
    footer: const KumoSidebarFooter(children: [KumoSidebarTrigger()]),
    child: KumoSidebarContent(children: [
      KumoSidebarGroup(children: [
        KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.house, label: 'Account home', active: true, onPress: () {}),
        KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.code, label: 'Workers', onPress: () {}),
      ]),
    ]),
  ),
  topBar: const KumoText('Workers', variant: KumoTextVariant.heading),
  body: const Center(child: KumoText('Page content')),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it once, at the root of an app's signed-in area. Pages go in `body`. Do not nest shells; for a sidebar inside a panel, use `KumoSidebar` directly.

## Layouts

| Width of the shell | Layout | Sidebar |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1024px and up | `KumoAppShellLayout.wide` | Persistent; the trigger collapses it to the rail. State: `sidebarOpen` |
| 768px to 1023px | `KumoAppShellLayout.medium` | Starts as the 57px rail; the trigger expands it until the layout changes |
| below 768px | `KumoAppShellLayout.narrow` | Drawer from the sidebar's edge, opened by the "Menu" button in the top bar or an edge swipe |

The width is the shell's own constraint width, so a shell inside a smaller box picks its layout from the box.

The shell is a page-level widget: it sets Kumo's text style and icon theme for everything inside it, paints the canvas color, and puts a transparent `Material` around the body (text fields need one), so it works as a route's root without a `Scaffold`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `Widget` | required | The page |
| `sidebar` | `KumoSidebar?` | | Its `open`/`onOpenChange` are ignored; the shell owns them |
| `topBar` | `Widget?` | | Content of the sticky bar (48px min, bottom border). Narrow layouts always show the bar for the menu button |
| `bottomNavigation` | `Widget?` | | Bar pinned to the bottom on narrow layouts, usually a `KumoBottomNavigation` (which draws its own border and home-indicator padding); any other widget gets a top border and the bottom safe area from the shell |
| `sidebarOpen` | `bool?` | null | Wide layout expanded state. Null keeps it inside, starting from `initialSidebarOpen` |
| `initialSidebarOpen` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `onSidebarOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Wide layout only |
| `onDrawerOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Drawer opened or closed, by any means |
| `layout` | `KumoAppShellLayout?` | | Force a layout |
| `narrowBreakpoint` | `double` | `768` | |
| `wideBreakpoint` | `double` | `1024` | |
| `bodyPadding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `EdgeInsets.zero` | Inside the safe area |
| `safeAreaBody` | `bool` | `true` | Pad the body for safe-area edges no bar covers |
| `drawerWidth` | `double?` | sidebar width | Capped so 56px of the page stays visible |
| `fullScreenDrawer` | `bool` | `false` | Drawer covers the screen without a scrim; put `KumoSidebarClose` in the header |
| `closeDrawerOnNavigate` | `bool` | `true` | Pressing a menu row closes the drawer |
| `menuLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.menu` | Visible label of the menu button |
| `edgeSwipeWidth` | `double` | `20` | Strip along the edge that starts an edge swipe (plus the safe-area inset) |

`KumoAppShell.of(context)` returns `KumoAppShellData`: `layout`, `drawerOpen`, `openDrawer()`, `closeDrawer()`, `toggleSidebar()`.

## Examples

### Phone app with a bottom bar

```dart
KumoAppShell(
  sidebar: mySidebar,
  topBar: const KumoText('Workers', variant: KumoTextVariant.heading),
  bottomNavigation: myTabBar, // a KumoBottomNavigation
  body: ListView(children: const []),
)
```

### Open the drawer from page content

```dart
KumoButton(label: 'Browse products', onPress: () => KumoAppShell.of(context).openDrawer())
```

### Controlled sidebar on wide screens

```dart
KumoAppShell(
  sidebarOpen: expanded,
  onSidebarOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => expanded = v),
  sidebar: mySidebar,
  body: const SizedBox(),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The menu button has a visible "Menu" label. Opening the drawer moves focus to its first row; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the drawer; Escape, the scrim (announced as "Close sidebar"), `KumoSidebarClose` and the system back gesture close it, and focus returns to what had it before.
- While the drawer is open the page behind is out of the focus order and hidden from screen readers.
- The top bar is separated from the page by a border (Kumo's rule for sticky elements).

## Motion

- The drawer follows the finger 1:1, keeping the grab offset. On release a clear flick (over 400px/s) decides by direction; otherwise the projected resting point decides, so a small drag springs back. The settle is a spring (`KumoSprings.sheet`) that keeps the finger's velocity and can be caught mid-flight.
- Past fully open the drawer resists (rubberband) and stretches from its edge rather than pulling away.
- The scrim dims in proportion to how far the drawer is open.
- A light haptic marks a gesture that changes the open state.
- Reduced motion: the drawer appears and disappears in place.
- Sidebar collapse on wide screens follows `KumoSidebar`'s motion.
- A `KumoBottomNavigation` in `bottomNavigation` slides its active pill between destinations.

## Mobile

- The top bar takes the top safe area, the bottom bar takes the bottom one, and the body gets the rest (`MediaQuery.padding` inside the body is what is left).
- Edge swipes start only in the edge strip, so horizontal scrolling in the page keeps working. A closed drawer never listens for drags across the page.
- The drawer is 260px or the sidebar's width, never closer than 56px to the far edge.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `Sidebar.Provider` + `<Sidebar>` + `<main>` | `KumoAppShell(sidebar:, body:)` |
| `mobileBreakpoint` | `narrowBreakpoint` |
| `fullScreenOnMobile` | `fullScreenDrawer` |
| mobile `Sidebar.Trigger` in a page header | the built-in "Menu" button, or `KumoAppShell.of(context).openDrawer()` |
| `openMobile` / `setOpenMobile` | `KumoAppShell.of(context).drawerOpen` / `openDrawer` / `closeDrawer` |
| `open` / `onOpenChange` (desktop) | `sidebarOpen` / `onSidebarOpenChange` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoAutocomplete.md
---

# KumoAutocomplete

A free-text field with a list of suggestions. Reach for it when any value is valid but common ones are worth offering: route patterns, hostnames, dates.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/autocomplete

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoAutocomplete(
  label: 'Route',
  placeholder: 'example.com/*',
  value: route,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => route = v),
  options: KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(['example.com/*', 'api.example.com/*', 'example.com/images/*']),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it when the text itself is the value and suggestions only speed up typing.
- When the value must be one of the options, use `KumoCombobox` or `KumoSelect`.
- For a plain field with no suggestions, use `KumoInput`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | The field's text |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | required | Every edit, and a picked suggestion's value |
| `options` | `List<KumoSelectItem<String>>` | required | Suggestions; an option's `value` is the inserted text, its `label` what the list shows |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `label`, `description`, `error`, `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Field parts |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | A loading row while suggestions are fetched |
| `filter` | `KumoOptionFilter<String>?` | `kumoContainsFilter` | Which suggestions match the text |
| `emptyMessage` | `String?` | `null` | Text when nothing matches; null hides the list instead (Kumo's behavior) |
| `loadingMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.loading` | |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | The suggestion list showed or hid |
| `onSubmitted` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Enter with no suggestion highlighted |
| `side`, `sideOffset` | | `bottom`, `4` | Flips above near the keyboard |
| `maxHeight` | `double` | `384` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a label |
| `keyboardType`, `autofillHints` | | | Passed to the text field |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace text for hostnames and paths |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Grouped suggestions with an empty message

```dart
KumoAutocomplete(
  label: 'Custom hostname',
  emptyMessage: 'No saved hostnames match. Press Enter to use what you typed.',
  value: hostname,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => hostname = v),
  onSubmitted: (v) => addHostname(v),
  options: const [
    KumoSelectGroup(label: 'Saved', options: [
      KumoSelectOption(value: 'shop.example.com', label: 'shop.example.com'),
      KumoSelectOption(value: 'docs.example.com', label: 'docs.example.com'),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- A labelled text field with an expanded state while suggestions show.
- Typing or Down opens the suggestions; Up and Down move the highlight while focus stays in the field; Enter puts the highlighted suggestion in the field (with nothing highlighted, Enter submits); Escape closes and keeps the text.
- The suggestion equal to the current text shows a check.

## Motion

Kumo's popup motion: a spring scale from the field plus a fade, fade only under reduced motion. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

The list stays anchored to the field and opens above it when the on-screen keyboard leaves too little room below.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop / part | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` + `Autocomplete.Item` | `options` |
| `Autocomplete.Group`, `GroupLabel`, `Separator` | `KumoSelectGroup`, `KumoSelectSeparator` |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `onOpenChange` | `onOpenChange` (`open` is managed by the field) |
| `Autocomplete.InputGroup size` | `size` |
| `Autocomplete.Empty` | `emptyMessage` |
| `useFilter` / `filter` | `filter` |
| `label`, `description`, `error`, `labelTooltip`, `required` | same names |

source: doc/components/KumoAvatar.md

# KumoAvatar

A person's or account's picture, with initials while it loads or when there is none, optional live presence, and `KumoAvatarGroup` for stacks.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no avatar component; this one is inspired by shadcn's avatar and uses Kumo's fill, line and text tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoAvatar(name: 'Ada Lovelace')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it next to a person's or account's name in members lists, audit logs and comments. Only show a picture the person or account uploaded; without one the avatar shows initials (or a person glyph without a name). Never generate a face.

Set `status` only from live presence data; a stale "online" dot is worse than none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String?` | | Full or account name. Initials come from the first and last words; an email uses the part before the @ |
| `image` | `ImageProvider?` | | The uploaded picture. Initials show while it loads and if it fails |
| `size` | `KumoAvatarSize` | `base` | `sm` 24px, `base` 32px, `lg` 40px |
| `shape` | `KumoAvatarShape` | `circle` | `circle` for people, `square` (8px radius) for accounts and teams |
| `status` | `KumoAvatarStatus?` | | `online`, `away`, `busy`, `offline` dot at the bottom end |
| `statusLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces the English status name read by screen readers |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces the spoken "name, status" |

`KumoAvatar.initialsOf(name)` returns the initials the avatar would show.

## Examples

### With a picture and presence

```dart
KumoAvatar(
  name: 'Grace Hopper',
  image: NetworkImage(member.avatarUrl),
  status: KumoAvatarStatus.online,
)
```

### Account

```dart
const KumoAvatar(name: 'example.com', shape: KumoAvatarShape.square, size: KumoAvatarSize.lg)
```

### Group

```dart
KumoAvatarGroup(
  max: 3,
  onOverflowPress: () => showMembers(),
  avatars: const [
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Ada Lovelace'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Grace Hopper'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Alan Turing'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Katherine Johnson'),
  ],
)
```

See `KumoAvatarGroup` for its parameters.

## Accessibility

The avatar is read as its name plus the status ("Grace Hopper, Online"); the picture itself is excluded. The status dot is never the only signal: screen readers hear the status, and wherever presence matters, show it as text next to the avatar too.

## Motion

A picture fades in over the initials when its first frame arrives (150ms). Under reduced motion it appears at once. Cached pictures appear without a fade. A status change eases the dot's color (150ms).

## Mobile

Initials scale with the text setting up to 1.3x, then stay inside the circle; the avatar keeps its size.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | |
| shadcn `AvatarImage src` | `image` |
| shadcn `AvatarFallback` | `name` (initials) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoAvatarGroup.md

# KumoAvatarGroup

Overlapping `KumoAvatar`s with a "+3" chip for the ones that do not fit.

Kumo reference: none. Inspired by shadcn's avatar group; see `KumoAvatar`.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoAvatarGroup(
  max: 3,
  avatars: [
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Ada Lovelace'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Grace Hopper'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Alan Turing'),
    KumoAvatar(name: 'Katherine Johnson'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show who has access to a resource or who is in a team, when the exact list lives elsewhere. When the names matter, list them as text instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avatars` | `List<KumoAvatar>` | required | In order. Each one's `size` is replaced by the group's |
| `max` | `int?` | | Avatars shown before the overflow chip. Null shows all |
| `size` | `KumoAvatarSize` | `base` | |
| `ringColor` | `KumoColor` | `base` | 2px ring around each avatar; set it to the surface behind the group |
| `onOverflowPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the "+N" chip a button (open the member list) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces the generated label |

## Examples

### Expand on press

```dart
KumoAvatarGroup(
  avatars: members,
  max: showAll ? null : 3,
  onOverflowPress: () => setState(() => showAll = true),
)
```

## Accessibility

Without `onOverflowPress` the group is one node: "Ada Lovelace, Grace Hopper, Alan Turing and 1 more". With it, each avatar reads its own name and the chip is a button labelled "Show 1 more".

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Each avatar after the first overlaps the previous one by a quarter of its width, toward the start edge (mirrored in RTL). A pressable chip gets a 44x44 hit area on touch platforms without changing its look.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | |

# KumoBadge

Kumo's `Badge`: a small label for status, categories or metadata, such as "Active", "Beta" or "Proxied".

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/badge

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoBadge('New', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.secondary)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a badge to label a row, a heading or a card with a short status or category. Keep the label to one or two words in sentence case: the label carries the meaning, the color only reinforces it.

Reach for the semantic variants (`primary`, `secondary`, `error`, `warning`, `success`, `info`, `outline`, `beta`) first. The color variants (`red`, `green`, `neutral`, `orange`, `purple`, `teal`, `blue`) are for product categories where a semantic color would say the wrong thing.

Do not use a badge as a button bar or a filter control; use buttons or tabs. A badge with `onPress` is for a single navigation target (a changelog link).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` (positional) | required | Badge text. One line, ellipsized if the parent is too narrow |
| `variant` | `KumoBadgeVariant` | `primary` | Color variant, see the table below |
| `appearance` | `KumoBadgeAppearance` | `filled` | `dot` draws a transparent badge with a hairline ring and a 7px status dot |
| `size` | `KumoBadgeSize` | `base` | `base` is Kumo's 20px badge (12px text). `lg` (13px text, about 23px) is a port addition for page headers |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading 12px icon. Filled appearance only |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Leading widget in place of `icon` |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the badge pressable; hover draws a 1px ring in the text color |
| `isLink` | `bool` | `false` | Announce as a link instead of a button when pressable |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces the label for screen readers |

### Variants

| Variant | Background | Text |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `primary` (alias `inverted`) | `badgeInverted` | `textBadgeInverted` |
| `secondary` (alias `neutralSubtle`) | `fill` | `textBadgeNeutralSubtle` |
| `error` | `dangerTint` | `textDanger` |
| `warning` | `warningTint` | `textWarning` |
| `success` | `successTint` | `textSuccess` |
| `info` | `infoTint` | `textInfo` |
| `beta` | transparent, 1px dashed `brand` border | `textLink` |
| `outline` | `base`, 1px `fill` border | `textDefault` |
| `red`, `green`, `neutral`, `purple`, `teal`, `blue` | `badge<Color>` | white |
| `orange` | `badgeOrange` | black |
| `tealSubtle` | `badgeTeal` at 12% (24% dark) | `textBadgeTealSubtle` |
| `orangeSubtle` | `badgeOrange` at 16% (20% dark) | `textBadgeOrangeSubtle` |
| `destructive` | deprecated, same as `red` | |

`KumoBadgeColors.resolve(theme, variant)` returns the exact pair a badge draws, for custom chips or tests.

## Examples

### Status with a dot

The dot only appears for `success`, `warning`, `error` and `neutral`, as in Kumo.

```dart
const Wrap(spacing: 8, children: [
  KumoBadge('Healthy', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.success, appearance: KumoBadgeAppearance.dot),
  KumoBadge('Rate limited', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.warning, appearance: KumoBadgeAppearance.dot),
  KumoBadge('Down', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.error, appearance: KumoBadgeAppearance.dot),
])
```

### With an icon

```dart
const KumoBadge('Verified', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.success, icon: KumoIcons.checkCircle)
```

### In a sentence

```dart
const Row(children: [
  KumoText('Workers'),
  SizedBox(width: 8),
  KumoBadge('New', variant: KumoBadgeVariant.secondary),
])
```

### Linked badge

```dart
KumoBadge(
  'View changelog',
  variant: KumoBadgeVariant.outline,
  isLink: true,
  onPress: () => openChangelog(),
)
```

## Accessibility

A static badge is plain text and is read as its label. The dot is decorative; the label names the state. A pressable badge is a button (or a link with `isLink`) with Kumo's focus ring, Enter and Space activation, and a 44x44 touch target on touch platforms.

Contrast, measured with `KumoColorUtils.contrastRatio` over the base, canvas, elevated and control surfaces (translucent tints composited first): every pair meets 4.5:1 in dark mode. In light mode two Kumo pairs fall short at 12px and are kept for parity with Kumo:

| Variant | Light ratio | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `warning` | about 3.8 to 4.0 | `textWarning` on `warningTint` |
| `green` | about 3.65 | white on `badgeGreen` (Tailwind green 600) |

Both pass 3:1. Where the badge is the only place a state appears, prefer `success` over `green`, or pair `warning` with an icon or the dot appearance.

## Motion

A change of label, variant or appearance (Deploying to Active) cross-fades the pill (100ms) and eases its width (200ms), so the row around it slides instead of jumping. The old label leaves the semantics tree at once. The hover ring of a pressable badge switches instantly, like every Kumo hover. Reduced motion swaps at once.

## Mobile

Badges are text-sized and never wrap; a label longer than its parent is ellipsized. At 2x text the badge grows taller instead of clipping.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `variant="teal-subtle"` | `variant: KumoBadgeVariant.tealSubtle` |
| `appearance="dot"` | `appearance: KumoBadgeAppearance.dot` |
| `icon={CheckCircleIcon}` | `icon: KumoIcons.checkCircle` |
| `icon={<Custom />}` | `iconWidget:` |
| wrapping in `<Link>` | `onPress:` + `isLink: true` |
| `className` | not ported |

Deviation: Kumo's `teal-subtle` uses `bg-kumo-badge-teal-subtle`, which Kumo's theme never defines, so the web badge renders with no fill. The port fills it with a light tint of the teal badge color.

---
source: doc/components/KumoBanner.md

# KumoBanner

A full-width inline message for information, warnings and errors that belong to a page or a section, with optional accent-tinted actions.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/banner

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

const updateBanner = KumoBanner(
  icon: KumoIcons.infoFill,
  title: 'Update available',
  description: 'Wrangler 4.2 is ready to install.',
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for messages tied to what is on screen: an expiring certificate on a zone page, a failed save above a form, a read-only notice in a dialog.
- Use `KumoToast` for transient outcomes of an action, and `KumoDialog` when the user must decide before going on.
- With `onDismiss`, the X collapses the banner and then calls `onDismiss`; the parent removes it (or sets `open: false`).

## Parameters

### KumoBanner

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | The message, medium weight. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Supporting text, 13px. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom description content in place of `description`; inherits the banner text color. |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | `null` | Leading icon in the accent color, the size of the text. Kumo pairs banners with filled icons. |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Usually `KumoBannerAction`s. Beside the text when the banner is 360px or wider, under it otherwise. |
| `variant` | `KumoBannerVariant` | `info` | `info` (blue), `alert` (amber), `error` (red), `secondary` (neutral). |
| `size` | `KumoBannerSize` | `base` | `sm`: compact, title and description share a line, 13px text, extra-small actions. |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Adds a ghost X action. Runs after the banner has collapsed. |
| `open` | `bool` | `true` | Shown while true. Changes expand or collapse the banner; mounting with `true` shows it at rest. |
| `dismissLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.dismiss` | Accessible name of the X. |

At least one of `title`, `description` or `child` is required.

### KumoBannerAction

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Null makes an icon-only square action. |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | `null` | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | required | Null disables it. |
| `variant` | `KumoBannerActionVariant` | `primary` | `primary`: accent gradient. `secondary`: accent outline. `ghost`: text only with a faint accent hover. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Required for icon-only actions. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a spinner and blocks presses. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |

Actions are 26px tall in a base banner and 20px in a compact one; on touch their hit area is padded to 44x44.

## Examples

### Actions and dismiss

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Widget paymentBanner({required VoidCallback retry, required VoidCallback openBilling, required VoidCallback hide}) {
  return KumoBanner(
    variant: KumoBannerVariant.error,
    icon: KumoIcons.warningCircleFill,
    title: 'Payment failed',
    description: 'Update your card to avoid interruption.',
    actions: [
      KumoBannerAction(label: 'Retry', onPress: retry),
      KumoBannerAction(label: 'Go to billing', variant: KumoBannerActionVariant.secondary, onPress: openBilling),
    ],
    onDismiss: hide,
  );
}
```

### Compact, inside a dialog

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

const readOnlyNotice = KumoBanner(
  size: KumoBannerSize.sm,
  icon: KumoIcons.infoFill,
  title: 'Read only.',
  description: 'Ask an admin for edit access.',
);
```

## Accessibility

- The title carries the message, so status never rests on color alone; add an icon for a second cue.
- Error banners are live regions, so they are announced when they appear.
- The dismiss X is announced with `KumoStrings.dismiss`. Text colors come from Kumo's text tokens on their tints.

## Motion

- Pressing the X collapses the banner from its bottom edge (200ms, height and opacity, content clipped at its size) so the content below slides up into its place; `onDismiss` runs when it is gone.
- Driving `open` expands or collapses it the same way, reversing from its current height if it flips mid-flight. The banner ignores taps while moving.
- Hover backgrounds on actions switch instantly; presses scale to 0.98 through `KumoPressable`.
- Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

Below 360px of banner width the actions move under the text and wrap. Text scales with the platform setting; the icon stays aligned with the first line.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant="default"` | `KumoBannerVariant.info` |
| `variant="alert"` / `"error"` / `"secondary"` | `KumoBannerVariant.alert` / `.error` / `.secondary` |
| `size="base"` / `"sm"` | `KumoBannerSize.base` / `.sm` |
| `icon={<Info weight="fill" />}` | `icon: KumoIcons.infoFill` |
| `title` / `description` | `title:` / `description:` (or `child:` for custom content) |
| `action={<>...</>}` | `actions: [...]` |
| `Banner.Action variant` | `KumoBannerAction(variant:)` |
| `<Banner.Action variant="ghost" icon={<X />} aria-label="Dismiss" />` | `onDismiss:` |
| `children` / `text` (deprecated) | `child:` / `description:` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoBottomNavigation.md

# KumoBottomNavigation

A tab bar for phone layouts of Kumo apps: three to five destinations, each an icon over a label, pinned to the bottom with room for the home indicator.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo is a dashboard system; this bar uses its tokens for apps that bring Kumo to phones.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoBottomNavigation(
  value: section,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => section = v),
  items: const [
    KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: KumoIcons.house, activeIcon: KumoIcons.houseFill),
    KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'workers', label: 'Workers', icon: KumoIcons.code, activeIcon: KumoIcons.codeFill),
    KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: KumoIcons.bell, activeIcon: KumoIcons.bellFill, badgeCount: 3),
  ],
  body: const KumoText('Workers'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it as the top-level navigation of a phone app with three to five sections. On tablets and desktop, use a sidebar instead (switch on `context.kumoIsNarrow`). Do not use it for views of one resource (`KumoTabs`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoBottomNavigationItem>` | required | 2 to 5 (asserted); 3 to 5 recommended |
| `value` | `String` | required | Active destination |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | required | Also called for the active one, so the app can scroll it to the top |
| `body` | `Widget?` | | Screen content laid out above the bar |
| `safeArea` | `bool` | `true` | Pad for the bottom system inset |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

`KumoBottomNavigationItem`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | |
| `label` | `String` | required | One short word |
| `icon` | `IconData` | required | Regular weight, inactive |
| `activeIcon` | `IconData?` | `icon` | Usually the `...Fill` variant |
| `badgeCount` | `int?` | | Unread count on the icon; over 99 shows "99+" |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `label` | |

## Examples

### Content never hides under the bar

With `body`, the bar lays out a `Column`: the body gets the space above the bar and its bottom safe-area padding is removed (the bar already pads for it). Without `body`, place the bar at the bottom of your own `Column` and leave the body in an `Expanded`.

```dart
Column(
  children: [
    const Expanded(child: KumoText('Alerts')),
    KumoBottomNavigation(
      value: 'alerts',
      onValueChange: (v) {},
      items: const [
        KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: KumoIcons.house),
        KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: KumoIcons.bell),
        KumoBottomNavigationItem(value: 'account', label: 'Profile', icon: KumoIcons.user),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The bar is a tab bar; each destination is a tab with its selected state and its label; an unread count is the value ("3"). Tab and Enter work with a keyboard. The active destination is marked by the fill icon, medium label and a tinted pill, not color alone.

## Motion

Press scales the destination (0.98 spring) and shows an instant tint on an inactive pill. The active pill slides from the previous destination to the new one on a spring (`KumoSprings.standard`) that starts from where it is, so a second tap mid-flight turns it around; each destination paints the part of the pill that crosses it, under its own icon. The fill icon cross-fades in over 150ms. A selection haptic fires when the destination changes. Reduced motion moves the pill and swaps the icon in one frame.

## Mobile

`base` surface with a hairline top border. Each destination fills its share of the width and is at least 56px tall (44px minimum target). At 2x text labels grow; they truncate with an ellipsis rather than wrap.
