source: doc/components/KumoBreadcrumbs.md
---

# KumoBreadcrumbs

The trail from the account root to the current page, for dashboards with nested resources (account, zone, DNS, record).

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/breadcrumbs

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoBreadcrumbs(
  items: [
    KumoBreadcrumbsItem(label: 'Account home', icon: KumoIcons.house, onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).popUntil((r) => r.isFirst)),
    KumoBreadcrumbsItem(label: 'example.com', onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).pop()),
  ],
  current: 'DNS records',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use breadcrumbs at the top of a page that sits two or more levels deep. Do not use them for steps of a flow (`KumoSteps`) or for switching sibling views (`KumoTabs`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoBreadcrumbsItem>` | `const []` | Ancestor pages, root first; not the current page |
| `current` | `String` | required | Title of the current page |
| `currentIcon` | `IconData?` | | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Placeholder bar in place of `current`, announced as loading |
| `size` | `KumoBreadcrumbsSize` | `base` | `base` 48px row, 14px; `sm` 40px row, 13px |
| `copyText` | `String?` | | Adds a copy button for a deep link (Kumo's `Breadcrumbs.Clipboard`) |
| `narrowLayout` | `KumoBreadcrumbsNarrowLayout` | `back` | What shows below 640px |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Where the More menu opens: popover, or a sheet below 768px |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.breadcrumbs` | |

`KumoBreadcrumbsItem(label:, onPress:, icon:, semanticLabel:)`. A null `onPress` shows the crumb as plain text.

`KumoBreadcrumbsNarrowLayout`:

| Value | Below 640px |
| --- | --- |
| `back` | One back link: a caret and the parent's label, announced as "Back, parent" |
| `trail` | Kumo's mobile trail: More menu, parent, current page |
| `full` | The whole trail, collapsing as on wide screens |

## Examples

### Collapsing when tight

On any width, when the trail does not fit, the middle ancestors move into a "More" menu (three dots) after the root: `Account home > ... > Records > api.example.com`. If even that does not fit, only the parent and current page remain. Ancestors never shrink (as in Kumo); the current page truncates with an ellipsis.

### Loading and copy

```dart
KumoBreadcrumbs(
  items: [KumoBreadcrumbsItem(label: 'Workers', onPress: () {})],
  current: 'image-resizer',
  loading: false,
  copyText: 'https://dash.example.com/workers/image-resizer',
)
```

The copy button appears on hover with a mouse and stays visible on touch. After copying it shows a check for 2 seconds.

## Accessibility

The trail is a labelled container ("Breadcrumbs"). Ancestors are links; the current page is plain medium-weight text. Separators are decorative. The More button announces "More" and its expanded state; its menu rows are links and the menu takes focus (arrow keys move, Escape closes and returns focus). Every link has Kumo's focus ring.

## Motion

When the width changes and crumbs move into or out of the More menu, the crumbs (or the More button) that appear fade in over 150ms; opacity only, so the row never lags a window resize, and the first layout shows at once. The copy button fades in on hover (100ms, Kumo's `transition-[opacity]`), and its check lands with a small bounce after a copy. The More menu opens with the popover motion of `KumoAnchoredOverlay`, or as a sheet that follows the finger. Reduced motion is instant.

## Mobile

Below 640px (Kumo's `sm`) the layout follows `narrowLayout`, a back link by default. Below 768px the More menu opens in a bottom sheet. Links have 44px hit areas on touch. At 2x text, a lone crumb or the current page truncates instead of overflowing.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Breadcrumbs.Link href>` children | `items: [KumoBreadcrumbsItem(label:, onPress:)]` |
| `Breadcrumbs.Link icon` | `KumoBreadcrumbsItem.icon` |
| `<Breadcrumbs.Current>` | `current` |
| `Breadcrumbs.Current icon` / `loading` | `currentIcon` / `loading` |
| `<Breadcrumbs.Separator />` | drawn automatically between crumbs |
| `<Breadcrumbs.Clipboard text>` | `copyText` |
| `size` | `size` |

Kumo's mobile ellipsis is decorative; here it is a working More menu. The overflow collapse on wide screens and the back-link layout are additions.

source: doc/components/KumoButton.md

# KumoButton

Kumo's `Button`: the control for actions, in six variants and four sizes, with icon-only shapes, a loading state and an optional tooltip.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/button

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoButton(label: 'Deploy', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {})
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a button for an action on the current page. Use one `primary` button per view for the main action, `secondary` (the default) for everything else, `ghost` in toolbars and dense rows, `destructive` for delete and revoke. For navigation inside text use `KumoLink`; for a toggled state use `KumoToggle` or `KumoSwitch`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | | Button text, sentence case |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Custom content in place of `label` |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Null renders the button disabled |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | |
| `variant` | `KumoButtonVariant` | `secondary` | `primary`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `secondaryDestructive`, `outline` |
| `size` | `KumoButtonSize` | `base` | `xs` 20px, `sm` 26px, `base` 36px, `lg` 40px |
| `shape` | `KumoButtonShape` | `base` | `square` and `circle` are icon-only and need `semanticLabel` or `title` |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading icon |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Leading widget in place of `icon` |
| `endIcon` | `IconData?` | | Trailing icon, such as a caret for menus |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a spinner in place of the icon and ignores presses; the label stays so the width does not jump |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | 50% opacity, not focusable |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Stretch to the parent's width |
| `title` | `String?` | | Tooltip text; also the accessible name of icon-only buttons |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name override |
| `isLink` | `bool` | `false` | Announce as a link (Kumo's `LinkButton`) |
| `haptic` | `KumoHaptic` | `none` | Haptic on press |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Variants

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: [
  KumoButton(label: 'Create Worker', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(label: 'Cancel', onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(label: 'Edit', variant: KumoButtonVariant.ghost, onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(label: 'Delete zone', variant: KumoButtonVariant.destructive, onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(label: 'Revoke token', variant: KumoButtonVariant.secondaryDestructive, onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(label: 'Filter', variant: KumoButtonVariant.outline, onPress: () {}),
])
```

### Icon and icon-only

```dart
Row(spacing: 8, children: [
  KumoButton(label: 'Add record', icon: KumoIcons.plus, onPress: () {}),
  KumoButton(
    icon: KumoIcons.copy,
    shape: KumoButtonShape.square,
    title: 'Copy token',
    onPress: () {},
  ),
])
```

### Loading

```dart
KumoButton(label: 'Deploying', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, loading: true, onPress: () {})
```

### Refresh button

`KumoRefreshButton` is a square button whose arrows turn only while `loading` is true.

```dart
KumoRefreshButton(onPress: () {}, loading: false)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a button (or link with `isLink`) with its label and enabled state. Icon-only shapes assert a `semanticLabel` or `title`. Tab focuses, Enter and Space activate, keyboard focus shows the 2px brand ring. On touch the hit area grows to 44x44.

## Motion

- Pointer-down scales the button to 0.98 with a spring; release springs back from wherever it is. Hover colors change instantly. Emphasis buttons lighten their top-lit gradient on hover.
- `loading` cross-fades the icon and the spinner (100ms) and keeps the label. In a label-only button the spinner fades in while the button eases to its new width.
- A new `label` ("Copy" to "Copied") cross-fades and the button eases to its new width (200ms). A keyed `iconWidget` cross-fades the same way; an unkeyed one updates in place.
- Becoming disabled or enabled eases between full and half opacity (100ms).
- `KumoRefreshButton`'s arrows turn only while `loading`, finish the current turn when it ends, and stay still under reduced motion.
- Reduced motion removes the scale, the cross-fades and the width easing.

## Mobile

Visual heights stay Kumo's; the touch hit area is padded to 44px. `block: true` is the usual choice for the main action at the bottom of a phone screen.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` / `child` |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `variant="secondary-destructive"` | `variant: KumoButtonVariant.secondaryDestructive` |
| `size`, `shape`, `loading`, `disabled`, `title` | same names |
| `icon={Plus}` | `icon: KumoIcons.plus` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `LinkButton` | `KumoButton(isLink: true)` |
| `RefreshButton` | `KumoRefreshButton` |

source: doc/components/KumoButtonGroup.md

# KumoButtonGroup

Kumo's `ButtonGroup`: a few tightly coupled buttons joined into one control, most often a split button (an action next to a menu trigger for related actions).

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/button-group

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoButtonGroup(
  semanticLabel: 'Deploy',
  variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary,
  children: [
    KumoButtonGroupButton(label: 'Deploy', onPress: deploy),
    KumoButtonGroupButton(
      icon: KumoIcons.caretDown,
      semanticLabel: 'More deploy options',
      onPress: openDeployMenu,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a split button or two or three actions that act on the same thing. For a row of independent actions, use a toolbar or spaced `KumoButton`s. For choosing between options, use `KumoToggleGroup` or a segmented `KumoRadioGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | `KumoButtonGroupButton`s, possibly wrapped in a tooltip or a menu anchor |
| `size` | `KumoButtonSize` | `base` | Default size of every button; keep them equal |
| `variant` | `KumoButtonVariant` | `secondary` | Default style of every button |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the group for screen readers |

### KumoButtonGroupButton

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | | Button text. Without it the button is square |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading icon, or the only content |
| `endIcon` | `IconData?` | | Trailing icon |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Null renders the button disabled |
| `variant` | `KumoButtonVariant?` | group's | |
| `size` | `KumoButtonSize?` | group's | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner in place of the icon; presses ignored |
| `title` | `String?` | | Tooltip; doubles as the accessible name of icon-only buttons |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Required for icon-only buttons (or `title`) |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |

## Examples

### Split button with a menu

```dart
KumoButtonGroup(
  semanticLabel: 'Save',
  children: [
    KumoButtonGroupButton(label: 'Save', onPress: save),
    KumoAnchoredOverlay(
      open: menuOpen,
      align: KumoAlign.end,
      trapFocus: true,
      onDismiss: () => setState(() => menuOpen = false),
      overlayBuilder: (context, placement) => KumoMenuPanel(
        children: [
          KumoMenuRow(label: 'Save as draft', onPress: saveDraft),
          KumoMenuRow(label: 'Save and publish', onPress: publish),
        ],
      ),
      child: KumoButtonGroupButton(
        icon: KumoIcons.caretDown,
        semanticLabel: 'More save options',
        onPress: () => setState(() => menuOpen = !menuOpen),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Joined actions

```dart
KumoButtonGroup(
  semanticLabel: 'Worker version',
  size: KumoButtonSize.sm,
  children: [
    KumoButtonGroupButton(label: 'Roll back', icon: KumoIcons.arrowCounterClockwise, onPress: rollBack),
    KumoButtonGroupButton(label: 'Promote', onPress: promote),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a labeled container; each button is a separate button with its own Tab stop and Enter/Space activation.
- Icon-only buttons need `semanticLabel` or `title` (asserted).
- Keyboard focus draws the 2px brand ring just inside the button's edge, so the neighbor's seam cannot cover it.

## Motion

Joined buttons do not scale on press: scaling one segment would open gaps at the seams. Press and hover feedback is the instant background change Kumo uses. A loading spinner turns only while `loading` is true.

## Mobile

On touch each button's hit area extends to 44px tall above and below the visual. Square buttons widen to 44px, because joined buttons cannot be padded apart the way single buttons are. A group wider than the screen scrolls sideways instead of overflowing, since Kumo's group keeps its intrinsic width.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (`Button`s) | `children` (`KumoButtonGroupButton`s) |
| child `variant`, `size` | group `variant`, `size`, or per button |
| child `shape="square"` | omit `label` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `className` | not ported |

Deviation: Kumo joins any `Button`. Flutter's `KumoButton` draws fixed rounded corners, so the group uses its own `KumoButtonGroupButton`, which matches `KumoButton`'s variants, sizes and loading state but rounds only the outer corners.

source: doc/components/KumoCalendar.md

# KumoCalendar

The month grid of Kumo's `DatePicker`, for picking one day, a run of days or a set of days, inline on a page or inside your own panel.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/date-picker

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCalendar.single(
  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KumoSpace.s3),
  value: renewal,
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => renewal = day),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `KumoCalendar` when the calendar should stay on screen (a scheduling page, a booking panel) or inside a container you build. For a form field that opens a calendar, use `KumoDatePicker`. For keyboard-first entry of a known date, use `KumoDateInput`.

## Parameters

Three constructors keep the value typed: `KumoCalendar.single`, `KumoCalendar.range` and `KumoCalendar.multiple`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `DateTime?` / `KumoDateRange?` / `List<DateTime>` | `null` / `null` / `const []` | The selection, per constructor. Only the day is used |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<DateTime?>?` / `ValueChanged<KumoDateRange?>?` / `ValueChanged<List<DateTime>>?` | | Called with the next selection. Null makes the days read-only |
| `min` | `int?` | | Range: fewest nights. Multiple: fewest days. Not on `single` |
| `max` | `int?` | | Range: most nights (a longer pick restarts the range). Multiple: most days (the other days become disabled). Not on `single` |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Tapping the only selected day does not clear it |
| `month` | `DateTime?` | | First shown month when the parent controls browsing |
| `initialMonth` | `DateTime?` | | First shown month when `month` is null. Defaults to the selection's month, then today's |
| `onMonthChange` | `ValueChanged<DateTime>?` | | First shown month after a swipe, nav button or keyboard move |
| `numberOfMonths` | `int` | `1` | Side by side when they fit, stacked otherwise |
| `showOutsideDays` | `bool?` | `numberOfMonths == 1` | Days of the adjacent months that fill the first and last week |
| `fixedWeeks` | `bool` | `false` | Always six weeks, so the height never changes |
| `minDate`, `maxDate` | `DateTime?` | | Earliest and latest pickable day; browsing stops at their months |
| `isDateDisabled` | `bool Function(DateTime)?` | | Days that can not be picked |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks every interaction, dims the calendar |
| `today` | `DateTime?` | `clock.now()` | The day marked as today |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Under the months, as wide as the calendar, 12px subtle text |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the selected day (or today) on first build |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `EdgeInsets.zero` | Kumo's calendar has no padding; demos use `p-3` (12px) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the whole calendar |

`KumoDateRange` holds `from` (required) and `to` (null while only the start is picked), with `isComplete`, `nights` and `contains(day)`. Equality compares days only.

## Examples

### Range across two months

```dart
KumoCalendar.range(
  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KumoSpace.s3),
  numberOfMonths: 2,
  value: period,
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => period = range),
)
```

Range taps follow react-day-picker: the first tap picks a one-day range, a later tap after the start moves the end, a tap before the start moves the start.

### Range of 3 to 7 nights from today

```dart
KumoCalendar.range(
  value: stay,
  min: 3,
  max: 7,
  minDate: DateTime.now(),
  footer: const Text('Select 3-7 nights'),
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => stay = range),
)
```

### Multiple days with a limit and unavailable days

```dart
KumoCalendar.multiple(
  value: maintenanceDays,
  max: 5,
  fixedWeeks: true,
  isDateDisabled: (day) => day.weekday == DateTime.saturday || day.weekday == DateTime.sunday,
  footer: Text('${maintenanceDays.length}/5 days selected. Grayed dates are unavailable.'),
  onValueChange: (days) => setState(() => maintenanceDays = days),
)
```

### Controlled month

Pass `month` and `onMonthChange` to move the calendar from outside, for example to the start of a preset range.

```dart
KumoCalendar.range(
  value: period,
  month: shownMonth,
  onMonthChange: (month) => setState(() => shownMonth = month),
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => period = range),
)
```

### Week starting on Monday

Weeks start on `KumoStrings.firstDayOfWeek` (Sunday by default, like Kumo). Month and weekday names come from `KumoStrings` too.

```dart
KumoLocale(
  strings: const KumoStrings(firstDayOfWeek: DateTime.monday),
  child: KumoCalendar.single(value: day, onValueChange: (d) => setState(() => day = d)),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each day is a button announced as `KumoStrings.fullDate` ("Wednesday, March 4, 2026"), with ", Today" for today, and selected and enabled state. Disabled days are announced as disabled.
- The month caption is a header and a live region, so month changes are read out.
- The grid is one Tab stop (the focused, selected, today or first available day), after the previous and next month buttons. Arrow keys move by day and week (left and right flip in RTL), Page Up and Page Down by month, Shift+Page Up and Down by year, Home and End to the start and end of the week, Enter and Space select. Moving past the shown months changes month. Unavailable days are skipped.
- Today is semibold link blue; selected days are filled with `contrast`; disabled and outside days use `text-inactive`.

## Motion

- Changing month with the buttons or keyboard slides the weeks in the direction of travel while the caption fades (Kumo's `rdp-weeks` slide, 200ms ease-out). A jump of several months slides the month left behind out. A press while a slide is still running continues from where the leaving month is, instead of recentering it first.
- On touch, the weeks follow a horizontal swipe 1:1. On release the velocity is projected forward: past half a month width the next or previous month springs in from where the finger left it (with a selection haptic), otherwise the grid springs back. At `minDate` or `maxDate` the grid rubberbands.
- A slide can be grabbed mid-flight.
- Reduced motion: no slide; the new month cross-fades in over 100ms.

## Mobile

- With a touch target size (`KumoTapTargetSize.padded`) day squares grow from 32px to 40px in 44px slots, so each day is a 44x44 target.
- Squares grow with the text scale (up to 1.6x) and shrink to fit narrow widths; several months stack vertically when they do not fit side by side.
- Swipe changes months on touch only; mouse drags select as clicks.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `mode="single" \| "range" \| "multiple"` | `KumoCalendar.single` / `.range` / `.multiple` |
| `selected` | `value` |
| `onChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `required` | `required` |
| `min`, `max` | `min`, `max` |
| `numberOfMonths` | `numberOfMonths` |
| `showOutsideDays` | `showOutsideDays` |
| `fixedWeeks` | `fixedWeeks` |
| `disabled` (matcher) | `isDateDisabled`, `minDate`, `maxDate` |
| `startMonth`, `endMonth` | `minDate`, `maxDate` (months) |
| `month`, `onMonthChange`, `defaultMonth` | `month`, `onMonthChange`, `initialMonth` |
| `today` | `today` |
| `footer` | `footer` |
| `weekStartsOn`, `locale` | `KumoStrings.firstDayOfWeek`, `KumoLocale` |
| `autoFocus` | `autofocus` |
| `className="p-3"` | `padding` |
| `captionLayout="dropdown"` | not ported; use the nav buttons, Page Up/Down or `month` |

source: doc/components/KumoChartColors.md

# KumoChartColors

Kumo's chart palette (`ChartPalette`): categorical colors for series, semantic colors for status data, a sequential scale for density and map fills, each tuned for light and dark mode.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts/colors

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final palette = KumoChartColors.of(context);
final errors = palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.attention);
final third = palette.categorical(2);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use **semantic** colors when the data has polarity: errors, warnings, health. `neutral` is the baseline series (total requests).
- Use **categorical** colors for nominal series with no meaning of their own. Past six series they cycle (`categorical(6)` is blue again); most charts should show the top five and group the rest.
- Use the **sequential** scale for magnitude across a set (heatmaps, choropleths), not to tell series apart.
- Do not use chart colors for UI chrome; use theme tokens (`context.kumo.colors`).
- Color alone never carries meaning: label semantic series and give lines a `KumoTimeseriesLineStyle` when they need telling apart.

## Parameters

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KumoChartColors.light` / `.dark` | `KumoChartColors` | The two palettes |
| `KumoChartColors.of(context)` | `KumoChartColors` | Palette for the nearest `KumoTheme`'s mode |
| `KumoChartColors.forBrightness(b)` | `KumoChartColors` | Palette for a `Brightness` |
| `categorical(int index)` | `Color` | Blue, yellow, pink, purple, teal, orange; wraps with modulo |
| `categoricalColors` | `List<Color>` | The six categorical colors |
| `semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor)` | `Color` | `attention`, `warning`, `success`, `neutral`, `disabled`, `skeleton` |
| `sequential([KumoChartSequentialPalette])` | `List<Color>` | Five steps, low to high (`blues`); reversed in dark mode so high reads brighter |
| `textPrimary` / `textSecondary` | `Color` | Kumo's ECharts label colors, for custom painters |
| `map` | `KumoChartMapColors` | `area` (no-data fill), `bubble`, `scale` (choropleth ramp) |

| Name | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| attention | `#FC574A` | `#FC574A` |
| warning | `#F8A054` | `#F8A054` |
| success | `#00A63E` | `#00A63E` |
| neutral | `#B9D6FF` | `#8EC5FF` |
| disabled | `#CBCBCB` | `#878787` |
| skeleton | `#DDDDDD` | `#5C5C5C` |

## Examples

### Status series

```dart
final palette = KumoChartColors.of(context);
final series = [
  KumoTimeseriesData(name: 'Requests', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.neutral), data: const []),
  KumoTimeseriesData(name: 'Errors', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.attention), data: const []),
];
```

### Matching chart colors outside a chart

```dart
final palette = KumoChartColors.of(context);
final swatch = Container(width: 8, height: 8, color: palette.categorical(0));
```

## Accessibility

The categorical order maximises the perceptual distance between neighbours and was checked by Kumo with a color vision deficiency simulator. Kumo avoids pairing dashed or dotted lines with the lightest colors, since patterns make lines read lighter.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

No changes.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `ChartPalette.categorical(i, isDarkMode)` | `KumoChartColors.of(context).categorical(i)` |
| `ChartPalette.semantic("Attention", isDarkMode)` | `.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.attention)` |
| `ChartPalette.sequential("blues", isDarkMode)` | `.sequential(KumoChartSequentialPalette.blues)` |
| `ChartPalette.text("primary", isDarkMode)` | `.textPrimary` |
| `ChartPalette.mapColors(isDarkMode)` | `.map` |
| `CHART_LIGHT_COLORS` / `CHART_DARK_COLORS` | `KumoChartColors.light.categoricalColors` / `.dark` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoChartLegend.md
---

# KumoChartLegend

A legend item for a chart series: a colored dot, the series name and its value. Kumo's `ChartLegend.SmallItem` and `ChartLegend.LargeItem`.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoChartLegend.small(name: 'Requests', color: KumoChartColors.of(context).categorical(0), value: '1,234')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `small` for multi-series legends under or beside a chart, `large` for headline metrics on a dashboard card. For a plain toggle legend on a `KumoTimeseriesChart`, pass `showLegend: true` instead of building one.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String` | required | Series name |
| `color` | `Color` | required | Dot color, from `KumoChartColors` |
| `value` | `String?` | | Formatted value; required for `large` |
| `unit` | `String?` | | `large` only: unit after the value (`'ms'`) |
| `inactive` | `bool` | `false` | Dot and text at 50% opacity (series hidden or faded) |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the item a focusable toggle button |
| `onHoverChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Pointer enter (true) and leave (false) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | name, value, unit | Announced label |
| `size` (`.loading`) | `KumoChartLegendSize` | `small` | Layout of the placeholder |

Constructors: `KumoChartLegend.small`, `KumoChartLegend.large`, `KumoChartLegend.loading`.

## Examples

### Headline metrics

```dart
final palette = KumoChartColors.of(context);
Wrap(spacing: 16, children: [
  KumoChartLegend.large(name: 'P99', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.attention), value: '124', unit: 'ms'),
  KumoChartLegend.large(name: 'P50', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.neutral), value: '10', unit: 'ms'),
]);
```

### Toggle and highlight a chart's series

```dart
KumoChartLegend.large(
  name: 'P95',
  color: KumoChartColors.of(context).semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.warning),
  value: '76',
  unit: 'ms',
  inactive: hidden.contains('P95'),
  onPress: () => setState(() => hidden.contains('P95') ? hidden.remove('P95') : hidden.add('P95')),
  onHoverChange: (hovering) => setState(() => highlighted = hovering ? 'P95' : null),
)
```

Pass the same `hidden` set to `KumoTimeseriesChart.hiddenSeries` and `highlighted` to `highlightedSeries`.

### Loading

```dart
const Wrap(spacing: 16, children: [KumoChartLegend.loading(), KumoChartLegend.loading()])
```

## Accessibility

Without callbacks the item is a single text node ("P99 124 ms"). With `onPress` it is a focusable button that reports `toggled` (on unless `inactive`); Enter and Space activate. Loading placeholders are hidden from screen readers; announce loading on the chart.

## Motion

Pressable items scale to 0.98 on press. Toggling `inactive` eases the item between full and half opacity (150ms), in step with the series fading in the chart; instant under reduced motion. Hover never animates color. Loading placeholders are static `KumoSkeletonLine` bars.

## Mobile

Pressable items grow their hit area to 44px tall on touch. Below the `md` breakpoint large items drop Kumo's 168px minimum width so two or three fit on a phone row.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `ChartLegend.SmallItem` | `KumoChartLegend.small` |
| `ChartLegend.LargeItem` | `KumoChartLegend.large` |
| `loading` | `KumoChartLegend.loading` |
| `name`, `color`, `value`, `unit`, `inactive` | same |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `onPointerEnter` / `onPointerLeave` | `onHoverChange(true / false)` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoCheckbox.md

# KumoCheckbox

Kumo's `Checkbox`: a 16px box with a label for a single yes or no choice, or the "select all" control above a list (with `indeterminate`).

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/checkbox

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  label: 'Purge cache after deploy',
  checked: purge,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => purge = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a checkbox for a choice that is submitted or saved later, or for selecting items in a list. For a setting that takes effect at once, use `KumoSwitch`. For one choice out of several, use `KumoRadioGroup`. For several related checkboxes under one title, use `KumoCheckboxGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | Controlled value |
| `onCheckedChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Called with the next value. An indeterminate checkbox reports `true`. Null disables the checkbox |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a dash; announced as mixed. Takes precedence over `checked` |
| `label` | `String?` | | Label text, regular weight (medium in cards). Also the accessible name |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label in place of `label` |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the label (13px, subtle) |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error text under the label, announced as a live region. Also switches to the error ring |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon with a tooltip after the label |
| `required` | `bool?` | | `false` shows "(optional)" after the label, as in Kumo |
| `controlFirst` | `bool?` | `true`, `false` for cards | Box before the label, or after it |
| `variant` | `KumoCheckboxVariant` | `base` | `error` draws the red ring without a message |
| `appearance` | `KumoCheckboxAppearance` | `base` | `card`: bordered, 12px padding, tinted while checked |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the box (the whole card for cards) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a visible label |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Select all with indeterminate

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  label: 'All routes',
  checked: selected.length == routes.length,
  indeterminate: selected.isNotEmpty && selected.length < routes.length,
  onCheckedChange: (all) => setState(() => selected = all ? routes.toSet() : <String>{}),
)
```

### Label first

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  label: 'Remember this device',
  controlFirst: false,
  checked: remember,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => remember = value),
)
```

### Error

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  label: 'I understand this deletes the bucket',
  error: confirmed ? null : 'Confirm to continue.',
  checked: confirmed,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => confirmed = value),
)
```

### Card

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  appearance: KumoCheckboxAppearance.card,
  label: 'Bot Fight Mode',
  description: 'Challenge requests that match known bot patterns.',
  checked: botFight,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => botFight = value),
)
```

### Row selection without a visible label

```dart
KumoCheckbox(
  semanticLabel: 'Select image-resizer',
  checked: isSelected,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => toggleRow('image-resizer', value),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Announced as a checkbox (not a button) with its checked, unchecked or mixed state; the label is the accessible name. Without a label, pass `semanticLabel`.
- Tab focuses the checkbox; Space or Enter toggles it. Keyboard focus draws Kumo's 2px brand ring on the box.
- `error` text is a live region, and the red ring is always paired with text.

## Motion

The check mark (or dash) scales in from 0.6 with Kumo's `--ease-bounce` curve (`KumoCurves.bounce`) over 150ms, a small overshoot as it lands. Unchecking removes the mark at once, as Kumo's indicator does. The whole row is the hit area; on pointer-down the box itself presses in to 0.9 with a press spring and springs back on release, from wherever it is. Under reduced motion the mark appears without animation and the box does not scale.

## Mobile

The box stays 16px. The whole row (box and label) is the hit area and is padded to at least 44px tall on touch platforms; a checkbox without a label gets a 44x44 hit area. Labels wrap; there is no fixed height, so 2x text does not clip.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` |
| `onCheckedChange` | `onCheckedChange` |
| `label` | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `labelTooltip` | `labelTooltip` |
| `controlFirst` | `controlFirst` |
| `variant="error"` | `variant: KumoCheckboxVariant.error` (or `error`) |
| `appearance="card"` (items) | `appearance: KumoCheckboxAppearance.card` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `required={false}` | `required: false` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `name` | not ported (no HTML forms) |

`description` and `error` on a single checkbox are port additions; Kumo shows them only on groups and card items.

---
source: doc/components/KumoCheckboxGroup.md
---

# KumoCheckboxGroup

Kumo's `Checkbox.Group`: a legend over a set of checkboxes, with an error and a description below, controlled with the list of checked values.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/checkbox

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCheckboxGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Email alerts',
  description: 'Sent to the account owner.',
  value: alerts,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => alerts = next),
  items: const [
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'deploys', label: 'Failed deployments'),
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'usage', label: 'Usage limits'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a group for several independent yes or no choices that belong together. For one choice out of several, use `KumoRadioGroup`. For a single checkbox, use `KumoCheckbox`. Use `appearance: KumoCheckboxAppearance.card` when each option needs a description.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoCheckboxGroupItem<T>>` | required | The options |
| `value` | `List<T>` | required | The checked values |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | | Next list; a newly checked value is appended. Null disables the group |
| `legend` | `String?` | | Group title (14px medium) |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Keep the legend for screen readers only |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the items |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error under the items (announced). Items switch to the error ring |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every item |
| `orientation` | `Axis` | `vertical` | `horizontal` wraps items in rows; card groups become a two-column grid |
| `appearance` | `KumoCheckboxAppearance` | `base` | `card` joins items into one bordered surface |
| `controlFirst` | `bool?` | `true`, `false` for cards | Box before the label |

### KumoCheckboxGroupItem

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | required | |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the label |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `variant` | `KumoCheckboxVariant?` | group's | Overrides the error ring for this item |
| `appearance` | `KumoCheckboxAppearance?` | group's | Overrides the group's appearance |

## Examples

### Validation

```dart
KumoCheckboxGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Email alerts',
  error: alerts.isEmpty ? 'Choose at least one alert.' : null,
  value: alerts,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => alerts = next),
  items: const [
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'deploys', label: 'Failed deployments'),
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'tokens', label: 'Expiring API tokens'),
  ],
)
```

### Horizontal

```dart
KumoCheckboxGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Cached methods',
  orientation: Axis.horizontal,
  value: methods,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => methods = next),
  items: const [
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'GET', label: 'GET'),
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'HEAD', label: 'HEAD'),
  ],
)
```

### Card grid

```dart
KumoCheckboxGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Where should this profile scan?',
  appearance: KumoCheckboxAppearance.card,
  orientation: Axis.horizontal,
  value: targets,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => targets = next),
  items: const [
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'web', label: 'Web traffic', description: 'Gateway HTTP policies.'),
    KumoCheckboxGroupItem(value: 'mail', label: 'Outbound email', description: 'Email leaving your organization.'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each item is a checkbox with its own Tab stop; Space toggles it.
- The legend is read before the items. With `hideLegend` it is not drawn but stays in the semantics tree.
- The error is a live region and is always text, never color alone.

## Motion

Items use `KumoCheckbox`'s motion: the box presses in on pointer-down, and the check mark scales in over 150ms on `KumoCurves.bounce`. Both are static under reduced motion.

## Mobile

On touch every row is padded to a 44px hit area, so single-line rows drop Kumo's 8px gap (the padding already separates them); rows with descriptions keep it. Horizontal card groups keep two columns at 390px and their text wraps.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `legend` / `Checkbox.Legend` | `legend` |
| `Checkbox.Legend className="sr-only"` | `hideLegend: true` |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `value` (controlled only) |
| `onValueChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `error`, `description` | `error`, `description` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `orientation` | `orientation` (`Axis`) |
| `appearance` | `appearance` |
| `controlFirst` | `controlFirst` |
| `Checkbox.Item` | `KumoCheckboxGroupItem` |
| `allValues` (parent checkbox) | not ported; build it with `KumoCheckbox(indeterminate: ...)` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoClipboardText.md

# KumoClipboardText

Kumo's `ClipboardText`: a read-only, input-like field holding a value with a copy button at its end.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/clipboard-text

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoClipboardText(text: '023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for values people copy into another tool: account and zone IDs, API tokens, install commands. For a short ID inside text or a table cell, use `KumoInlineCopyText`. For multi-line code, use `KumoCodeHighlighted` with `showCopyButton`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required | Shown, and copied unless `textToCopy` is set |
| `textToCopy` | `String?` | | Copied in place of `text` |
| `masked` | `bool` | `false` | Shows dots and a reveal button |
| `size` | `KumoClipboardTextSize` | `lg` | `sm` 26px (12px mono), `base` 36px, `lg` 40px (13px mono) |
| `block` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the parent's width |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | | After a successful copy |
| `tooltip` | `KumoClipboardTextTooltip?` | | Tooltip mode: `text`, `copiedText`, `side` |
| `copyLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copy` | Copy button name |
| `revealLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.show` | Reveal button name |
| `hideLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.hide` | Hide button name |

## Examples

### Masked token

```dart
const KumoClipboardText(text: 'cf_sample_7Hq2xK9mZpL4', masked: true, block: true)
```

### Shortened value, full copy

```dart
const KumoClipboardText(text: 'cf_sample_7Hq2...', textToCopy: 'cf_sample_7Hq2xK9mZpL4')
```

### Tooltip mode

```dart
const KumoClipboardText(
  text: 'npx wrangler deploy',
  tooltip: KumoClipboardTextTooltip(text: 'Copy command', copiedText: 'Command copied'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The copy button is named by `copyLabel`; the reveal button is a toggle (`toggled` state, like `aria-pressed`) named "Show" or "Hide".
- After a copy, the copied text (`tooltip.copiedText` or `KumoStrings.copied`) is announced. If the clipboard write fails, a warning icon replaces the check and `KumoStrings.copyFailed` is announced.

## Motion

On copy the copy icon slides up and out while a check slides in (200ms), then they swap back after 1.5 seconds. Each copy kicks a spring that swells the check (or the tooltip-mode bubble) about 4% and settles, so a repeat press still visibly lands. Revealing or hiding a masked value cross-fades the value and the eye icon and eases the field's width. Reduced motion swaps everything instantly with no bump.

## Mobile

On touch screens the field is at least 44px tall and the buttons at least 44px wide. Long values truncate with an ellipsis; the copy button never moves off screen.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | `text` |
| `textToCopy` | `textToCopy` |
| `masked` | `masked` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `onCopy` | `onCopy` |
| `tooltip` (`text`, `copiedText`, `side`) | `tooltip: KumoClipboardTextTooltip(...)` |
| `labels.copyAction` / `revealAction` / `hideAction` | `copyLabel` / `revealLabel` / `hideLabel` |
| `className="w-full"` | `block: true` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoCode.md

# KumoCode

Kumo's `Code` and `Code.Block`: monospace code without syntax colors, in `text-kumo-subtle` at 13px on 20px lines.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/code-highlighted

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoCode(code: 'npx wrangler deploy')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `KumoCode` for short commands and output where color adds nothing, and `KumoCode.block` to set them off in a bordered block. Kumo deprecates `Code` in favor of `CodeHighlighted`; prefer `KumoCodeHighlighted` for source code.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `String` | required | |
| `lang` | `String?` | | Hint only; `KumoCode` never colors |
| `values` | `Map<String, KumoCodeValue>?` | | Fills `{{key}}` placeholders; the copy button copies the filled text |
| `variant` | `KumoCodeVariant` | `plain` (`KumoCode`), `standard` (`KumoCode.block`) | Block: `bg-kumo-base`, `kumo-fill` border, `rounded-md`, 10px padding |
| `showLineNumbers` | `bool` | `false` | Never shown for single-line code |
| `highlightLines` | `List<int>` | `[]` | 1-based lines to tint |
| `showCopyButton` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `wrap` | `bool` | `false` | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | | Scroll vertically past this height |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | | After a successful copy |

`KumoCodeValue(value, highlight: false)`: a highlighted value is set in medium weight `text-kumo-strong` so the part to replace stands out.

## Examples

### Block with a copy button

```dart
const KumoCode.block(code: 'npm create cloudflare@latest -- image-resizer', showCopyButton: true)
```

### Template values

```dart
const KumoCode.block(
  code: 'export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN={{token}}',
  values: {'token': KumoCodeValue('your-api-token', highlight: true)},
  showCopyButton: true,
)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `KumoCodeHighlighted`: line numbers are hidden from screen readers, the copy button is reachable with Tab and announces "Copied" or the failure copy.

## Motion

The copy button fades in on hover and bumps on each copy; its label cross-fades from "Copy" to "Copied" and back while the button eases to its new width. Reduced motion turns all of it off.

## Mobile

Long lines scroll sideways with an edge fade, or wrap with `wrap: true`. The copy button is always visible on touch screens.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Code code lang>` | `KumoCode(code:, lang:)` |
| `<Code.Block>` / `<CodeBlock>` | `KumoCode.block(...)` |
| `values` (`{ value, highlight }`) | `values` (`KumoCodeValue`) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoCodeHighlighted.md
---

# KumoCodeHighlighted

Kumo's `CodeHighlighted`: a syntax-colored code block with optional line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/code-highlighted

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoCodeHighlighted(code: 'npx wrangler deploy', lang: 'sh', showCopyButton: true)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for snippets people read or copy: a Worker's handler, a `wrangler.toml`, a shell command. For a short inline value use `KumoInlineCopyText`; for a value in an input-like field use `KumoClipboardText`; for code without colors use `KumoCode`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `String` | required | Source text |
| `lang` | `String` | required | Language or alias, see below. Unknown languages render plain |
| `variant` | `KumoCodeVariant` | `standard` | `standard`: `bg-kumo-base`, 1px `kumo-fill` border, `rounded-md`, 16px padding. `plain`: no frame |
| `showLineNumbers` | `bool` | `false` | Never shown for single-line code |
| `highlightLines` | `List<int>` | `[]` | 1-based lines to tint |
| `showCopyButton` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `copyLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copy` | |
| `copiedLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copied` | Shown and announced after copying |
| `wrap` | `bool` | `false` | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | | Scroll vertically past this height |
| `colors` | `KumoCodeColors?` | `KumoCodeColors.of(theme)` | Token palette |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | | After a successful copy |

Languages (aliases in brackets): `javascript` [js, mjs, cjs], `jsx`, `typescript` [ts, mts, cts], `tsx`, `json`, `jsonc` [json5], `bash` [sh, shell, zsh, console], `toml`, `yaml` [yml], `html` [xml, svg], `css` [scss], `dart`, `python` [py], `sql`, `diff` [patch], `hcl` [tf, terraform].

## Examples

### Line numbers and highlighted lines

```dart
const KumoCodeHighlighted(
  code: 'export default {\n  async fetch(request) {\n    return new Response("Hello");\n  },\n};',
  lang: 'ts',
  showLineNumbers: true,
  highlightLines: [3],
  showCopyButton: true,
)
```

### Wrapping long commands

```dart
const KumoCodeHighlighted(
  code: 'curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/ZONE_ID/purge_cache" --data \'{"purge_everything":true}\'',
  lang: 'bash',
  wrap: true,
)
```

### Tokens directly

The tokenizer is public, for custom renderers or tests.

```dart
final tokens = KumoCodeHighlighter.tokenize('name = "image-resizer"', 'toml');
final keyColor = KumoCodeColors.of(context.kumo).of(KumoCodeTokenType.property);
```

## Accessibility

- Line numbers are hidden from screen readers (Kumo's `aria-hidden`).
- The copy button is a regular `KumoButton`: Tab reaches it even while it is visually hidden, and focusing it reveals it. After copying, "Copied" is announced; a failed write shows and announces `KumoStrings.copyFailed`.
- Every token color keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast on `bg-kumo-base` in light and dark (tested).
- Wrap a page in Flutter's `SelectionArea` to let readers select code.

## Motion

The copy button fades in on hover (150ms, instant under reduced motion). The label swaps to "Copied" with a small spring bump on every copy, and returns after 2 seconds.

## Mobile

Long lines scroll sideways inside the block, with a fade on the edge that hides content and a thin scrollbar while scrolling; line numbers stay put. On touch screens, which have no hover, the copy button is always visible.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `code` | `code` |
| `lang` | `lang` |
| `showLineNumbers` | `showLineNumbers` |
| `highlightLines` | `highlightLines` |
| `showCopyButton` | `showCopyButton` |
| `labels.copy` / `labels.copied` | `copyLabel` / `copiedLabel` |
| `variant="plain"` | `variant: KumoCodeVariant.plain` |
| `ShikiProvider` | not needed: highlighting is built in, with no dependencies |
| Shiki themes `github-light` / `vesper` | `KumoCodeColors`, derived from Kumo text tokens |

---
source: doc/components/KumoCollapsible.md

# KumoCollapsible

A trigger that shows and hides a panel, for optional detail (advanced settings, an explanation) that most people skip.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/collapsible

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCollapsible(
  open: open,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  label: 'Advanced settings',
  child: const KumoText('Compatibility date, usage model and placement.'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for one block of secondary content. For a list of sections where you want one open at a time, use `KumoAccordion`. Do not hide required form fields in it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Changes animate |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | required | Next open state |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Panel content |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text of the default trigger (required unless `triggerBuilder`) |
| `triggerBuilder` | `KumoCollapsibleTriggerBuilder?` | | `(context, open, toggle) => Widget` |
| `panelStyle` | `KumoCollapsiblePanelStyle` | `accent` | `accent`: 2px `fill` rule on the start edge, 16px inset; `plain`: as given |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `keepMounted` | `bool` | `false` | Keep closed content alive (form fields keep their text) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the default trigger |

Building blocks, also public:

- `KumoCollapsibleTrigger(label:, open:, onPress:, disabled:, semanticLabel:)`: Kumo's `DefaultTrigger`, medium 14px text and a 12px caret that turns while open.
- `KumoCollapsiblePanel(open:, child:, keepMounted:, duration:, fade:)`: Kumo's `Panel`, the animated clip. Use it for your own disclosure layouts.
- `KumoDisclosureCaret(open:, size: 16, color:, icon: KumoIcons.caretDown, turns: 0.5, duration: KumoDurations.moderate)`: the caret, on the same clock as the panel. Put it in custom triggers so it turns in step with the height.

```dart
KumoPressable(
  onPress: () => setState(() => open = !open),
  expanded: open,
  child: Row(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    spacing: KumoSpace.s1,
    children: [const KumoText('Routes'), KumoDisclosureCaret(open: open, size: 12)],
  ),
)
```

## Examples

### Custom trigger

```dart
KumoCollapsible(
  open: open,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  panelStyle: KumoCollapsiblePanelStyle.plain,
  triggerBuilder: (context, open, toggle) => KumoButton(
    label: open ? 'Hide bindings' : 'Show bindings',
    size: KumoButtonSize.sm,
    onPress: toggle,
  ),
  child: const KumoText('R2 bucket assets, KV namespace sessions'),
)
```

### Panel only

```dart
KumoCollapsiblePanel(open: showLogs, child: const KumoText('No errors in the last hour'))
```

## Accessibility

The default trigger is a button with an expanded state; Enter and Space toggle. While closed (and while closing) the panel's content is out of the focus order and hidden from screen readers, also with `keepMounted`. A custom trigger should set its own expanded semantics, for example with `KumoPressable(expanded: open)`.

## Motion

The height animates over 200ms (`KumoDurations.moderate`, standard curve) with a fade, while the content is laid out at full height and clipped, so text never reflows mid-animation. Toggling mid-animation reverses from the current height. The caret is a `KumoDisclosureCaret`: it runs on the same clock as the panel, so it turns in step with the height, including when reversed mid-flight. Reduced motion opens, closes and turns instantly.

## Mobile

The trigger's hit area is 44px tall on touch. Content keeps its natural height at 2x text.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `Collapsible.Root open / onOpenChange` | `open` / `onOpenChange` |
| `Collapsible.DefaultTrigger` children | `label` |
| `Collapsible.Trigger render` | `triggerBuilder` |
| `Collapsible.DefaultPanel` | `panelStyle: accent` |
| `Collapsible.Panel` | `panelStyle: plain`, or `KumoCollapsiblePanel` |
| `keepMounted` | `keepMounted` |
| `defaultOpen` | not ported (controlled only) |

Kumo's panel transition is 100ms; this port uses the package's 200ms expand duration, which reads better on taller mobile content.

---
source: doc/components/KumoCombobox.md
---

# KumoCombobox

A text field that filters a list of options as you type, for one value or several shown as chips. Reach for it when the list is long enough that searching beats scrolling.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/combobox

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCombobox<String>(
  label: 'Database',
  placeholder: 'Search databases',
  value: database,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => database = v),
  options: const [
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'd1', label: 'D1'),
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'hyperdrive', label: 'Hyperdrive'),
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'kv', label: 'Workers KV'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it when the value must come from the list and the list is long or the user knows the name.
- When any typed text is valid, use `KumoAutocomplete`. For a short list, `KumoSelect` is quicker.
- For free-form values collected as chips (emails, labels), use `KumoTagInput`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<KumoSelectItem<T>>` | required | Options, groups and separators. Groups get a hairline between them |
| `value` | `T?` | `null` | Chosen value (single). The field shows its label |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | | Picked value, or null from the clear button |
| `values` | `List<T>` | required in `.multiple` | Chosen values, shown as chips |
| `onValuesChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | | `.multiple` only |
| `inputSide` | `KumoComboboxInputSide` | `right` | `.multiple` only: input after the chips, or `top` above them |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | `xs` 20, `sm` 26, `base` 36, `lg` 40 px |
| `label`, `description`, `error`, `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Field parts, as in `KumoField` |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Input placeholder (hidden behind inline chips) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | A loading row at the top of the list; hides the empty state |
| `filter` | `KumoOptionFilter<T>?` | `kumoContainsFilter` | `(option, query) => bool`. Pass `(o, q) => true` for server-filtered options |
| `emptyMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.noResults` | Shown when nothing matches |
| `loadingMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.loading` | |
| `onInputValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Text as typed, for fetching options |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | Flips above when the keyboard or the screen edge leaves too little room |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `4` | |
| `maxHeight` | `double` | `384` | Kumo's 24rem cap |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a visible label |
| `clearLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.clear` | Single: the clear button's name |
| `showOptionsLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.showOptions` | Single: the caret button's name |
| `removeLabel` | `String Function(String)?` | `KumoStrings.removeItem` | Multiple: a chip's remove button name |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Multiple with chips

```dart
KumoCombobox<String>.multiple(
  label: 'Allowed crawlers',
  placeholder: 'Add a crawler',
  values: bots,
  onValuesChange: (v) => setState(() => bots = v),
  options: KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(['Googlebot', 'Bingbot', 'Applebot', 'DuckDuckBot']),
)
```

### Server search

```dart
KumoCombobox<String>(
  label: 'R2 bucket',
  placeholder: 'Search buckets',
  options: results,
  filter: (option, query) => true,
  loading: searching,
  onInputValueChange: (q) => searchBuckets(q),
  value: bucket,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => bucket = v),
)
```

### Custom filter

```dart
KumoCombobox<String>(
  label: 'Region code',
  options: const [
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'enam', label: 'Eastern North America', keywords: ['us-east']),
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'weur', label: 'Western Europe', keywords: ['eu-west']),
  ],
  filter: (option, query) => option.value.startsWith(query.toLowerCase()),
  value: region,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => region = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The input is a labelled text field with an expanded state while the list shows.
- Focus stays in the input. Down and Up open the list and move the highlight (skipping disabled options); Enter picks; Escape closes and restores the chosen label; Tab closes and moves on.
- Typing highlights the first match, so Enter picks it.
- Multiple: each chip's X is a button named "Remove <label>"; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip.
- "No results" and the loading row are live regions.

## Motion

The list scales in from the field and fades with Kumo's popup spring; reduced motion leaves only the fade. In multiple mode a picked chip grows in from zero width and fades in over 150ms; a removed chip shrinks and fades the way it came while the chips after it slide over, and the gap before it closes with it. A chip removed and picked again mid-exit turns around from where it is. The up-down caret is symmetric and does not rotate. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once. Under reduced motion chips appear and leave at once.

## Mobile

The list stays anchored to the field on phones (a sheet would hide the text being typed) and opens above the field when the on-screen keyboard covers the room below. Chip remove buttons and the clear button get touch targets up to 44px wide without changing the 36px field. Backspace on an empty input is a hardware-keyboard gesture; touch users remove chips with their X.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop / part | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` + `Combobox.Item` | `options` |
| `Combobox.Group` + `GroupLabel` | `KumoSelectGroup` |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `multiple` + `TriggerMultipleWithInput` + `Chip` | `KumoCombobox.multiple(values:, onValuesChange:)` |
| `inputSide` | `inputSide` |
| `Combobox.TriggerInput` (clear and caret buttons) | the single-value field |
| `Combobox.Empty` | `emptyMessage` |
| `useFilter` / `filter` | `filter` |
| `onInputValueChange` | `onInputValueChange` |
| `size`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `labelTooltip`, `required` | same names |
| `clearLabel`, `showOptionsLabel`, `removeLabel` | same names |
| `Combobox.TriggerValue` + `Combobox.Input` (search inside the popup) | not ported; use `KumoSelect` or the single field |

# KumoCommandPalette

A searchable list of commands, opened with Cmd+K or Ctrl+K. Reach for it to let keyboard users jump to any page or action without the navigation.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/command-palette

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoCommandPaletteShortcut(
  onTrigger: () => showKumoCommandPalette(
    context: context,
    placeholder: 'Type a command or search',
    groups: [
      KumoCommandGroup(label: 'Workers', items: [
        KumoCommandItem(title: 'Deploy image-resizer', icon: KumoIcons.rocket, onSelect: () => deploy()),
        KumoCommandItem(title: 'Create Worker', icon: KumoIcons.plus, shortcut: 'N', onSelect: () => create()),
      ]),
    ],
  ),
  child: const DashboardPage(),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it as a global shortcut layer over an app with many pages and actions.
- It is not a replacement for visible navigation or buttons; every command should also be reachable without it.
- For searching one list in a form, use `KumoCombobox`.

## API

### `showKumoCommandPalette`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `BuildContext` | required | |
| `groups` | `List<KumoCommandGroup>` | required | Local commands, filtered as you type |
| `onSearch` | `KumoCommandSearch?` | | `(query) async => groups` shown after the local results, with loading and error rows |
| `filter` | `bool Function(KumoCommandItem, String)?` | built in | Replaces the built-in matching; `KumoCommandPalette.noFilter` keeps everything |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Search field placeholder; also the dialog's name |
| `emptyMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.noResults` | |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Key hints; dialog only |
| `onSelect` | `void Function(KumoCommandItem, {required bool newTab})?` | | After the item's own `onSelect` |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Dialog on wide screens, full-height sheet below 768px |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `placeholder` | |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

Returns `Future<KumoCommandItem?>`: the command that ran, or null when dismissed. Only one palette opens at a time.

### `KumoCommandPalette` (the panel)

Same content parameters (`groups`, `onSearch`, `filter`, `placeholder`, `emptyMessage`, `footer`, `onSelect`) plus:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows `KumoCommandPaletteLoading` in place of results |
| `searchErrorMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.searchFailed` | Shown when `onSearch` throws |
| `onClose` | `ValueChanged<KumoCommandItem?>?` | | The panel asks to close: with the command that ran, or null on Escape |
| `onQueryChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `initialQuery` | `String` | `''` | |
| `inputLeading` / `inputTrailing` | `Widget?` | | Replace the search icon (a back button) / add to the search row |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `expand` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the height (full-height sheets) |

### Data

| Type | Parameters |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoCommandGroup` | `label` (optional), `items` |
| `KumoCommandItem` | `title`, `id`, `icon`, `description`, `breadcrumbs`, `shortcut`, `keywords`, `external`, `disabled`, `showArrow = true`, `onSelect`, `value` |

### Parts

| Widget | Kumo part |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoCommandPaletteInput` | `CommandPalette.Input` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteGroupLabel` | `CommandPalette.GroupLabel` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteItem` | `CommandPalette.Item` / `ResultItem` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteHighlightedText` | `CommandPalette.HighlightedText` (`highlights`: inclusive `(start, end)` records) |
| `KumoCommandPaletteEmpty` | `CommandPalette.Empty` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteLoading` | `CommandPalette.Loading` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteFooter` | `CommandPalette.Footer` |
| `KumoCommandPaletteKeyHint`, `KumoCommandPaletteKbd` | the footer's `kbd` hints |
| `KumoCommandPaletteShortcut` | Cmd/Ctrl+K listener; `KumoCommandPaletteShortcut.label()` gives "⌘K" or "Ctrl K" |

## Examples

### Footer hints

```dart
showKumoCommandPalette(
  context: context,
  groups: commands,
  footer: const KumoCommandPaletteFooter(children: [
    KumoCommandPaletteKeyHint(label: 'Navigate', keys: ['Up', 'Down'], icons: [KumoIcons.arrowUp, KumoIcons.arrowDown]),
    KumoCommandPaletteKeyHint(label: 'Run', keys: ['Enter'], icons: [KumoIcons.arrowElbowDownLeft]),
    KumoCommandPaletteKeyHint(label: 'Close', keys: ['Esc']),
  ]),
);
```

### Remote results

```dart
showKumoCommandPalette(
  context: context,
  groups: commands,
  onSearch: (query) async {
    final buckets = await api.searchBuckets(query);
    return [
      KumoCommandGroup(label: 'R2 buckets', items: [
        for (final b in buckets) KumoCommandItem(title: b, breadcrumbs: const ['R2'], icon: KumoIcons.archive),
      ]),
    ];
  },
);
```

### Embedded panel

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 360,
  child: KumoCommandPalette(autofocus: false, placeholder: 'Filter commands', groups: commands),
)
```

## Matching

Every word typed must appear in the title, breadcrumbs, description or keywords; a word of three letters or more may also match the title's letters in order ("dpl" finds "Deploy"). Within a group, titles that start with the query come first, then word starts, then other matches; matched letters are marked with `bg-kumo-warning/50`. Groups keep their order and empty groups disappear. Remote results are shown as returned.

## Accessibility

- The search field takes focus when the palette opens and keeps it: Up and Down move the highlight (wrapping, skipping disabled commands), Enter runs, Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter elsewhere) runs with `newTab: true`, Escape closes. Focus returns to where it was.
- Rows are buttons named by breadcrumbs and title, with the description as a hint; the highlighted row is announced as selected; `external` rows are links.
- Empty, loading and error states are live regions; the error has an icon as well as color.

## Motion

The dialog fades and scales from 0.9 (Kumo's 150ms dialog motion); reduced motion keeps a short fade. While filtering, rows are reused in place so they never flash, and the panel's height follows the results over 150ms instead of jumping. The keyboard highlight and its arrow fade between rows over 100ms (Kumo's `transition-colors`); the pointer's own hover shows at once. Loading, empty, error and results states fade in when they swap. The sheet follows the finger and dismisses with a downward flick. Under reduced motion the height, highlight and swaps change at once.

## Mobile

Below 768px the palette is a full-height sheet with a Cancel button beside the search field and no footer (key hints mean little on a touch keyboard). The results area sits above the on-screen keyboard. Rows are 44px tall on touch platforms.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop / part | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `CommandPalette.Root open/onOpenChange` | `showKumoCommandPalette` (route) |
| `CommandPalette.Dialog` + `Panel` | `KumoDialogRoute` + `KumoCommandPalette` |
| `items` + `Results` / `Items` render props | `groups: [KumoCommandGroup(...)]` |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `initialQuery`, `onQueryChange` |
| `filter` (pass-through default) | `filter` (built-in matching by default; `KumoCommandPalette.noFilter` for Kumo's default) |
| `onSelect(item, {newTab})` | `onSelect(item, newTab:)` and `KumoCommandItem.onSelect` |
| `ResultItem` `title`, `breadcrumbs`, `titleHighlights`, `description`, `icon`, `external`, `showArrow` | `KumoCommandItem` fields; highlights are computed |
| `Input leading/trailing` | `inputLeading`, `inputTrailing` |
| `Empty`, `Loading`, `Footer` | `emptyMessage`, `loading`, `footer` |
| `getSelectableItems`, `itemToStringValue`, `onItemHighlighted` | not needed |

source: doc/components/KumoContextMenu.md
