# KumoContextMenu

A menu that opens where the user right-clicks a widget, or long-presses it on touch screens. It takes the same items as `KumoDropdownMenu`.

Kumo reference: none (Kumo has no context menu; the behavior follows shadcn's `ContextMenu`). Items match https://kumo-ui.com/components/dropdown

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoContextMenu(
  items: [
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Copy record ID', icon: KumoIcons.copy, onPress: copyId),
    const KumoDropdownSeparator(),
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Delete record', icon: KumoIcons.trash, destructive: true, onPress: deleteRecord),
  ],
  child: const KumoText('A  example.com  192.0.2.1'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it as a shortcut for actions on a row, file or canvas object.
- Context menus are hard to discover: every action in one must also be reachable from a visible control, such as a row's overflow `KumoDropdownMenu`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The area that responds to right click and long press. Its own taps keep working |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | required | `KumoDropdownItem`, `KumoDropdownSubmenu` and the other dropdown items |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Bottom sheet below 768px |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Ignores right click, long press and keys |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the menu |
| `sheetTitle` | `String?` | | Heading of the sheet presentation |
| `backLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.back` | Back row of sheet submenus |

## Examples

### Nested actions

```dart
KumoContextMenu(
  sheetTitle: 'example.com',
  items: [
    KumoDropdownSubmenu(
      label: 'Change TTL',
      icon: KumoIcons.clock,
      children: [
        KumoDropdownItem(label: '5 minutes', onPress: () => setTtl(300)),
        KumoDropdownItem(label: '1 hour', onPress: () => setTtl(3600)),
      ],
    ),
  ],
  child: const KumoText('example.com'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Keyboard: with focus anywhere inside `child`, the Menu key or Shift+F10 opens the menu at the center of `child`. Inside, the keys work as in `KumoDropdownMenu`; Escape closes it.
- Screen readers have no right click: put the same actions on a visible button.

## Motion

Opens with its corner at the pointer and scales from there with `KumoAnchoredOverlay`'s spring; flips above or to the side near screen edges. Right-clicking elsewhere on `child` while it is open moves it to the new point. A long press fires a medium haptic.

## Mobile

On touch, a long press opens it. Below 768px it opens as a bottom sheet with the same items (submenus push in place). On the web, call `BrowserContextMenu.disableContextMenu()` once at startup so the browser's own menu does not cover it.

## Kumo React mapping

| shadcn prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `ContextMenu onOpenChange` | `onOpenChange` |
| `ContextMenuTrigger` children | `child` |
| `ContextMenuContent` items | `items` (Kumo dropdown items) |
| `ContextMenuTrigger disabled` | `disabled` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoDateInput.md
---

# KumoDateInput

Typed date entry with validation and a calendar button. Separators are inserted as you type, impossible or unavailable days show an inline error, and the button opens a `KumoCalendar`.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input (field styling) and https://kumo-ui.com/components/date-picker (calendar)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoDateInput(
  label: 'API token expires on',
  value: expiry,
  minDate: DateTime.now(),
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => expiry = day),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when people usually know the date (a birth date, an expiry from a contract) and typing is faster than browsing. Use `KumoDatePicker` when browsing a calendar is the common path, and for ranges.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `DateTime?` | | The day shown whenever the field is not being edited |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<DateTime?>?` | | A complete, real, allowed day, or `null` when the text is cleared |
| `format` | `KumoDateInputFormat` | `iso` | `iso` `YYYY-MM-DD`, `mdy` `MM/DD/YYYY`, `dmy` `DD/MM/YYYY` |
| `label`, `description` | `String?` | | Rendered through `KumoField` |
| `error` | `String?` | | Parent error; wins over the built-in messages |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | the format pattern | |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `minDate`, `maxDate`, `isDateDisabled` | | | Allowed days, for typing and the calendar |
| `showCalendarButton` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Calendar in a popover, or a bottom sheet below 768px |
| `invalidDateMessage` | `String?` | `'Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD.'` (pattern of `format`) | For text that is not a real date |
| `unavailableDateMessage` | `String` | `'This date is not available. Pick another day.'` | For a real day outside the allowed days |
| `calendarButtonLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.chooseDateFromCalendar` | Accessible name of the button |
| `autofocus`, `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a `label` |

`KumoDateInputFormat` also exposes `format(DateTime)`, `parse(String)` (null for incomplete text or days like February 30) and `pattern`.

## Examples

### Month-first, weekdays only

```dart
KumoDateInput(
  label: 'Launch date',
  format: KumoDateInputFormat.mdy,
  value: launch,
  isDateDisabled: (day) => day.weekday == DateTime.saturday || day.weekday == DateTime.sunday,
  unavailableDateMessage: 'Launches happen on weekdays. Pick Monday to Friday.',
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => launch = day),
)
```

### Without the calendar button

```dart
KumoDateInput(
  label: 'Date of incident',
  showCalendarButton: false,
  value: incident,
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => incident = day),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The text field is named by the label; the calendar button is a separate button with `calendarButtonLabel` and expanded state.
- Alt+Down opens the calendar from the field; focus moves to the selected day, Escape closes and returns focus.
- Errors appear once the text is complete, or on leaving the field or submitting while incomplete, and are announced by `KumoField` (a live region with a warning icon, not only red).

## Motion

The calendar popover and sheet animate as in `KumoDatePicker`; the field itself changes instantly. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once. A date error that appears while typing never takes focus away from the field.

## Mobile

- The field opens the date-time keyboard; only digits are kept.
- Below 768px the calendar opens in a bottom sheet and picking a day closes it.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no typed date field; it combines Kumo's `Input` chrome with the `DatePicker` calendar.

| Kumo | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Input` `size`, `error`, `disabled`, `placeholder` | `size`, `error`, `disabled`, `placeholder` |
| `Field` `label`, `description` | `label`, `description` |
| `DatePicker` `disabled` matcher | `isDateDisabled`, `minDate`, `maxDate` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoDatePicker.md
---

# KumoDatePicker

A date field that opens a `KumoCalendar`: Kumo's `DatePicker` composed with a `Popover`, as the Kumo docs show it, for single days, ranges with presets and sets of days.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/date-picker

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoDatePicker.single(
  label: 'Certificate expiry',
  value: expiry,
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => expiry = day),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it in forms and filters where a date is one field among others. Use `KumoCalendar` when the calendar should stay visible, and `KumoDateInput` when people usually know the date and type it.

## Parameters

Three constructors: `KumoDatePicker.single`, `KumoDatePicker.range` and `KumoDatePicker.multiple`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `DateTime?` / `KumoDateRange?` / `List<DateTime>` | `null` / `null` / `const []` | The selection, per constructor |
| `onValueChange` | matching `ValueChanged` | | Called with the next selection (and `null` or `[]` from the clear button) |
| `presets` | `List<KumoDatePickerPreset>` | `const []` | `range` only. Shortcuts beside the calendar |
| `min`, `max` | `int?` | | `range`: nights. `multiple`: days. Not on `single` |
| `closeOnSelect` | `bool` | `true` | `single` only. Close when a day is picked |
| `label`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | Rendered through `KumoField`; `error` also rings the field |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.pickDate` / `KumoStrings.pickDates` | Shown while nothing is picked |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | `xs` 20, `sm` 26, `base` 36, `lg` 40px |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `clearable` | `bool` | `true` | Clear button in the field while a value is set |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Popover on wide screens, bottom sheet below 768px |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | `bool?`, `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Control the panel from outside; otherwise it manages itself |
| `minDate`, `maxDate`, `isDateDisabled` | | | Passed to the calendar |
| `numberOfMonths` | `int?` | 2 for `range`, else 1 | Months in the popover. The sheet shows one and swipes |
| `formatDate` | `String Function(DateTime)?` | `KumoStrings.shortDate` | How each date reads in the field ("Mar 4, 2026") |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Under the calendar |
| `today` | `DateTime?` | `clock.now()` | Today mark, and the day presets count from |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | Label markers |
| `doneLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.done` | Button that closes the sheet |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name when there is no `label` |

`KumoDatePickerPreset(label:, range:)` takes a function from today to a `KumoDateRange`, so it stays right across midnight. `KumoDatePickerPreset.kumoDefaults` holds Kumo's six: Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, This month, Last month.

## Examples

### Range with presets

```dart
KumoDatePicker.range(
  label: 'Analytics period',
  value: period,
  maxDate: DateTime.now(),
  presets: KumoDatePickerPreset.kumoDefaults,
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => period = range),
)
```

Picking a preset sets the range and moves the calendar to its first month. The active preset is filled and announced as selected.

### Custom presets

```dart
KumoDatePicker.range(
  value: period,
  presets: [
    KumoDatePickerPreset(
      label: 'Last 14 days',
      range: (today) => KumoDateRange(from: today.subtract(const Duration(days: 13)), to: today),
    ),
  ],
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => period = range),
)
```

### Multiple days

```dart
KumoDatePicker.multiple(
  label: 'Deploy freeze days',
  value: freezeDays,
  max: 3,
  onValueChange: (days) => setState(() => freezeDays = days),
)
```

### Error

```dart
KumoDatePicker.single(
  label: 'Rollout starts',
  value: start,
  error: start == null ? 'Pick the first day of the rollout.' : null,
  onValueChange: (day) => setState(() => start = day),
)
```

### Always a popover

```dart
KumoDatePicker.single(
  presentation: KumoPresentation.popover,
  value: day,
  onValueChange: (d) => setState(() => day = d),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The field is a button named by the label, with the formatted value as its value and expanded state while open. The clear button is a separate button named `KumoStrings.clear`.
- Enter or Space opens the panel; focus moves to the selected day (or today) and stays trapped in the popover. Escape and outside taps close it and focus returns to the field.
- All calendar keyboard and screen reader behavior applies (see `KumoCalendar`).

## Motion

- The field shows its focus ring on pointer-down, before the panel opens. It has no caret to rotate.
- The popover opens and closes along the same path from the field (`KumoAnchoredOverlay`).
- The sheet follows the finger, snaps by velocity and dismisses with a flick down (`showKumoSheet`). Months inside it change with a horizontal swipe; see `KumoCalendar` for the month slide.
- The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.
- Reduced motion: fades only.

## Mobile

- Below 768px (`KumoPresentation.auto`) the calendar opens in a bottom sheet with the label as a heading, presets as wrapping chips, one month, and Clear and Done buttons. Values update live while the sheet is open.
- The field keeps its 36px look and pads its hit area to 44px on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Popover>` + `<Popover.Trigger>` + `<DatePicker>` | `KumoDatePicker` (one widget) |
| `mode` | named constructor |
| `selected`, `onChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `numberOfMonths` | `numberOfMonths` |
| `min`, `max`, `disabled`, `footer` | `min`, `max`, `isDateDisabled`/`minDate`/`maxDate`, `footer` |
| Presets demo (`DatePickerRangeWithPresetsDemo`) | `presets`, `KumoDatePickerPreset.kumoDefaults` |
| Trigger text `toLocaleDateString()` | `formatDate` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoDateRangePicker.md

# KumoDateRangePicker

Deprecated. Kumo replaced `DateRangePicker` with `DatePicker mode="range"`; this alias forwards every argument to `KumoDatePicker.range` so code can move over gradually.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/date-range-picker

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
// ignore: deprecated_member_use
KumoDateRangePicker(
  label: 'Log retention window',
  value: window,
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => window = range),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Do not use it in new code. Replace it with `KumoDatePicker.range`, which takes the same arguments:

```dart
KumoDatePicker.range(
  label: 'Log retention window',
  value: window,
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => window = range),
)
```

## Parameters

The same as `KumoDatePicker.range`: `value`, `onValueChange`, `presets`, `min`, `max`, `label`, `description`, `error`, `placeholder`, `size`, `disabled`, `clearable`, `presentation`, `open`, `onOpenChange`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `isDateDisabled`, `numberOfMonths`, `formatDate`, `footer`, `today`, `doneLabel`, `semanticLabel`. See [KumoDatePicker](KumoDatePicker.md).

## Examples

### With presets

```dart
// ignore: deprecated_member_use
KumoDateRangePicker(
  value: window,
  presets: KumoDatePickerPreset.kumoDefaults,
  onValueChange: (range) => setState(() => window = range),
)
```

## Accessibility

As `KumoDatePicker`.

## Motion

As `KumoDatePicker`.

## Mobile

As `KumoDatePicker`: a bottom sheet below 768px.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo's deprecated component had its own uncontrolled API; the port keeps only the name and the controlled range API.

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `onStartDateChange`, `onEndDateChange` | `onValueChange` with a `KumoDateRange` (`from`, `to`) |
| `size`, `variant` | not ported; the calendar follows `KumoDatePicker` |
| `timezone` | not ported; put it in `description` or `footer` |
| "Reset Dates" | the field's clear button and the sheet's Clear |

source: doc/components/KumoDeleteResource.md

# KumoDeleteResource

A confirmation dialog for deleting a resource: the destructive button stays disabled until the user types the resource's name.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/blocks/delete-resource

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoDeleteResource(
  open: open,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  resourceType: 'Zone',
  resourceName: 'example.com',
  isDeleting: deleting,
  onDelete: () async {
    setState(() => deleting = true);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    setState(() {
      deleting = false;
      open = false;
    });
  },
  child: KumoButton(
    label: 'Delete zone',
    variant: KumoButtonVariant.destructive,
    onPress: () => setState(() => open = true),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for deletions that cannot be undone and take a resource's data with them (zones, Workers, buckets, namespaces). For reversible or low-stakes removals, use a plain confirm dialog or an undo toast instead; typing a name for every small delete teaches people to ignore it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Keep the widget mounted and drive this; the dialog animates in and out |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>` | required | Cancel, close, Escape and backdrop tap call it with false (not while deleting) |
| `resourceType` | `String` | required | "Zone", "Worker". Used in the copy and the default button |
| `resourceName` | `String` | required | The exact name to type |
| `onDelete` | `FutureOr<void> Function()` | required | Runs when confirmed |
| `isDeleting` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner on the button; field, Cancel, close and dismissal disabled |
| `caseSensitive` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `deleteButtonText` | `String?` | `'Delete {resourceType}'` | |
| `errorMessage` | `String?` | | Error banner above the copy |
| `size` | `KumoDeleteResourceSize` | `base` | Width from 768px, as `KumoDialogSize`: `sm` 288, `base` 384 |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Rendered in place, usually the trigger button |

## Examples

### Failed delete

```dart
KumoDeleteResource(
  open: open,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => open = v),
  resourceType: 'Worker',
  resourceName: 'image-resizer',
  errorMessage: 'Could not delete image-resizer. Remove its routes first.',
  onDelete: () {},
)
```

## Accessibility

- The dialog is a modal route named "Delete {name}"; focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger on close. The field is focused on open and named "Type {name} to confirm deletion".
- The name chip is a button, "Copy {name} to clipboard"; copying shows a check and announces "Copied".
- The error banner is a live region. Enter in the field confirms once the name matches.

## Motion

- Built on `KumoDialogRoot` and `KumoDialog`, so it has Kumo's dialog motion: fade with a scale from 0.9 over 150ms, on the same path in and out.
- The delete button eases from its disabled look as the typed name matches.
- The error banner (a `KumoBanner`) grows in over 200ms and cross-fades, so the copy below slides instead of jumping.
- Reduced motion keeps only a short fade for the dialog; the button and banner change in one frame.

## Mobile

Below 768px the dialog takes the full width minus 16px gutters, 32px from the top, and scrolls when the keyboard or 2x text needs the room.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | `open`, `onOpenChange` |
| `resourceType`, `resourceName` | `resourceType`, `resourceName` |
| `onDelete`, `isDeleting` | `onDelete`, `isDeleting` |
| `caseSensitive`, `deleteButtonText`, `errorMessage` | same names |
| `size="sm" \| "base"` | `KumoDeleteResourceSize.sm` / `.base` |
| trigger outside the component | `child` |

source: doc/components/KumoDialog.md

# KumoDialog

A modal panel near the top of the screen over a recessed backdrop, for focused tasks and confirmations that block the page behind them.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/dialog

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> renameWorker(BuildContext context) async {
  final name = await showKumoDialog<String>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => const KumoDialog(
      title: 'Rename Worker',
      description: 'Routes keep working; the workers.dev URL changes.',
      actions: [
        KumoDialogClose(label: 'Cancel'),
        KumoDialogClose(label: 'Rename', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, result: 'thumbnailer'),
      ],
    ),
  );
  debugPrint('Renamed to $name');
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a short task or decision that must finish before the user goes on: renaming a resource, editing a record, confirming a change.
- Use `KumoDialogRole.alertDialog` (or `showKumoAlertDialog`) for destructive or irreversible confirmations.
- Use `KumoLayerDialog` when the same content should be a bottom sheet on phones, and `KumoDrawer` for details and filters that sit beside the page.
- Do not use a dialog for messages that need no decision; use `KumoToast` or `KumoBanner`.
- Never conditionally render a dialog. Open it with `showKumoDialog`, or keep it mounted in `KumoDialogRoot` and drive `open` so it can animate out.

## Parameters

### KumoDialog

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | 20px semibold heading. Names the dialog for screen readers. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Subtle supporting copy under the title. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Body. Scrolls inside the panel when it does not fit. |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Footer buttons, end-aligned, wrapping when they do not fit. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown before the title, such as a 40px warning badge. |
| `size` | `KumoDialogSize` | `base` | Desktop width: `sm` 288, `base` 384, `lg` 512, `xl` 768. `sm` also uses 16px padding and small buttons. |
| `showCloseButton` | `bool?` | `null` | The header X. Null shows it for `KumoDialogRole.dialog` with a title, hides it for alert dialogs. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | `null` | Overrides the size's padding (24px, 16px for `sm`). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name when there is no title. |

Static helpers: `KumoDialog.closeFrom(context, [result])` closes the dialog, layer dialog or drawer that `context` belongs to; `KumoDialog.roleOf(context)` returns the role it was opened with.

### showKumoDialog

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `BuildContext` | required, positional | |
| `builder` | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Builds the dialog, usually a `KumoDialog`. |
| `role` | `KumoDialogRole` | `dialog` | `alertDialog` blocks backdrop dismissal and hides the X. |
| `dismissible` | `bool?` | `null` | Backdrop tap closes. Defaults to true for `dialog`, false for `alertDialog`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Route label. |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

Returns `Future<T?>`: the result of the `KumoDialogClose` or `KumoDialog.closeFrom` call that closed it, or null.

### KumoDialogRoot

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Shows the dialog while true; turning false animates it out. |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>` | required | Called with false for every user dismissal (X, close parts, Escape, backdrop, back gesture, swipe). |
| `dialog` | `Widget` | required | Rebuilt with the root, so live state reaches the open dialog (one frame later). A `KumoLayerDialog` or `KumoDrawer` opens in a sheet route. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The page content, usually with the trigger. |
| `role` | `KumoDialogRole` | `dialog` | |
| `dismissible` | `bool?` | `null` | As in `showKumoDialog`. Read when the dialog opens. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

### Parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoDialogTitle(String)` | The heading, for custom layouts in `child`. |
| `KumoDialogDescription(String)` | Subtle 14px copy. |
| `KumoDialogFooter(children:)` | End-aligned wrapping action row with 8px gaps. |
| `KumoDialogClose({label, variant, size, result, onPress, semanticLabel, autofocus, disabled})` | A button that closes the dialog with `result` after running `onPress`. Without `label` it is the square X, announced with `KumoStrings.close`. Size defaults to the dialog size's button size. |

## Examples

### Destructive confirmation with a badge

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<bool?> confirmRevoke(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoDialog<bool>(
    context,
    role: KumoDialogRole.alertDialog,
    builder: (context) => const KumoDialog(
      title: 'Revoke API token?',
      description: 'Scripts using "ci-deploy" stop authenticating right away.',
      leading: KumoIcon(KumoIcons.warningFill, size: 20, color: KumoColor.textDanger),
      actions: [
        KumoDialogClose(label: 'Keep token', result: false, autofocus: true),
        KumoDialogClose(label: 'Revoke token', variant: KumoButtonVariant.destructive, result: true),
      ],
    ),
  );
}
```

### Kept mounted with KumoDialogRoot

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

class EditRecord extends StatefulWidget {
  const EditRecord({super.key});

  @override
  State<EditRecord> createState() => _EditRecordState();
}

class _EditRecordState extends State<EditRecord> {
  bool _open = false;
  bool _saving = false;

  Future<void> _save() async {
    setState(() => _saving = true);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _open = false);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoDialogRoot(
      open: _open,
      onOpenChange: (open) => setState(() => _open = open),
      dialog: KumoDialog(
        title: 'Edit DNS record',
        actions: [
          KumoDialogClose(label: 'Cancel', disabled: _saving),
          KumoButton(label: 'Save record', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, loading: _saving, onPress: _save),
        ],
        child: const KumoText('api.example.com, type CNAME'),
      ),
      child: KumoButton(label: 'Edit record', onPress: () => setState(() => _open = true)),
    );
  }
}
```

### Long content

Body content taller than the screen scrolls inside the panel. Hairlines appear under the header once content passes beneath it and above the footer while more content is below, so the sticky parts stay separated without shifting layout.

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> reviewRecords(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoDialog<void>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => KumoDialog(
      size: KumoDialogSize.lg,
      title: 'Review DNS records',
      actions: const [KumoDialogClose(label: 'Done', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary)],
      child: Column(children: [for (var i = 1; i <= 40; i++) KumoText('app$i.example.com')]),
    ),
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- The panel is a `SemanticsRole.dialog` (or `alertDialog`) node; the title is a heading that names the route.
- Focus moves into the dialog on open, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside, and focus returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape closes every dialog, alert dialogs included (the ARIA alert dialog pattern); the backdrop is announced as a Close button when it dismisses.
- The X is announced with `KumoStrings.close`; buttons get 44x44 hit areas on touch.
- `showKumoAlertDialog` focuses Cancel first for destructive confirmations, so Enter never confirms by accident.

## Motion

- Fades in and scales up from 0.9 over 150ms (`KumoDialogRoute`), and leaves the same way. The backdrop fades with it.
- When the content grows or shrinks (a step changes, an error appears), the panel edge glides to the new height on a spring that starts from its current height and speed. The content is laid out at its new size at once and clipped while the edge moves.
- A new `size` animates the width over 200ms; the screen edge still clamps it immediately, so resizing a window never lags.
- Under reduced motion the dialog only cross-fades and size changes land in one frame.

## Mobile

- Below 768px the panel takes the full width minus 16px on each side; from 768px it uses the size width (capped to the screen minus 32px).
- It sits 32px below the safe area (64px from 640px up) and stops 16px above the keyboard or bottom inset; the body scrolls when space runs out.
- Footer buttons wrap onto a second line at large text sizes.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Dialog.Root open` / `onOpenChange` | `KumoDialogRoot(open:, onOpenChange:)` |
| `Dialog.Root role="alertdialog"` | `role: KumoDialogRole.alertDialog` |
| `Dialog.Root disablePointerDismissal` | `dismissible: false` |
| `Dialog.Trigger` | `KumoDialogRoot(child:)` or a button calling `showKumoDialog` |
| `Dialog size` | `size: KumoDialogSize` |
| `Dialog.Title` | `title:` or `KumoDialogTitle` |
| `Dialog.Description` | `description:` or `KumoDialogDescription` |
| `Dialog.Close render={Button}` | `KumoDialogClose(label:, variant:)` |
| `className="p-8"` | `padding:` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoDialogRoute.md
---

# KumoDialogRoute

The route behind Kumo dialogs: Kumo's backdrop (recessed surface at 80%), a scale-from-0.9 entry, focus trap, Escape and backdrop dismissal. `showKumoDialog` uses it; push it directly for a custom modal.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Navigator.of(context).push(KumoDialogRoute<void>(
  semanticLabel: 'Purge cache',
  builder: (context) => const Center(child: KumoLayerCard(child: KumoText('Purge everything?'))),
));
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `builder` | `WidgetBuilder` | required | |
| `transition` | `KumoDialogTransition` | `scale` | `scale` (0.9 to 1 plus fade, 150ms) or `slideUp` (40px rise, for full-screen pages) |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `true` | Backdrop tap closes |
| `closeOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `showScrim` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the route |

`KumoScrim(onPress:, opacity:)` is the backdrop on its own.

## Motion

Enters and leaves on the same path. Reduced motion keeps only a short fade.

---
source: doc/components/KumoDrawer.md
---

# KumoDrawer

A panel attached to a screen edge, for details, settings and filters that sit beside the page instead of over its center.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no drawer; this follows the sheet pattern from shadcn/ui, built on `KumoSheet` and Kumo tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> openSettings(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoDrawer<void>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => KumoDrawer(
      title: 'image-resizer',
      description: 'Worker settings',
      actions: [
        const KumoDialogClose(label: 'Cancel'),
        KumoButton(
          label: 'Save settings',
          variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary,
          onPress: () => KumoDialog.closeFrom(context),
        ),
      ],
      child: const KumoText('Compatibility date 2026-10-26'),
    ),
  );
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use an end drawer for a record's details or settings while the list stays in view, a start drawer for navigation, a bottom drawer for short pickers on phones.
- Use `KumoDialog` when the task needs the user's full attention, and `KumoLayerDialog` for a dialog that becomes a bottom sheet on phones.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `side` | `KumoSheetEdge` | `end` | `start`, `end`, `bottom` or `top`. `start` and `end` follow the text direction. |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | 16px semibold heading; names the route. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Subtle text under the title. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Body. Scrolls when it does not fit. |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `const []` | Footer buttons, end-aligned. `KumoDialogClose` works here. |
| `showCloseButton` | `bool` | `true` | The ghost X in the header. |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `384` | Largest width of a side drawer; never more than 85% of the screen. |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `true` | False blocks backdrop taps and drag dismissal. Escape still closes. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a title. |

`Future<T?> showKumoDrawer<T>(BuildContext context, {required WidgetBuilder builder, String? semanticLabel, bool useRootNavigator = true})` returns the value passed to `KumoDialog.closeFrom` or `KumoDialogClose(result:)`. `KumoDialogRoot(dialog: KumoDrawer(...))` keeps one mounted.

## Examples

### Bottom picker

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<String?> pickFilter(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoDrawer<String>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => KumoDrawer(
      side: KumoSheetEdge.bottom,
      title: 'Filter zones',
      child: Column(
        children: [
          for (final option in const ['All zones', 'Active zones', 'Paused zones'])
            KumoButton(label: option, block: true, onPress: () => KumoDialog.closeFrom(context, option)),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

- Focus moves into the drawer, Tab stays inside, and focus returns to the trigger on close. Escape closes it.
- The title is a heading that names the route; the X is announced with `KumoStrings.close`. A bottom drawer's handle is a Close button for screen readers.

## Motion

The drawer springs in from its edge and follows the finger 1:1, rubberbanding past its open position. On release the finger's velocity decides: a flick toward the edge dismisses and carries on at that speed; a short or reversed drag springs back. Escape, the backdrop and the back gesture close it along the same path. The backdrop dims with how far the drawer is open. Reduced motion swaps the slide for a fade.

## Mobile

Side drawers take at most 85% of the width so the page stays visible as a cue; bottom drawers cap at 85% of the height and hand drags at the top of scrolled content to the drawer. The header and footer stay put while the body scrolls, separated by hairlines once content passes under them, and the panel respects the safe area on the edges it touches.

## Kumo React mapping

| shadcn/ui Sheet | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Sheet` / `open` / `onOpenChange` | `showKumoDrawer` or `KumoDialogRoot` |
| `SheetContent side` | `side:` |
| `SheetTitle` / `SheetDescription` | `title:` / `description:` |
| `SheetFooter` | `actions:` |
| `SheetClose` | `KumoDialogClose` |

source: doc/components/KumoDropdownMenu.md

# KumoDropdownMenu

A list of actions anchored to a trigger, with checkbox items, radio groups and submenus. Reach for it for row actions, account menus and "Add" buttons.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/dropdown

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  triggerBuilder: (context, menu) => KumoButton(label: 'Add', icon: KumoIcons.plus, onPress: menu.toggle),
  items: [
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Worker', onPress: createWorker),
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Pages project', onPress: createProject),
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'KV namespace', onPress: createNamespace),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a short list of commands or settings that belong to one trigger.
- To pick a value for a form field, use a select. To search a long list, use a combobox.
- For a menu that opens where the user right-clicks, use `KumoContextMenu` (same items). For several menus in a row, use `KumoMenubar`.
- For rich content (forms, text), use `KumoPopover`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | required | Item widgets listed below, top to bottom |
| `triggerBuilder` | `KumoDropdownTriggerBuilder?` | | `(context, menu) => Widget`; call `menu.toggle`, `menu.open` or `menu.close`; `menu.isOpen` is the state |
| `trigger` | `Widget?` | | Non-interactive content made pressable by the menu (an avatar). Pass exactly one of `trigger` and `triggerBuilder`. A `KumoButton` without `onPress` renders disabled, so buttons go in `triggerBuilder` |
| `open` | `bool?` | `null` | Controls the open state; null lets the menu manage it |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Trigger press, item selection, Escape, outside tap, sheet dismissal |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | Flips when there is no room |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `center` | Base UI's default |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `8` | Gap between trigger and menu |
| `alignOffset` | `double` | `0` | |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | `auto` uses a bottom sheet below 768px |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks opening |
| `minWidth` | `double` | `144` | Kumo's `min-w-36` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the menu and the sheet |
| `sheetTitle` | `String?` | | Heading at the top of the sheet presentation |
| `backLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.back` | Accessible name of the back row in a sheet submenu |
| `tapRegionGroupId` | `Object?` | | Taps in other widgets of this group do not close the menu |
| `restoreFocus` | `bool` | `true` | Return focus to whatever had it before opening |
| `onNavigateSibling` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Left/Right on a row without a submenu (-1 previous, +1 next, mirrored in RTL); used by `KumoMenubar` |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | Scale and fade the anchored menu in and out. `KumoMenubar` turns it off while switching between open menus |

### Items

| Widget | Key parameters | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KumoDropdownItem` | `label`, `onPress`, `icon`, `description`, `shortcut`, `destructive`, `disabled`, `selected`, `closeOnPress = true`, `semanticLabel` | Runs `onPress`, then closes. `destructive` is Kumo's `variant="danger"`. `selected` shows a check at the end. `shortcut` is a hint only |
| `KumoDropdownLinkItem` | `label`, `onPress` (required, navigates), `icon`, `destructive`, `disabled` | Announced as a link; closes after `onPress` |
| `KumoDropdownCheckboxItem` | `label`, `checked`, `onCheckedChange`, `description`, `shortcut`, `disabled`, `closeOnPress = false` | Check in the leading slot; stays open |
| `KumoDropdownRadioGroup<T>` | `value`, `onValueChange`, `children`, `label` | Owns the value of its `KumoDropdownRadioItem`s |
| `KumoDropdownRadioItem<T>` | `value`, `label`, `icon`, `description`, `disabled`, `closeOnPress = false` | Check at the end when selected; stays open |
| `KumoDropdownGroup` | `children`, `label` | Groups rows under an optional heading |
| `KumoDropdownLabel` | `text` (positional) | `text-base font-semibold` heading |
| `KumoDropdownSeparator` | | Hairline between groups |
| `KumoDropdownSubmenu` | `label`, `children`, `icon`, `disabled`, `minWidth` | Opens to the side; pushes in place in the sheet. Keep `label` unique within its menu |

Rows without an icon are inset automatically when another row in the same menu has one, so labels line up.

## Examples

### Checkbox items

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  triggerBuilder: (context, menu) => KumoButton(label: 'View options', onPress: menu.toggle),
  items: [
    KumoDropdownGroup(
      label: 'Display',
      children: [
        KumoDropdownCheckboxItem(
          label: 'Show line numbers',
          checked: showLineNumbers,
          onCheckedChange: (v) => setState(() => showLineNumbers = v),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Submenu with a radio group

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  triggerBuilder: (context, menu) => KumoButton(label: 'Account', icon: KumoIcons.user, onPress: menu.toggle),
  items: [
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Profile', icon: KumoIcons.user, onPress: openProfile),
    KumoDropdownSubmenu(
      label: 'Region',
      icon: KumoIcons.globe,
      children: [
        KumoDropdownRadioGroup<String>(
          value: region,
          onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => region = v),
          children: const [
            KumoDropdownRadioItem(value: 'wnam', label: 'Western North America'),
            KumoDropdownRadioItem(value: 'weur', label: 'Western Europe'),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ),
    const KumoDropdownSeparator(),
    KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Log out', icon: KumoIcons.signOut, destructive: true, onPress: logOut),
  ],
)
```

### Custom trigger

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  semanticLabel: 'Signed in as MR',
  trigger: const CircleAvatarWidget(initials: 'MR'),
  items: [KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Settings', icon: KumoIcons.gear, onPress: openSettings)],
)
```

### Controlled

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  open: menuOpen,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => menuOpen = v),
  triggerBuilder: (context, menu) => KumoButton(label: 'Actions', onPress: menu.toggle),
  items: [KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Purge cache', onPress: purgeCache)],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Rows are buttons; checkbox rows expose `checked`, radio rows `checked` + `inMutuallyExclusiveGroup`, link rows `link`, submenu rows `expanded`, the selected item `selected`. Disabled rows are announced as disabled.
- Keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger open the menu (ArrowDown and keyboard opens focus the first item). Up and Down move, Home and End jump. ArrowRight opens a submenu and focuses its first item; ArrowLeft or Escape closes it and returns focus to its row. Escape closes the menu and focus returns to the trigger. Tab stays inside the open menu.
- Opened by pointer, the menu panel takes focus so the first ArrowDown reaches the first item.

## Motion

- Opens from the trigger with `KumoAnchoredOverlay`'s scale-from-anchor spring (0.9 to 1, plus a 150ms fade) and closes along the same path; reopening mid-close turns around from where it is.
- Submenus open the same way from their row after a 100ms hover delay, and close 200ms after the pointer settles on another row, so a diagonal move toward a submenu does not close it.
- A checkbox or radio check lands with Kumo's small bounce (200ms, scale 0.5 to 1) and fades out over 100ms when cleared. Picking another radio option moves the check: the old one leaves while the new one lands. A value flipped back mid-flight reverses from where it is. Checks that are on when the menu opens show at rest.
- The sheet follows the finger and dismisses on a downward flick. Submenus slide and fade in place (200ms) while the sheet grows or shrinks to the new level's height with the same timing.
- `KumoDropdownCaret(open: menu.isOpen)` is a trigger caret that turns over while the menu is open (150ms, the popup's timing) and turns back from wherever it is.
- Reduced motion leaves fades only; checks, the caret and sheet levels change at once.

### KumoDropdownCaret

```dart
KumoDropdownMenu(
  triggerBuilder: (context, menu) => KumoButton(
    onPress: menu.toggle,
    child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, spacing: 6, children: [
      const Text('image-resizer'),
      KumoDropdownCaret(open: menu.isOpen),
    ]),
  ),
  items: const [KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Rename')],
)
```

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | The menu is showing; the caret points the other way |
| `size` | `double` | `16` | Icon size |
| `icon` | `IconData` | `KumoIcons.caretDown` | Glyph at rest |

## Mobile

Below 768px (`presentation: KumoPresentation.auto`) the same items open in `showKumoSheet`: rows are at least 44px tall, `sheetTitle` heads the sheet, and a submenu replaces the list with a back row at the top. Checkbox and radio rows keep the sheet open and update live. Force a presentation with `KumoPresentation.popover` or `KumoPresentation.sheet`.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `DropdownMenu` `open` / `onOpenChange` | `open` / `onOpenChange` |
| `DropdownMenu.Trigger render={<Button/>}` | `triggerBuilder` |
| `DropdownMenu.Trigger` children | `trigger` |
| `DropdownMenu.Content side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset` | `side` / `align` / `sideOffset` / `alignOffset` |
| `DropdownMenu.Item` `icon`, `variant="danger"`, `selected`, `disabled`, `onClick` | `KumoDropdownItem` `icon`, `destructive`, `selected`, `disabled`, `onPress` |
| `DropdownMenu.Shortcut` | `KumoDropdownItem.shortcut` |
| `DropdownMenu.LinkItem href` | `KumoDropdownLinkItem.onPress` |
| `DropdownMenu.CheckboxItem checked / onCheckedChange` | `KumoDropdownCheckboxItem checked / onCheckedChange` |
| `DropdownMenu.RadioGroup value / onValueChange` + `RadioItem` + `RadioItemIndicator` | `KumoDropdownRadioGroup` + `KumoDropdownRadioItem` (indicator built in) |
| `DropdownMenu.Sub` + `SubTrigger` + `SubContent` | `KumoDropdownSubmenu` |
| `DropdownMenu.Group` / `Label` / `Separator` | `KumoDropdownGroup` / `KumoDropdownLabel` / `KumoDropdownSeparator` |
| `inset` | automatic |
| `closeOnClick` (Base UI) | `closeOnPress` |

# KumoEmpty

Kumo's `Empty`: what a list, table or page shows when it has nothing to show, with an optional copyable command and actions.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/empty

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoEmpty(
  icon: KumoIcons.database,
  title: 'No D1 databases yet',
  description: 'Databases you create in this account appear here.',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it in place of an empty list, table or page, and for a data view that failed to load. Every data view needs an empty, a loading and an error state; this covers empty and error, `KumoSkeletonLine` covers loading.

Write the copy for the person looking at it:

- The `title` names what is missing or why: "No results for \"api\"", "No connection to the API".
- The `description` says the next step: "Clear the filter to see all 24 records."
- The action in `contents` has a specific label: "Create database", "Retry". Never "Get started".

Do not use it for a single empty field; show a placeholder or a dash instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | With a `description`: a 20px semibold heading. Alone: 14px subtle text. Both are level-2 headings for screen readers |
| `description` | `String?` | | Secondary text, centered, at most 560px wide |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Decorative icon, 32, 48 or 64px by size |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom content in place of `icon` |
| `iconColor` | `KumoColor` | `textInactive` | Color of `icon`, as in Kumo's demos |
| `commandLine` | `String?` | | Shell command with a `$` prompt and a copy button |
| `copyLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copyToClipboard` | Accessible name of the command's copy button |
| `contents` | `Widget?` | | Actions under the description |
| `size` | `KumoEmptySize` | `base` | `sm` (px-6 py-8 gap-4), `base` (px-10 py-16 gap-6), `lg` (px-12 py-20 gap-8) |

## Examples

### With actions

```dart
KumoEmpty(
  icon: KumoIcons.cloudSlash,
  title: 'Could not load buckets',
  description: 'The request to the R2 API timed out. Check your connection, then retry.',
  contents: Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: [
    KumoButton(label: 'Retry', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () => reload()),
    KumoButton(label: 'View status page', onPress: () => openStatus()),
  ]),
)
```

### With a command line

```dart
const KumoEmpty(
  icon: KumoIcons.folderOpen,
  title: 'No Workers in this account',
  description: 'Create a Worker from the command line, then deploy it with wrangler.',
  commandLine: 'npm create cloudflare@latest',
)
```

### Minimal

```dart
const KumoEmpty(title: 'No API tokens match "deploy"', size: KumoEmptySize.sm)
```

## Accessibility

The title is a level-2 heading. The icon and the `$` prompt are hidden from screen readers. The copy button is labelled `copyLabel` (default `KumoStrings.copyToClipboard`, "Copy to clipboard"); after a copy it announces `KumoStrings.copied` (or `copyFailed`).

## Motion

After a copy the copy icon cross-fades into a green check that bounces in (Kumo's `animate-bounce-in`: scale 0.6 to 1.2 to 1 over 400ms); after one second the copy icon fades back. Under reduced motion the icons swap at once and the check appears without the bounce.

## Mobile

The container fills the width. A long command scrolls horizontally inside its box, which is at most 80% of the content width, and the edge with hidden text fades out so the scroll is visible; the box grows taller at 2x text. Put two actions in a `Wrap` so they stack on a phone.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `icon={<PackageIcon size={48} />}` | `icon: KumoIcons.package` (sized by `size`) or `iconWidget:` |
| `title`, `description` | `title`, `description` |
| `commandLine` | `commandLine` |
| `contents` | `contents` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `className` | not ported |

Deviation: Kumo draws a white 1px inner border inside the command box's ring in both modes. In dark mode the port keeps only the ring, since a white edge on the dark overlay reads as a bright outline.

source: doc/components/KumoField.md

# KumoField

Kumo's `Field`: a label above a control, with a description or an error message below it. Use it to give a custom or bare control the same layout as Kumo's form components.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input (Field is documented with the form components)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoField(
  label: 'Custom hostname',
  description: 'A hostname under a domain you own.',
  error: hostnameError,
  child: KumoInput(semanticLabel: 'Custom hostname', value: hostname, onValueChange: setHostname),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Kumo's form components already wrap themselves in a field when you pass `label`, `description` or `error`, so prefer `KumoInput(label: ...)` over `KumoField(child: KumoInput())`. Reach for `KumoField` around a control that has no label of its own: a custom picker, a row of chips, a group of buttons. For checkboxes and switches use the control's own label.

## Layout

A column with 8px gaps (`grid gap-2`): label, control, then the error or the description. The error replaces the description, in 13px danger text with a warning icon. The description is 13px subtle text.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The control |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text above the control, drawn with `KumoLabel` |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label in place of `label` |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text below; hidden while `error` is set |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error message below, announced as a live region. Also put the control in its error state |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | "(optional)" after the label |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon after the label |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announces the label as required |
| `hideLabel` | `bool` | `false` | Keeps the label for screen readers only |

## Examples

### Around a custom control

```dart
KumoField(
  label: 'Allowed methods',
  description: 'Requests with other methods get a 405.',
  child: Wrap(spacing: 8, children: [
    for (final m in ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT'])
      KumoButton(label: m, size: KumoButtonSize.sm, onPress: () => toggle(m)),
  ]),
)
```

### Error

The field draws the message; put the control in its own error state too if it has one.

```dart
KumoField(
  label: 'Allowed methods',
  error: methods.isEmpty ? 'Pick at least one method.' : null,
  child: Wrap(spacing: 8, children: [
    for (final m in ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT'])
      KumoButton(label: m, size: KumoButtonSize.sm, onPress: () => toggle(m)),
  ]),
)
```

### Visually hidden label

```dart
const KumoField(
  label: 'Search zones',
  hideLabel: true,
  child: KumoInput(semanticLabel: 'Search zones', leadingIcon: KumoIcons.magnifyingGlass),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The label is exposed as text; the control needs its own accessible name (`semanticLabel` on Kumo inputs) because a field label is not linked to an arbitrary child. Kumo's own form components do this linking for you when you use their `label`.
- `required` reads the label as "Label, Required".
- The error row is a live region, so a new error is announced.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Every row wraps and grows with the text scale; nothing has a fixed height.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `label` (string or node) | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `error` (`{ message, match }`) | `error` (string; decide when it shows in Dart) |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| `required` | `required` |
| `labelTooltip` | `labelTooltip` |
| `hideLabel` | `hideLabel` (Flutter keeps the label for screen readers) |
| `controlFirst` | not used; checkbox and switch labels come from those controls |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFieldBox.md
---

# KumoFieldBox

The chrome of every Kumo text field, and `KumoEditable`, the bare text-editing core that goes inside it. Use them to build custom fields that match `KumoInput`.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class HostField extends StatefulWidget {
  const HostField({super.key});

  @override
  State<HostField> createState() => _HostFieldState();
}

class _HostFieldState extends State<HostField> {
  final _focus = FocusNode();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _focus.addListener(() => setState(() {}));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _focus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoFieldBox(
      focused: _focus.hasFocus,
      leading: const KumoIcon(KumoIcons.globe),
      child: KumoEditable(focusNode: _focus, placeholder: 'example.com'),
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `KumoInput` and the other finished fields first. Use these for a field they do not cover.

## Parameters (`KumoFieldBox`)

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Usually a `KumoEditable` |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | `xs` 20, `sm` 26, `base` 36, `lg` 40, matching button sizes |
| `focused` | `bool` | `false` | 1.5px focus ring |
| `error` | `bool` | `false` | Danger ring |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Recessed fill |
| `leading`, `trailing` | `Widget?` | | Inside the box |
| `multiline` | `bool` | `false` | Top-aligned content |
| `minHeight`, `padding`, `borderRadius` | | | |

## Parameters (`KumoEditable`)

`controller`, `focusNode`, `placeholder`, `size` (`KumoTextSize`), `mono`, `enabled`, `readOnly`, `obscureText`, `autofocus`, `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions`, `keyboardType`, `textInputAction`, `textCapitalization`, `inputFormatters`, `maxLength`, `minLines`, `maxLines` (1), `textAlign`, `autofillHints`, `onChanged`, `onSubmitted`, `onTap`, `onTapOutside`, `onEditingComplete`, `semanticLabel`, `color`, `scrollPadding`.

## Accessibility

Wrap the field in `KumoField` for a label, description and error, so screen readers announce them together.

## Motion

None; the focus ring appears instantly.

## Mobile

`KumoEditable` scrolls itself above the on-screen keyboard (`scrollPadding`).

---
source: doc/components/KumoFlowAnchor.md
---

# KumoFlowAnchor

Marks where connectors attach inside a [KumoFlowNode](KumoFlowNode.md), so they meet a header or leave from a footer instead of the node's center.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/flow

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Load balancer'),
  KumoFlowNode(
    semanticLabel: 'my-worker, 2 bindings',
    render: Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        KumoFlowAnchor(type: KumoFlowAnchorType.end, child: Text('my-worker')),
        Text('Routes: example.com/*'),
        KumoFlowAnchor(type: KumoFlowAnchorType.start, child: Text('Bindings 2')),
      ],
    ),
  ),
  KumoFlowParallel(children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'DATABASE'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'OTHER_SERVICE'),
  ]),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for tall nodes whose incoming and outgoing connections belong to different parts of the node.
- Anchors apply to horizontal flows only. In vertical flows, connectors always meet a node at the center of its top and bottom edges, as in Kumo.
- It must be inside a `KumoFlowNode`'s `child` or `render`. Anywhere else it throws a `FlutterError`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `KumoFlowAnchorType` | `both` | `start`: outgoing connectors leave here. `end`: incoming connectors arrive here. `both`: both. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The content the connectors line up with. They meet its vertical center. |

If a node has two anchors of the same type, the last one wins.

## Examples

### One anchor for both directions

```dart
const KumoFlowNode(
  render: Column(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      KumoFlowAnchor(child: Text('Header')),
      Text('Body content that makes the node taller'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

Anchors add no semantics. Name the node with `semanticLabel` so that its parts read as one step.

## Motion

Connectors follow the anchor whenever the node lays out again, for example when a section above the anchor expands.

## Mobile

No special behavior.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Flow.Anchor>` | `KumoFlowAnchor` |
| `type="start" \| "end"`, omitted | `type: KumoFlowAnchorType.start \| end \| both` |
| `render` / `children` | `child` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFlowDiagram.md
---

# KumoFlowDiagram

A directed step diagram: nodes joined by connectors with rounded elbows, plus parallel branches and custom anchor points. Use it when the order of steps matters, as in a request path, a deploy pipeline or a set of routing rules.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/flow

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(
  semanticLabel: 'Request path',
  children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Request'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'WAF'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'image-resizer'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Origin'),
  ],
)
```

The children are entries, not widgets: [KumoFlowNode](KumoFlowNode.md), [KumoFlowParallel](KumoFlowParallel.md) and [KumoFlowList](KumoFlowList.md). Like Material's `Step` in a `Stepper`, they only work inside a diagram. Inside a node, [KumoFlowAnchor](KumoFlowAnchor.md) marks where connectors attach.

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a small, fixed structure that the reader should understand at a glance: three to fifteen steps with a few branches.
- Do not use it for an editable graph with free node placement, or for hundreds of nodes. It lays nodes out automatically and builds every node.
- For a linear progress indicator ("step 2 of 4" in a form), use a stepper or progress component instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<KumoFlowEntry>` | required | Steps in order. |
| `orientation` | `KumoFlowOrientation` | `horizontal` | `horizontal`, `vertical`, or `auto` (horizontal when it fits the width, otherwise vertical). |
| `align` | `KumoFlowAlign` | `start` | Cross-axis alignment: `start` or `center`. |
| `canvas` | `bool` | `true` | When the content overflows: pan, wheel, edge fade and scrollbars. With `false`, overflow is clipped and the content does not move. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 64)` | Space between the diagram's edge and the content. Kumo's default. |
| `onOverflowChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoFlowOverflow>?` | `null` | Called after the first layout, then whenever overflow changes. `KumoFlowOverflow` has `x` and `y`. |
| `onGeometryChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoFlowGeometry>?` | `null` | Called after layout when the node rectangles or connector endpoints change. It also reports the orientation that `auto` picked. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader name of the diagram. Falls back to `strings.diagram`. |
| `strings` | `KumoFlowStrings?` | from `KumoLocale` | Screen reader copy: `diagram`, `step(i, n)`, `branch(i, n)`, `steps(n)`. Defaults to `KumoStrings.flowDiagram`, `flowStep`, `flowBranch`, `flowSteps`. |

`KumoFlowGeometry` holds `orientation`, `size` (the content box), `nodes` (one `Rect` per node, depth first), `ids` and `connectors`. Each `KumoFlowConnector` has `from`, `to`, `start`, `end` and `disabled`. Coordinates are relative to the content box, so they exclude the padding and the pan offset, and they are mirrored under RTL.

## Examples

### Vertical, centered

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(
  orientation: KumoFlowOrientation.vertical,
  align: KumoFlowAlign.center,
  children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Start'),
    KumoFlowParallel(children: [
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'Branch A'),
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'Branch B'),
    ]),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'End'),
  ],
)
```

### Adapting to the screen

```dart
KumoFlowDiagram(
  orientation: KumoFlowOrientation.auto,
  onGeometryChange: (geometry) => debugPrint('Using ${geometry.orientation.name}'),
  children: const [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Push to main'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Build'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Deploy preview'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Promote'),
  ],
)
```

### A large diagram in a frame

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 240,
  child: KumoFlowDiagram(
    semanticLabel: 'Deploy pipeline',
    children: [
      for (final step in ['Install', 'Lint', 'Test', 'Build', 'Upload', 'Deploy', 'Purge cache'])
        KumoFlowNode(label: step),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Loading, empty and error states

The diagram draws whatever structure it is given. While the data loads, or when there is none, show a loader or a message in its place:

```dart
Widget routes(List<String>? routes, Object? error) {
  if (error != null) {
    return const KumoText('Could not load routes for example.com. Check your API token and reload.',
        variant: KumoTextVariant.error);
  }
  if (routes == null) return const KumoLoader(semanticLabel: 'Loading routes');
  if (routes.isEmpty) {
    return const KumoText('No routes on example.com yet. Add a route to a Worker to see its path.',
        variant: KumoTextVariant.secondary);
  }
  return KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
    KumoFlowParallel(children: [for (final r in routes) KumoFlowNode(label: r)]),
    const KumoFlowNode(label: 'image-resizer'),
  ]);
}
```

To show the status of a single step, put an icon and text inside that node. See [KumoFlowNode](KumoFlowNode.md).

## Accessibility

- The diagram is one semantics container. Its label is `semanticLabel` and its value is the step count ("Request path, 4 steps").
- Screen readers visit nodes in flow order, not screen order, so a branch is read in full before the step after it. Each node reads its label and its place: "image-resizer, Step 3 of 4", "WAF, Step 2 of 3, branch 1 of 2". A step inside a list branch gets another part: "Load session, Step 2 of 3, branch 1 of 2, Step 2 of 2".
- Tab moves through pressable nodes in the same order. Enter and Space activate the focused node.
- When the content overflows, the container exposes scroll left/right/up/down actions that pan by 80% of the viewport. A node that gets keyboard or accessibility focus is panned into view.
- Disabled nodes are announced as disabled. Kumo shows a disabled node only by dimming its connectors, so also say it in the label ("Backup handler, paused").
- Connectors use `textPlaceholder`, as in Kumo. They are decoration; the structure also comes from the layout and the announcements.

## Motion

- Panning follows the finger 1:1 from the first frame. Movement before the drag is recognized counts too.
- On release, the finger's velocity becomes momentum. Past the start or end, the content rubber-bands and springs back with `KumoSprings.standard`. Touching a moving canvas stops it where it is.
- Revealing a focused node uses a spring that starts from the current position. Under reduced motion it jumps.
- Scrollbars appear and disappear instantly (Kumo shows them on hover), while hovered, dragged or moving.

## Mobile

- Kumo's diagrams are built for wide dashboards. On a phone, a horizontal diagram usually does not fit. There are two answers, and both are supported:
  - The default `horizontal` keeps Kumo's layout and pans. Edges where content is hidden fade out over 24px, so it is clear there is more. This is the right choice when left-to-right order carries meaning, or for short diagrams.
  - `auto` switches to vertical only when the horizontal layout does not fit the measured width, so landscape and tablets keep the horizontal look. This is the right choice when the diagram sits in a scrolling page, because vertical diagrams scroll with the page instead of inside it.
- Only the overflowing axis is grabbed. A horizontal diagram inside a vertical page lets vertical drags and mouse wheels scroll the page.
- Nodes are measured with the viewport width as their maximum, so long labels wrap instead of overflowing at 2x text.
- Pressable nodes keep Kumo's geometry in the layout and still answer taps within a 44x44 area on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Flow>` | `KumoFlowDiagram` |
| `orientation="horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `orientation: KumoFlowOrientation.horizontal \| vertical` (plus `auto`) |
| `align="start" \| "center"` | `align: KumoFlowAlign.start \| center` |
| `canvas` | `canvas` |
| `padding={{ x, y }}` | `padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: x, vertical: y)` |
| `onOverflowChange` | `onOverflowChange` |
| `className` | wrap the diagram (for example in a `DecoratedBox`) |
| `children` | `children` |
| n/a | `onGeometryChange`, `semanticLabel`, `strings` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFlowList.md
---

# KumoFlowList

A sequence of connected steps inside a [KumoFlowParallel](KumoFlowParallel.md), for a branch with more than one step.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/flow

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Request'),
  KumoFlowParallel(children: [
    KumoFlowList(children: [
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'Cache lookup'),
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'Serve from cache'),
    ]),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Bypass cache'),
  ]),
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Response'),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it only as a branch. The diagram's own `children` are already a list.
- Entries outside the list connect to its first node (incoming) and its last node (outgoing) only.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<KumoFlowEntry>` | required | Steps in order. These can include their own parallel groups. |

Steps in a list are 64px apart on the main axis (Kumo's `columnGap`).

## Examples

### A branch that starts with its own branches

```dart
const KumoFlowParallel(children: [
  KumoFlowList(children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Client users'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Engineering access'),
  ]),
  KumoFlowList(children: [
    KumoFlowParallel(children: [
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'All authenticated users'),
      KumoFlowNode(label: 'Site users'),
    ]),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Contractor access'),
  ]),
])
```

## Accessibility

Steps in a list announce their place in it after their branch: "Serve from cache, Step 2 of 3, branch 1 of 2, Step 2 of 2".

## Motion

None of its own.

## Mobile

A list branch makes a horizontal diagram longer. On phones, prefer `orientation: KumoFlowOrientation.auto` on the diagram, or keep list branches to two steps.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Flow.List>` | `KumoFlowList` |
| `children` | `children` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFlowNode.md
---

# KumoFlowNode

One step in a [KumoFlowDiagram](KumoFlowDiagram.md). By default it is Kumo's node card. It can show custom content, be pressable and selected, or be disabled.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/flow

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Request'),
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'image-resizer'),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use `label` for a plain step, `child` for richer content inside the standard card, and `render` for a different shape, such as a dot or a contrast pill.
- Make a node pressable when pressing it shows details somewhere else on the screen, and mark that node `selected`. Do not hide essential information behind a press.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String?` | `null` | Stable identity. Keeps the node's widget state when earlier nodes change, and names it in `KumoFlowGeometry`. Must be unique. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Text in the card. Also the screen reader label. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content inside the default card, instead of `label`. |
| `render` | `Widget?` | `null` | Replaces the card entirely. It is still measured, positioned and connected. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Connectors touching this node draw at 40% opacity. It also blocks `onPress` and is announced as disabled. |
| `selected` | `bool` | `false` | Tinted background (`tint`) and a 2px `interact` ring. Announced as selected. |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Makes the node pressable, built on `KumoPressable`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Screen reader label when `label` is missing or does not say enough. |

`label` and `child` are mutually exclusive. `render` cannot be combined with either.

The default card is `rounded-md bg-kumo-base px-3 py-2 shadow ring ring-kumo-line`: 6px corners, base surface, 12px by 8px padding, a 1px `line` ring and `KumoShadow.sm`, around 14px body text. Pressable nodes switch to `elevated` instantly on hover, as Kumo's selectable cards do.

## Examples

### Selectable steps

```dart
class RequestPath extends StatefulWidget {
  const RequestPath({super.key});

  @override
  State<RequestPath> createState() => _RequestPathState();
}

class _RequestPathState extends State<RequestPath> {
  String _selected = 'waf';

  KumoFlowNode _step(String id, String label) => KumoFlowNode(
        id: id,
        label: label,
        selected: _selected == id,
        onPress: () => setState(() => _selected = id),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
        _step('request', 'Request'),
        _step('waf', 'WAF'),
        _step('worker', 'image-resizer'),
      ]);
}
```

### Status inside a node

Pair the color with an icon and words:

```dart
const KumoFlowNode(
  semanticLabel: 'Deploy, failed',
  child: Row(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    spacing: KumoSpace.s1_5,
    children: [
      KumoIcon(KumoIcons.warningCircle, color: KumoColor.textDanger),
      Text('Deploy failed'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Custom shape

```dart
KumoFlowNode(
  semanticLabel: 'Entry point',
  render: Container(
    width: 16,
    height: 16,
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFFE9E9E9), shape: BoxShape.circle),
  ),
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const KumoFlowParallel(children: [
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Primary handler'),
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Backup handler, paused', disabled: true),
])
```

## Accessibility

- A node reads its label, then its place in the diagram as the value ("WAF, Step 2 of 4"). Pressable nodes are buttons and also announce selected and disabled.
- Nodes with `label` or `child` are merged into one element. A `render` node is a container, so buttons inside it (an expand toggle, a link) stay separately reachable. Give it a `semanticLabel`.
- Keyboard: Tab reaches pressable nodes in flow order, and Enter or Space activates them. A focused node shows Kumo's 2px brand ring and pans into view.

## Motion

Pressable nodes use `KumoPressable`: the press scale starts on pointer-down and springs back, and the hover color changes instantly. Selecting a node eases its tint and 2px ring in (100ms), from wherever they are. Under reduced motion there is no scale and selection is instant. When a node changes size (for example an expanding section), the diagram lays out again and the connectors follow in the same frame.

## Mobile

On touch platforms, pressable nodes answer taps within a 44x44 area. The extra area is added to hit testing only, so the diagram's spacing and connector endpoints stay as in Kumo. Labels wrap at the viewport width and scale with text size.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Flow.Node>` | `KumoFlowNode` |
| `id` | `id` |
| `children` (text) | `label` |
| `children` (elements) | `child` |
| `render` | `render` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| n/a | `selected`, `onPress`, `semanticLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFlowParallel.md
---

# KumoFlowParallel

Parallel branches in a [KumoFlowDiagram](KumoFlowDiagram.md). The step before the group fans out to every branch, and every branch joins the step after it.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/flow

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Request'),
  KumoFlowParallel(children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'WAF'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Bot score'),
  ]),
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Origin'),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for work that happens side by side or for alternative routes: several triggers starting one Worker, or one Worker writing to several stores.
- Two parallel groups next to each other are not connected, as in Kumo. If every branch of the first group leads into every branch of the second, put a node between them.
- For a branch with more than one step, use a [KumoFlowList](KumoFlowList.md) as the branch.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<KumoFlowEntry>` | required | One entry per branch: a node, a list or another parallel group. |
| `align` | `KumoFlowParallelAlign` | `start` | `start` lines branches up at the leading edge. `end` lines them up at the trailing edge of the widest branch (the right in a horizontal LTR flow, the bottom in a vertical one). |

Branches are 16px apart (Kumo's `rowGap`). The group is as wide as its widest branch in a horizontal flow, and as tall as its tallest in a vertical one.

## Examples

### Fan in, fan out

```dart
const KumoFlowDiagram(children: [
  KumoFlowParallel(children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'HTTP trigger'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Cron trigger'),
  ]),
  KumoFlowNode(label: 'Process request'),
  KumoFlowParallel(children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Log analytics'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Update cache'),
  ]),
])
```

### Align end

```dart
const KumoFlowParallel(
  align: KumoFlowParallelAlign.end,
  children: [
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'DNS'),
    KumoFlowNode(label: 'Transform Rules'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Each node in a branch adds its branch to its announcement: "Bot score, Step 2 of 3, branch 2 of 2". Screen readers and Tab finish one branch before moving to the next, then continue to the step after the group.

## Motion

None of its own. Connectors re-route in the same frame when branches are added, removed or resized.

## Mobile

In a vertical flow, branches sit side by side and can be wider than a phone. The diagram then pans sideways with an edge fade. Keep vertical groups to two or three short branches.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Flow.Parallel>` | `KumoFlowParallel` |
| `align` omitted / `"end"` | `align: KumoFlowParallelAlign.start` / `.end` |
| `children` | `children` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoFocusTrap.md
---

# KumoFocusTrap

Keeps keyboard focus inside a subtree while it is on screen and hands it back when it goes away. Dialogs, sheets and focus-trapping popovers already use it.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoFocusTrap(
  onEscPress: () {},
  child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
    KumoButton(label: 'Save', onPress: () {}),
    KumoButton(label: 'Cancel', onPress: () {}),
  ]),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | |
| `onEscPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Called on Escape |
| `disableFocusTrap` | `bool` | `false` | Let Tab leave at the ends |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `disableAutoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disableArrowKeyNavigation` | `bool` | `true` | When false, Up and Down also move focus |

## Accessibility

Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside and wrap; focus returns to the previously focused widget on unmount.

source: doc/components/KumoGrid.md
