# KumoGrid

Kumo's `Grid`: a responsive column grid with a gap, whose columns collapse at Kumo's breakpoints.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/grid

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoGrid(
  variant: KumoGridVariant.twoUp,
  children: [KumoLayerCard(child: Text('Workers')), KumoLayerCard(child: Text('R2'))],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to lay out cards and stat tiles that should sit side by side on wide screens and stack on phones. For a single row of controls use a `Row` or `Wrap`; for tabular data use `KumoTable`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Fill rows in reading order |
| `variant` | `KumoGridVariant?` | | Preset layout, see below. Neither `variant` nor `columns`: one column |
| `columns` | `KumoGridColumns?` | | Explicit counts: `base`, `sm` (640), `md` (768), `lg` (1024), `xl` (1280) |
| `gap` | `KumoGridGap` | `base` | `none` 0, `sm` 12, `base` 8 / 24 from md / 32 from lg, `lg` 32 |
| `mobileDivider` | `bool` | `false` | `fourUp` only: hairlines between stacked items |
| `breakpoints` | `KumoGridBreakpoints` | `window` | `container` reads the grid's own width |

Variants: `twoUp` (1, 2 from md), `sideBySide` (2), `twoOne` (2fr 1fr from md), `oneTwo` (1fr 2fr from md), `oneThreeUp` (1, 3 from lg), `threeUp` (1, 2, 3), `fourUp` (1, 2, 3, 4 at xl), `sixUp` (2, 3, 4, 6 at xl), `oneTwoFourUp` (1, 2, 4 from lg).

## Examples

### Explicit columns

```dart
KumoGrid(
  columns: const KumoGridColumns(base: 2, md: 4),
  gap: KumoGridGap.sm,
  children: [for (final name in ['assets', 'backups', 'logs', 'uploads']) KumoLayerCard(child: Text(name))],
)
```

### Inside a side panel

```dart
const KumoGrid(
  variant: KumoGridVariant.twoUp,
  breakpoints: KumoGridBreakpoints.container,
  children: [Text('Requests'), Text('Bandwidth')],
)
```

## Accessibility

The grid adds no semantics; children are read in reading order, which is also visual order in both directions.

## Motion

None. Columns change when the width crosses a breakpoint.

## Mobile

Most variants are one column below 768px. Cells in a row stretch to the tallest cell, like CSS grid, so cards line up. In right-to-left layouts the first column is on the right.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Grid>` + `<GridItem>` | `KumoGrid(children:)` |
| `variant="2up"`, `"side-by-side"`, `"2-1"`, `"1-2"`, `"1-3up"`, `"3up"`, `"4up"`, `"6up"`, `"1-2-4up"` | `KumoGridVariant.twoUp`, `.sideBySide`, `.twoOne`, `.oneTwo`, `.oneThreeUp`, `.threeUp`, `.fourUp`, `.sixUp`, `.oneTwoFourUp` |
| `gap` | `gap` |
| `mobileDivider` | `mobileDivider` |
| custom `grid-cols-*` classes | `columns: KumoGridColumns(...)` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoHoverCard.md
---

# KumoHoverCard

A preview card that opens while the pointer rests on a link or name: a Worker's last deployment, a zone's status.

Kumo reference: none (Kumo has no hover card; the behavior follows shadcn's `HoverCard`). The surface matches https://kumo-ui.com/components/popover

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoHoverCard(
  content: const Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      KumoText('image-resizer', bold: true),
      KumoText('Last deployed 2 hours ago', variant: KumoTextVariant.secondary),
    ],
  ),
  child: KumoButton(label: 'image-resizer', variant: KumoButtonVariant.ghost, isLink: true, onPress: openWorker),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to preview what a link leads to, for people who use a pointer.
- Never make it the only way to reach information: touch and screen reader users can miss it. The trigger must lead to the full page.
- For a short label, use `KumoTooltip`. For content people act on, use `KumoPopover`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The trigger; keep it interactive on its own |
| `content` | `Widget` | required | Card content; scrolls if taller than the room |
| `openDelay` | `Duration` | `700ms` | Hover time before opening |
| `closeDelay` | `Duration` | `300ms` | Time after the pointer leaves the trigger and card |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `center` | |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `8` | |
| `alignOffset` | `double` | `0` | |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `width` | `double?` | `256` | shadcn's `w-64`; null fits the content |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `all(16)` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `open` | `bool?` | `null` | Controls the open state; null lets hover and focus drive it |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | |

## Examples

### Controlled

```dart
KumoHoverCard(
  open: previewOpen,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => previewOpen = v),
  content: const KumoText('Zone example.com is active'),
  child: const KumoText('example.com'),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Opens while the trigger has keyboard focus and closes when focus leaves; Escape closes it.
- It never takes focus from the page. Content is readable by screen readers while open, but treat it as a bonus.

## Motion

Opens from the trigger with `KumoAnchoredOverlay`'s scale-from-anchor spring after `openDelay`, and closes along the same path. Moving the pointer from the trigger onto the card keeps it open. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

Touch has no hover: a long press opens the card (with a medium haptic) and a tap anywhere else closes it. A plain tap still activates the trigger.

## Kumo React mapping

| shadcn prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `HoverCard openDelay / closeDelay` | `openDelay` / `closeDelay` |
| `HoverCard open / onOpenChange` | `open` / `onOpenChange` |
| `HoverCardTrigger` | `child` |
| `HoverCardContent side / align / sideOffset` | `side` / `align` / `sideOffset` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoIcon.md

# KumoIcon

Renders a Phosphor glyph from `KumoIcons` (or any `IconData`) at Kumo's 16px default size.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com (Kumo uses `@phosphor-icons/react`)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoIcon(KumoIcons.gear)
```

## When to use / when not to

Pick icons for their meaning (a globe for DNS, a lock for SSL). If no icon fits, use none. Use the `Fill` weight for selected or active states.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `IconData` | required, positional | A `KumoIcons` constant or any IconData |
| `size` | `double` | `16` | |
| `color` | `KumoColor?` | | Defaults to the surrounding text color |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Icons are decorative unless labelled |

## Examples

### Status icon with meaning

```dart
const KumoIcon(KumoIcons.warningCircle, color: KumoColor.textDanger, semanticLabel: 'Error')
```

### Fill weight for an active state

```dart
const KumoIcon(KumoIcons.starFill, color: KumoColor.warning)
```

### Searching the catalog

```dart
// import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_icon_catalog.dart';
// final matches = kumoIconCatalog.where((e) => e.matches('cloud')).toList();
```

## Accessibility

Decorative icons are excluded from semantics. Give a label only to icons that carry meaning without text next to them.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Icons inside controls inherit the control's hit area; standalone tappable icons belong in a `KumoButton` with `shape: square`.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<GearIcon />` | `KumoIcon(KumoIcons.gear)` |
| `<Star weight="fill" />` | `KumoIcon(KumoIcons.starFill)` |
| `size={20}` | `size: 20` |

# KumoInlineCopyText

Kumo's `InlineCopyText`: a compact, borderless copy control for IDs and other short values in text and dense table cells.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/inline-copy-text

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoInlineCopyText(
  'f86b3f10-32e9-4db7-ae95-84a1b2c3d4e5',
  copyLabel: 'Copy database ID',
  copiedLabel: 'Database ID copied',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for short identifiers people copy now and then: database IDs, version hashes, ray IDs. Use `KumoClipboardText` when copying is the main task and the value deserves an always-visible button.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (positional) | `String` | required | Shown and copied |
| `child` (`.rich`) | `Widget` | required | Any content |
| `value` | `String?` | `text`; required with `.rich` | The value to copy |
| `variant` | `KumoTextVariant` | `monoSecondary` (`.rich`: `body`) | Any variant but `heading` |
| `size` | `KumoTextSize` | `base` | Mono variants only take `lg` (14px) |
| `bold` | `bool` | `false` | Ignored by mono variants |
| `truncate` | `bool` | `true` | One line with an ellipsis |
| `alwaysShowIcon` | `bool` | `false` | Show the copy icon at rest |
| `copyLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copy` | Accessible name |
| `copiedLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.copied` | Name and announcement after copying |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | | After a successful copy |

## Examples

### Rich content

```dart
KumoInlineCopyText.rich(
  value: 'f86b3f10-32e9-4db7-ae95-84a1b2c3d4e5',
  copyLabel: 'Copy database ID',
  child: const Text('Database ID: f86b3f10...'),
)
```

### In a table cell

A hovered `KumoTable` or `KumoTree` row reveals the icon, like Kumo's Tailwind `group`.

```dart
KumoTableColumn<String>(
  id: 'id',
  label: 'ID',
  cell: (context, id) => KumoInlineCopyText(id, copyLabel: 'Copy ID'),
)
```

## Accessibility

A button named `copyLabel`, with the text as its value. After a copy its name becomes `copiedLabel`, which is also announced; a failed write shows a warning icon and announces `KumoStrings.copyFailed`. Enter and Space copy.

## Motion

The copy icon fades in on hover and focus (150ms; instant under reduced motion). After a copy it cross-fades into a check that bumps with a small spring, and cross-fades back after 1.5 seconds. `monoSecondary` text brightens to `text-kumo-default` on hover, instantly.

## Mobile

There is no hover on touch screens, so the icon is always visible there. The hit area grows to 44px.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (string) | positional `text` |
| `children` (node) + `value` | `KumoInlineCopyText.rich(child:, value:)` |
| `variant`, `size`, `bold`, `truncate` | same names |
| `labels.copyAction` / `labels.copied` | `copyLabel` / `copiedLabel` |
| `onCopy` | `onCopy` |
| parent Tailwind `group` | `KumoTable` and `KumoTree` rows; elsewhere `alwaysShowIcon` |

# KumoInput

Kumo's `Input`: a single-line text field with a built-in label, description and error message. Use it for names, hostnames, emails, URLs, search boxes and any other short text.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoInput(
  label: 'Worker name',
  description: 'Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.',
  placeholder: 'image-resizer',
  value: name,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `KumoInput` for one line of free text. Reach for:

- `KumoInputArea` for several lines.
- `KumoInputGroup` when the field needs addons (an icon, `https://`, `.workers.dev`) or buttons attached inside one ring.
- `KumoSensitiveInput` for API tokens and other secrets that should be masked until revealed.
- `KumoNumberInput` for numbers with bounds and steppers, `KumoInputOtp` for one-time codes.
- `KumoSelect` or `KumoCombobox` when the value comes from a list.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | | The text. Null leaves the field uncontrolled (the controller owns it) |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Called with the new text on every edit |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | | Drives the text instead of `value`; a new `value` is written into it |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | `xs` 20px, `sm` 26px, `base` 36px, `lg` 40px (minimum heights; they grow with text scale) |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text above the field; also its accessible name. Wraps the field in `KumoField` |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label content; pair with `semanticLabel` |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon after the label with this tooltip; also exposed as the field's tooltip |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text below; hidden while `error` is set |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error message below; turns the ring red and marks the field invalid |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announced to screen readers; nothing is drawn (Kumo marks optional fields instead) |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | Shows "(optional)" after the label |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name when there is no `label` (Kumo's `aria-label`) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | 60% opacity, recessed fill, not focusable |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Selectable, not editable, recessed fill |
| `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon` | `IconData?` | | Icons inside the field, 16px (12px for `xs`/`sm`) |
| `leading`, `trailing` | `Widget?` | | Any widget in place of the icons (a clear button, a unit) |
| `obscureText` | `bool` | `false` | Masks the text (`type="password"`) |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace text for IDs, tokens and hostnames |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | | `emailAddress`, `url`, `phone`, `number` for `type="email"` and friends |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | | The keyboard's action key |
| `textCapitalization` | `TextCapitalization` | `none` | |
| `autofillHints` | `Iterable<String>?` | `null` | Null keeps the field out of autofill |
| `passwordManagerIgnore` | `bool` | `false` | Drops `autofillHints` and suggestions so password managers skip a non-credential field |
| `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `true` | Turned off automatically for `obscureText` |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | | |
| `maxLength` | `int?` | | Hard limit; no counter is drawn |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign` | `start` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `onSubmitted`, `onEditingComplete`, `onTap` | | | |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `(20, 56, 20, 56)` | Room kept around the field when it scrolls above the keyboard, enough for the label and description |

## Examples

### Sizes

```dart
Column(children: [
  for (final s in KumoFieldSize.values) KumoInput(size: s, label: s.name, placeholder: 'example.com'),
])
```

### Error

The error replaces the description, turns the ring red, marks the field invalid for screen readers and is announced when it appears.

```dart
KumoInput(
  label: 'Billing email',
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.email],
  value: email,
  error: isValidEmail(email) ? null : 'Enter an email address like you@example.com.',
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => email = v),
)
```

### Optional field and label tooltip

```dart
Column(children: const [
  KumoInput(label: 'Phone number', showOptional: true, placeholder: '+1 555 0100'),
  KumoInput(label: 'Account ID', labelTooltip: 'Find it in the dashboard URL after /accounts/', mono: true),
])
```

### Bare input with icons

Without a label, name the field with `semanticLabel`.

```dart
KumoInput(
  semanticLabel: 'Search Workers',
  placeholder: 'Search Workers',
  leadingIcon: KumoIcons.magnifyingGlass,
  value: query,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => query = v),
  trailing: query.isEmpty
      ? null
      : KumoButton(
          icon: KumoIcons.x,
          shape: KumoButtonShape.square,
          size: KumoButtonSize.xs,
          variant: KumoButtonVariant.ghost,
          semanticLabel: 'Clear search',
          onPress: () => setState(() => query = ''),
        ),
)
```

### Password managers

```dart
const KumoInput(label: 'Webhook secret', obscureText: true, passwordManagerIgnore: true)
```

### Controlled value and the caret

The field keeps an internal controller in sync with `value`. While the parent echoes back what was typed, the caret stays where it is. When the parent changes the value (a reset, a transform such as lowercasing), the text is replaced and the selection is kept, clamped to the new length.

```dart
KumoInput(
  label: 'Subdomain',
  value: subdomain,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => subdomain = v.toLowerCase()),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The field is one text-field node named by `label` (or `semanticLabel`), with the description or error as its hint, `isRequired` when `required`, and an invalid validation result when `error` is set. The visible label is hidden from screen readers so the name is not read twice.
- The error row is a live region, so a new error is announced.
- Tapping the label, the padding or an icon focuses the field, like a web `<label>`.
- Tab focuses the field; focus shows Kumo's 1.5px focus ring (`ring-kumo-focus/50`), red in the error state.

## Motion

The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once. The focus and error rings change instantly, as in Kumo.

## Mobile

- Heights are minimums: at 2x text the field grows instead of clipping.
- On focus the field scrolls into view above the keyboard, keeping `scrollPadding` around it so the label and description stay visible (inside any `Scrollable`; give the screen a `Scaffold` with `resizeToAvoidBottomInset`).
- Pick `keyboardType` and `autofillHints` for the right keyboard and autofill.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `value` (controlled) / `controller` |
| `onValueChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `onChange` | `onValueChange` (receives the string) |
| `size` | `size` (`KumoFieldSize`) |
| `variant="error"` (deprecated) | `error` |
| `label` (string or node) | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `labelTooltip` | `labelTooltip` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `error` (string or `{ message, match }`) | `error` (string; validate in Dart and pass the message) |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| `required` | `required` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `type="password"` | `obscureText: true` |
| `type="email"`, `"url"`, `"tel"`, `"number"` | `keyboardType` |
| `autoComplete` | `autofillHints` |
| `passwordManagerIgnore` | `passwordManagerIgnore` |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `placeholder`, `maxLength` | same names |

---
source: doc/components/KumoInputArea.md
---

# KumoInputArea

Kumo's `InputArea`: a multi-line text field (a textarea) with a built-in label, description and error message. Use it for notes, descriptions, messages and pasted config or scripts.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input-area

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoInputArea(
  label: 'Deployment notes',
  placeholder: 'What changed in this version?',
  value: notes,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => notes = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the answer can run past one line. For one line use `KumoInput`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | | The text. Null leaves the field uncontrolled |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Called on every edit, newlines included |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | | Drives the text instead of `value` |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | Text size and horizontal padding (`xs`/`sm` use 12px text) |
| `rows` | `int` | `3` | Visible lines when `autoResize` is off; longer text scrolls |
| `autoResize` | `bool` | `false` | Grow and shrink with the content |
| `minRows` | `int` | `1` | Lines when empty, with `autoResize` |
| `maxRows` | `int?` | | Lines to grow to before scrolling; null grows without limit |
| `label`, `labelWidget`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | | | As in `KumoInput` |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announced, not drawn |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | "(optional)" after the label |
| `placeholder`, `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace, for scripts and config |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | `multiline` | |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | `newline` | |
| `textCapitalization` | `TextCapitalization` | `sentences` | |
| `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `inputFormatters`, `maxLength`, `autofocus`, `onTap` | | | |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `(20, 56, 20, 56)` | Room kept around the caret when it scrolls above the keyboard |

## Examples

### Grows with its content

```dart
KumoInputArea(
  label: 'Configuration value',
  description: 'Grows up to 8 rows, then scrolls.',
  autoResize: true,
  minRows: 2,
  maxRows: 8,
  value: config,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => config = v),
)
```

### Fixed rows

```dart
const KumoInputArea(label: 'Summary', rows: 2, placeholder: 'One or two sentences')
```

### Error

```dart
KumoInputArea(
  label: 'Support message',
  error: message.trim().length < 10 ? 'Write at least 10 characters so support can help.' : null,
  value: message,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => message = v),
)
```

### Monospace script

```dart
const KumoInputArea(
  label: 'Worker script',
  labelTooltip: 'An ES module with a default fetch handler',
  mono: true,
  rows: 6,
)
```

## Accessibility

Same as `KumoInput`: one text-field node named by the label, with the description or error as its hint and the invalid state when `error` is set. The error row is a live region. Tapping the label or the padding focuses the field.

## Motion

With `autoResize` the height follows the text line by line, as on the web. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

- The web resize handle has no touch equivalent; use `autoResize` so the field grows as the user types.
- Enter inserts a newline (`TextInputAction.newline`).
- Heights come from the row count and text scale, so 2x text never clips.
- The caret scrolls into view above the keyboard.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `value` / `controller` |
| `onValueChange`, `onChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `rows` | `rows` |
| `autoResize` | `autoResize` |
| `minRows`, `maxRows` | `minRows`, `maxRows` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | same names (`error` is a string) |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `placeholder`, `maxLength` | same names |
| `resize` (CSS) | not applicable; use `autoResize` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoInputGroup.md
---

# KumoInputGroup

Kumo's `InputGroup`: one field built from an input and the parts around it (icons, text addons, an inline suffix, buttons), drawn inside a single ring with a single focus ring.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input-group

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoInputGroup(
  label: 'Subdomain',
  children: [
    KumoInputGroupInput(value: subdomain, onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => subdomain = v)),
    const KumoInputGroupSuffix('.workers.dev'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a group when something belongs inside the field: a leading icon, a fixed prefix (`https://`, `/api/`, `$`), a domain that follows the value, a status icon or loader, a show/hide or clear button, or an action button attached to the end (Search, Apply). For a plain field use `KumoInput`; for a secret with reveal and copy use `KumoSensitiveInput`, which already has those buttons.

## Parts

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoInputGroup` | Root: size, disabled, label, description, error. Owns the ring and focus ring |
| `KumoInputGroupInput` | The text input (exactly one). Takes the value and keyboard settings |
| `KumoInputGroupAddon` | Icon, text or compact button at `start` or `end` |
| `KumoInputGroupSuffix` | Text that follows the typed value and truncates when the value fills the field |
| `KumoInputGroupButton` | Ghost button inside an addon, or a solid button attached to the group's end |

Start addons are always drawn first and end addons last, whatever their order in `children`.

## Parameters

### KumoInputGroup

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | The parts |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | Applies to every part: `xs` 20, `sm` 26, `base` 36, `lg` 40px |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the input and every button |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text above; also the input's accessible name |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon after the label |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text below |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error message below; turns the ring red |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announced, not drawn |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | "(optional)" after the label |

### KumoInputGroupInput

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | | Null leaves the input uncontrolled |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `controller`, `focusNode` | | | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name when the group has no `label` |
| `readOnly`, `obscureText`, `mono` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `keyboardType`, `textInputAction`, `textCapitalization`, `autofillHints`, `inputFormatters`, `maxLength` | | | As in `KumoInput` |
| `passwordManagerIgnore` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `autofocus`, `onSubmitted`, `scrollPadding` | | | |

### KumoInputGroupAddon

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `KumoInputGroupAlign` | `start` | `start` or `end` |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Sized to the group: 10, 13, 18, 20px for `xs` to `lg` |
| `text` | `String?` | | Subtle text such as `/api/` or `@example.com` |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Anything else: a `KumoInputGroupButton`, a `KumoLoader`, a status icon |

### KumoInputGroupSuffix

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required (positional) | Follows the typed value |

### KumoInputGroupButton

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | | Button text |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Icon; icon-only buttons need `semanticLabel` or `tooltip` |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Null disables the button |
| `variant` | `KumoButtonVariant` | `ghost` | `ghost` inside an addon; any solid variant as a direct child attaches the button to the group's end |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Defaults to `tooltip` for icon-only buttons |
| `tooltip` | `String?` | | Tooltip below the button |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Icon and text addons

```dart
Column(children: const [
  KumoInputGroup(children: [
    KumoInputGroupAddon(icon: KumoIcons.link),
    KumoInputGroupInput(semanticLabel: 'Link', placeholder: 'Paste a link'),
  ]),
  KumoInputGroup(children: [
    KumoInputGroupAddon(text: '/api/'),
    KumoInputGroupInput(semanticLabel: 'API path', placeholder: 'endpoint'),
    KumoInputGroupAddon(align: KumoInputGroupAlign.end, text: '.json'),
  ]),
])
```

### Inline suffix with a status

Pair the status icon with text (here the description and error) so it is never conveyed by color alone.

```dart
KumoInputGroup(
  label: 'Subdomain',
  description: available ? '$subdomain.workers.dev is available.' : null,
  error: available ? null : '$subdomain.workers.dev is taken.',
  children: [
    KumoInputGroupInput(value: subdomain, onValueChange: check),
    const KumoInputGroupSuffix('.workers.dev'),
    KumoInputGroupAddon(
      align: KumoInputGroupAlign.end,
      child: checking
          ? const KumoLoader(size: KumoLoaderSize.sm, semanticLabel: 'Checking availability')
          : const KumoIcon(KumoIcons.checkCircleFill, color: KumoColor.textSuccess, semanticLabel: 'Available'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Buttons

A ghost button inside an addon acts on the value. A solid button as a direct child attaches to the end with its own border and focus treatment.

```dart
KumoInputGroup(children: [
  const KumoInputGroupAddon(icon: KumoIcons.magnifyingGlass),
  KumoInputGroupInput(semanticLabel: 'Search rules', value: query, onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => query = v)),
  KumoInputGroupAddon(
    align: KumoInputGroupAlign.end,
    child: KumoInputGroupButton(icon: KumoIcons.x, semanticLabel: 'Clear search', onPress: () => setState(() => query = '')),
  ),
  KumoInputGroupButton(label: 'Search', variant: KumoButtonVariant.secondary, onPress: search),
])
```

### Button with a tooltip

```dart
KumoInputGroupAddon(
  align: KumoInputGroupAlign.end,
  child: KumoInputGroupButton(icon: KumoIcons.question, tooltip: 'Query language help', onPress: openHelp),
)
```

### Sizes

```dart
Column(children: [
  for (final s in KumoFieldSize.values)
    KumoInputGroup(size: s, label: s.name, children: const [
      KumoInputGroupAddon(icon: KumoIcons.magnifyingGlass),
      KumoInputGroupInput(placeholder: 'Search zones'),
    ]),
])
```

## Layout details

- Spacing follows Kumo's model: the input has full padding at the group edge (12px at `base`) and a narrower seam (8px) next to an addon; addons have outer padding only (8px, or 4px when they hold a button).
- Buttons inside an addon are one size below the group (26px in a 36px group) with corners concentric with the group's.
- Next to a suffix the input is as wide as its text (or placeholder), so the suffix follows the value; a long value pushes the suffix out rather than overflowing.

## Accessibility

- The group is one semantics container. The input is named by the group's `label` (or the input's `semanticLabel`), with the description or error as its hint and the invalid state on error.
- Icon-only buttons need `semanticLabel` or `tooltip`; status icons in an addon need their own `semanticLabel`.
- Tapping an addon, the suffix or empty space focuses the input; buttons keep their own taps.
- The focus ring stays on the group while focus is on any part inside it, including a button.

## Motion

Buttons inside addons press with the standard 0.98 spring scale. A solid button attached to the end does not scale (it would open a gap at the seam with the field); its press shows through the instant hover fill. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

- On touch, buttons inside the group get a 44px-wide hit area as tall as the group, so the group keeps Kumo's height instead of growing to 44px.
- At 2x text the group grows; parts stay on one row.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `InputGroup` | `KumoInputGroup` |
| `InputGroup.Input` | `KumoInputGroupInput` |
| `InputGroup.Addon align="start" \| "end"` | `KumoInputGroupAddon(align: KumoInputGroupAlign.start \| end)` |
| `InputGroup.Suffix` | `KumoInputGroupSuffix` |
| `InputGroup.Button` | `KumoInputGroupButton` |
| `InputGroup.Button tooltip` | `tooltip` |
| `size`, `disabled`, `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | same names on `KumoInputGroup` |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| focus modes `container` / `individual` / `hybrid` | chosen the same way: solid direct buttons attach to the end with their own border |
| `InputGroup.Label`, `InputGroup.Description` (deprecated) | `KumoInputGroupAddon`, `KumoInputGroupSuffix` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoInputOtp.md
---

# KumoInputOtp

A one-time code field drawn as a row of cells, for verification codes sent by SMS, email or an authenticator app.

Kumo has no such component; this follows shadcn's `InputOTP`, drawn with Kumo's field chrome (each cell is a `KumoFieldBox`). Kumo reference for the styling: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoInputOtp(
  label: 'Verification code',
  value: code,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => code = v),
  onComplete: verify,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for short fixed-length codes: two-factor codes, email confirmation codes, device PINs, recovery codes. For a long token the user pastes once (an API token) use `KumoSensitiveInput` or `KumoInput`.

## Behavior

One hidden text field drives every cell:

- Typing fills the next cell; backspace clears the previous one. The caret always stays after the last character, so cells fill in order.
- Pasting fills every cell. Separators and spaces are dropped ("123 456" becomes 123456) and extra characters are cut off.
- The platform's one-time-code autofill (`AutofillHints.oneTimeCode`) fills the code from an SMS.
- `onComplete` fires each time the code reaches `length`.
- Digits only by default, with the number keyboard. `alphanumeric` accepts letters too and uppercases them.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `int` | `6` | Number of cells |
| `value` | `String?` | | The code typed so far; null leaves the field uncontrolled |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Whole code after every edit |
| `onComplete` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | When the code reaches `length` |
| `controller`, `focusNode` | | | |
| `groups` | `List<int>?` | | Splits cells with a dash, such as `[3, 3]`; must add up to `length` (otherwise ignored) |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `lg` | Square cells: 40px at `lg`, 36px at `base` |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | As in `KumoInput`; `error` turns every cell red |
| `required`, `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a `label` |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `obscureText` | `bool` | `false` | A dot in place of each character (PINs) |
| `alphanumeric` | `bool` | `false` | Letters and digits, uppercased |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `(20, 56, 20, 56)` | |

## Examples

### Grouped code with verification

```dart
KumoInputOtp(
  label: 'Verification code',
  description: 'Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.',
  error: rejected ? 'That code is not valid. Request a new one.' : null,
  groups: const [3, 3],
  value: code,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => code = v),
  onComplete: verify,
)
```

### Masked PIN

```dart
KumoInputOtp(
  label: 'Device PIN',
  length: 4,
  obscureText: true,
  value: pin,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => pin = v),
)
```

### Recovery code with letters

```dart
KumoInputOtp(
  label: 'Recovery code',
  length: 8,
  groups: const [4, 4],
  alphanumeric: true,
  value: recovery,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => recovery = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Screen readers see one text field named by the label, with the code as its value and the description or error as its hint. The cells are hidden from the semantics tree.
- The error row is a live region.
- Tap any cell, or the label, to focus.

## Motion

The real field is invisible, so the next empty cell draws its own 1.5px caret while the code has focus. It blinks like a text caret (500ms on, 500ms off) only while focused, pauses off screen, and holds still under reduced motion. The active cell's focus ring moves instantly as cells fill. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

- Number keyboard and SMS code autofill by default; long-press the cells for Paste.
- Cells stay square and grow with text scale. When the row is wider than the screen (8 cells at 2x text on a phone), the row scales down to fit instead of overflowing.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no one-time code input. Compared with shadcn's `InputOTP`:

| shadcn | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `maxLength` | `length` |
| `value`, `onChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `onComplete` | `onComplete` |
| `InputOTPGroup` + `InputOTPSeparator` | `groups` |
| `pattern` | `alphanumeric` (or digits by default) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoKbd.md
---

# KumoKbd

Keyboard key chips: one key ("K") or a shortcut ("⌘ K" on a Mac, "Ctrl K" elsewhere), named the way each platform names it.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no keyboard key component; the chip uses Kumo tokens (12px medium `textSubtle` on `base`, `line` ring, `shadow-xs`).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoKbd('K', modifiers: [KumoKbdModifier.mod])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show a shortcut next to a menu item, in a tooltip or in a help panel. Show only shortcuts that work: build the chip from the same `SingleActivator` that handles the key with `KumoKbd.fromActivator`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keyLabel` | `String` (positional) | required | A character (`'K'`, `'/'`) or a `KumoKbdKeys` name |
| `modifiers` | `List<KumoKbdModifier>` | `[]` | Held keys, shown first |
| `platform` | `TargetPlatform?` | `defaultTargetPlatform` | Which platform's names to use |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces the spelled-out names |

`KumoKbdModifier`: `mod` (Command on macOS and iOS, Ctrl elsewhere), `control`, `alt` (Option on Apple platforms), `shift`, `meta` (Command on Apple platforms, Win on Windows, Super elsewhere).

`KumoKbdKeys`: `enter`, `escape`, `tab`, `space`, `backspace`, `delete`, `arrowUp`, `arrowDown`, `arrowLeft`, `arrowRight`. Arrows draw as glyphs everywhere; Return and Backspace draw as glyphs on Apple platforms.

## Examples

### From a SingleActivator

```dart
KumoKbd.fromActivator(const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyP, meta: true, shift: true))
```

### In a menu row

```dart
const Row(children: [
  Expanded(child: KumoText('Open command palette')),
  KumoKbd('K', modifiers: [KumoKbdModifier.mod]),
])
```

## Accessibility

The chips are one node read with full names: "Command Shift P", "Ctrl K", "Up arrow", "Escape". On Apple platforms modifiers follow the macOS menu order (Control, Option, Shift, Command) whatever order they are passed in; `mod` and `meta` together show one Command key.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Chips have a 20px minimum size and grow with the text. Long combinations wrap.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | |
| shadcn `KeyboardDisplay(keys)` | `KumoKbd(key, modifiers:)` / `KumoKbd.fromActivator` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoLabel.md
---

# KumoLabel

Kumo's `Label`: the medium-weight 14px text above a form control, with an optional "(optional)" marker and an info tooltip.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/label

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoLabel('Zone name')
```

## When to use / when not to

Most of the time you do not use `KumoLabel` directly: `KumoInput`, `KumoInputArea`, `KumoInputGroup`, `KumoSensitiveInput`, `KumoNumberInput`, `KumoInputOtp` and `KumoField` draw it from their `label`, `showOptional` and `labelTooltip` parameters, and wire the name to the control for screen readers. Use it on its own for a custom layout, or as the `labelWidget` of a `KumoField`.

Kumo marks optional fields rather than required ones. Show "(optional)" when most fields in a form are required; use a tooltip for context that does not fit in the label, never for information the user must read.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required (positional) | Label text, sentence case |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | Shows "(optional)" after the text in subtle, regular-weight text |
| `optionalLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.optional` | Replaces "(optional)" |
| `tooltip` | `String?` | | Shows an info icon after the text with this tooltip |
| `tooltipSemanticLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.moreInformation` | Accessible name of the info icon |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announces "Required" after the text; nothing is drawn |

## Examples

### Optional and tooltip

```dart
Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: const [
  KumoLabel('Phone number', showOptional: true),
  KumoLabel('API token', tooltip: 'Create one under My Profile, API Tokens'),
])
```

### Translated

`KumoLocale` replaces the built-in copy for a subtree.

```dart
const KumoLocale(
  strings: KumoStrings(optional: '(opcional)', moreInformation: 'Mais informações'),
  child: KumoLabel('Telefone', showOptional: true),
)
```

## Accessibility

- With `required`, the label reads as "Zone name, Required".
- The info icon is named "More information" and exposes the tooltip text to screen readers.
- Form components hide their visible label from screen readers and put the name on the control itself, so it is read once, with the control.

## Motion

The tooltip opens on hover after a short delay, at once on keyboard focus, and on long press with touch (see `KumoTooltip`).

## Mobile

The label wraps onto more lines when it does not fit, and scales with the platform text size.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `text` |
| `showOptional` | `showOptional` |
| `optionalLabel` | `optionalLabel` |
| `tooltip` | `tooltip` |
| `tooltipAriaLabel` | `tooltipSemanticLabel` |
| `htmlFor`, `asContent` | not needed: form components wire the label themselves |

---
source: doc/components/KumoLayerCard.md
---

# KumoLayerCard

Kumo's `LayerCard`: the standard container for a block of content, plain or layered with a header strip.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/layer-card

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoLayerCard(child: KumoText('Requests in the last 24 hours'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one card per block of related content. Never nest a layer card inside another; put a heading above a single card instead. Not every group needs a card: lists and plain sections with spacing are often clearer.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required (plain form) | |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required (`.layered`) | `KumoLayerCardSecondary` and `KumoLayerCardPrimary` |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `h 20, v 16` | Plain form only |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the card pressable |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | For pressable cards |

`KumoLayerCardSecondary(child:, trailing:)` is the header strip. `KumoLayerCardPrimary(child:, padding:)` is the inset content panel.

## Examples

### Layered

```dart
const KumoLayerCard.layered(children: [
  KumoLayerCardSecondary(child: Text('Web Analytics')),
  KumoLayerCardPrimary(child: Text('Measure site traffic without changing your code.')),
])
```

### Pressable

```dart
KumoLayerCard(
  onPress: () {},
  semanticLabel: 'Open image-resizer',
  child: const KumoText('image-resizer'),
)
```

## Accessibility

A pressable card is one button; give it a `semanticLabel` that names the destination.

## Motion

Pressable cards scale to 0.98 on press; hover tint is instant.

## Mobile

Cards fill the width with 16px page gutters.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<LayerCard>` | `KumoLayerCard(child:)` |
| `<LayerCard.Secondary>` | `KumoLayerCardSecondary` |
| `<LayerCard.Primary>` | `KumoLayerCardPrimary` inside `KumoLayerCard.layered` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoLayerDialog.md

# KumoLayerDialog

A strict responsive dialog with a sticky title frame and one primary action: a centered panel from 640px up, a bottom sheet that follows the finger on phones.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/layer-dialog

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> configureHostname(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoLayerDialog<void>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => KumoLayerDialog(
      title: 'Configure custom hostname',
      description: 'Route requests for this hostname to your Worker.',
      body: const KumoText('api.example.com'),
      action: KumoLayerDialogAction(
        label: 'Save hostname',
        onPress: () => KumoDialog.closeFrom(context),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when a dialog must also work well on phones: forms, pickers and confirmations that become bottom sheets there.
- The composition is fixed. Without `action`: an X in the title frame and no footer, for read-only content. With `action`: no X, an automatic dismiss button at the start of the footer and the action at the end. You cannot add other footer controls; put related actions in `KumoLayerDialogAction.menu`.
- Use `KumoLayerDialog.alert` for destructive or critical confirmations.
- Use `KumoDialog` for free-form layouts.

## Parameters

### KumoLayerDialog / KumoLayerDialog.alert

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | Heading of the sticky title frame (16px medium); names the dialog. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Under the title. Folds away once the body scrolls past 8px (if enough overflow remains) and unfolds at the top. |
| `body` | `Widget` | required | Scrollable content. Use `KumoLayerDialogSeparator` between sections. |
| `action` | `KumoLayerDialogAction?` | `null` | The single primary action. Required in `.alert`. |
| `dismissLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.close`, or `KumoStrings.cancel` in `.alert` | Footer dismiss button text. |
| `closeLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.close` | Accessible name of the X. |
| `size` | `KumoLayerDialogSize` | `base` | Desktop width: `sm` 448, `base` 576, `lg` 672, `xl` 768. |
| `verticalAlign` | `KumoLayerDialogVerticalAlign` | `center` | Desktop placement: `center` (24px margins) or `top` (64px from the top). |
| `dismissDisabled` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks the X, the dismiss button, Escape, the backdrop, swipes and the back gesture while work is pending. Closing from code still works. |

`.alert` is announced as an alert dialog, shows no X, ignores backdrop taps and swipes, and labels the dismiss button Cancel. Escape still cancels.

`KumoLayerDialog.createRoute<T>({builder, semanticLabel})` returns the route `showKumoLayerDialog` pushes.

### KumoLayerDialogAction

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | required | Null disables it. The action does not close the dialog by itself; call `KumoDialog.closeFrom`. |
| `variant` | `KumoLayerDialogActionVariant` | `primary` | `destructive` for irreversible confirmations. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `menu` | `List<KumoLayerDialogMenuItem>` | `const []` | Related actions behind a caret button next to the action. |
| `menuLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.moreActions` | Accessible name of the caret. |

`KumoLayerDialogMenuItem({required label, required onPress, icon, destructive = false})`.

### showKumoLayerDialog

`Future<T?> showKumoLayerDialog<T>(BuildContext context, {required WidgetBuilder builder, String? semanticLabel, bool useRootNavigator = true})`. To keep the dialog mounted instead, pass it to `KumoDialogRoot(dialog:)`.

## Examples

### Alert

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> deleteWorker(BuildContext context) {
  return showKumoLayerDialog<void>(
    context,
    builder: (context) => KumoLayerDialog.alert(
      title: 'Delete production-api?',
      body: const KumoText('Requests to its routes fail until another Worker is deployed.'),
      action: KumoLayerDialogAction(
        label: 'Delete Worker',
        variant: KumoLayerDialogActionVariant.destructive,
        onPress: () => KumoDialog.closeFrom(context),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

### Split action and separator

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

KumoLayerDialog deployDialog(VoidCallback deploy, VoidCallback saveDraft) => KumoLayerDialog(
      title: 'Deploy changes',
      body: const Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          KumoText('image-resizer, 2 changed files'),
          KumoLayerDialogSeparator(),
          KumoText('Compatibility date 2026-10-26'),
        ],
      ),
      action: KumoLayerDialogAction(
        label: 'Save and deploy',
        onPress: deploy,
        menu: [KumoLayerDialogMenuItem(label: 'Save as draft', onPress: saveDraft)],
      ),
    );
```

### Pending work

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

class DeployButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const DeployButton({super.key});

  @override
  State<DeployButton> createState() => _DeployButtonState();
}

class _DeployButtonState extends State<DeployButton> {
  bool _open = false;
  bool _deploying = false;

  Future<void> _deploy() async {
    setState(() => _deploying = true);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));
    if (mounted) setState(() => _deploying = false);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _open = false);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoDialogRoot(
      open: _open,
      onOpenChange: (open) => setState(() => _open = open),
      dialog: KumoLayerDialog(
        title: 'Deploy staging-api',
        dismissDisabled: _deploying,
        body: const KumoText('Publishes the new version to every route.'),
        action: KumoLayerDialogAction(label: 'Deploy Worker', loading: _deploying, onPress: _deploy),
      ),
      child: KumoButton(label: 'Deploy staging-api', onPress: () => setState(() => _open = true)),
    );
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

- Announced as a dialog (alert dialog for `.alert`); the title is a heading that names the route. A folded description stays in the semantics tree.
- Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger afterwards. Escape closes unless `dismissDisabled`.
- The phone handle is decorative and hidden from screen readers; the footer dismiss button or the X is always reachable.

## Motion

- Desktop: the panel fades in and rises 8px (200ms), and leaves the same way; the backdrop fades with it.
- Phone: a `KumoSheet` that springs up, follows the finger, rubberbands past its open position and dismisses with a downward flick at the finger's velocity. Alerts and pending dialogs do not move.
- The action's caret turns over while its menu is open (150ms) and back when it closes.
- The description folds over 200ms by clipping, not reflowing. Reduced motion makes the fold instant and the panel a short cross-fade.

## Mobile

Below 640px it is a full-width bottom sheet capped at 85% of the screen, with a grab handle (not for alerts). The footer stays under the scrolling body behind a hairline and above the safe area and keyboard; the dismiss button switches to the secondary style. The presentation is chosen when the dialog opens.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `LayerDialog.Root` / `open` / `onOpenChange` | `showKumoLayerDialog` or `KumoDialogRoot` |
| `LayerDialog.Alert` | `KumoLayerDialog.alert` |
| `LayerDialog.Root dismissDisabled` | `dismissDisabled:` |
| `LayerDialog.Content size` / `verticalAlign` / `closeLabel` | `size:` / `verticalAlign:` / `closeLabel:` |
| `LayerDialog.Title` / `Description` / `Body` | `title:` / `description:` / `body:` |
| `LayerDialog.Separator` | `KumoLayerDialogSeparator` |
| `LayerDialog.Actions dismissLabel` | `dismissLabel:` |
| `LayerDialog.Action variant` / `loading` / `menu` / `menuLabel` | `KumoLayerDialogAction(variant:, loading:, menu:, menuLabel:)` |
| `KumoLocaleProvider layerDialog.close` / `.cancel` | `KumoLocale(strings: KumoStrings(close:, cancel:))` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoLink.md
---

# KumoLink

A styled text link: link blue with a soft underline, or inheriting the surrounding color, or plain. Flutter has no `href`, so navigation happens in `onPress`.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/link

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoLink(label: 'View deployment logs', onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed('/logs'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a link to go somewhere: another page, a document, an external site. Use `KumoButton` for actions that change something (deploy, delete, save).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | required | Navigates. Null shows inactive text |
| `variant` | `KumoLinkVariant` | `inline` | `inline`, `current` or `plain` |
| `external` | `bool` | `false` | Adds the arrow-in-box icon and the `externalHint` |
| `size` | `KumoTextSize?` | inherited | Null follows the surrounding `DefaultTextStyle` |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading icon, sized to the text |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | `textInactive`, no presses |
| `padTapTarget` | `bool` | `true` | 44x44 hit area on touch. Turn off inside running text |
| `externalHint` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.opensInNewWindow` | Screen reader hint for external links |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |

Variants:

| Variant | Color | Underline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inline` | `textLink` | text color at 35% (65% in dark), solid on hover |
| `current` | inherited text color | same as inline |
| `plain` | `textLink`, 70% on hover | none |

## Examples

### External

```dart
KumoLink(label: 'Workers documentation', external: true, onPress: () {})
```

### Inside running text

```dart
Text.rich(TextSpan(children: [
  const TextSpan(text: 'Read the '),
  WidgetSpan(
    alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.baseline,
    baseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
    child: KumoLink(label: 'routing guide', padTapTarget: false, onPress: () {}),
  ),
  const TextSpan(text: ' before adding a custom domain.'),
]))
```

### Inside colored text

```dart
DefaultTextStyle(
  style: context.kumo.text(color: KumoColor.textDanger),
  child: KumoLink(label: 'Create a new token', variant: KumoLinkVariant.current, onPress: () {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a link with its label (and the external hint). Enter activates; focus shows Kumo's ring. Inline links in a paragraph may keep the line height as their target (the inline exception in WCAG 2.5.8); standalone links keep the 44px target.

## Motion

None. Hover changes color and underline instantly.

## Mobile

A long label wraps inside the link. In a `WidgetSpan` the link does not break across lines with the paragraph, like Kumo's `inline-flex` link, so keep inline labels short.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `label` |
| `href`, `to`, `render`, `LinkProvider` | `onPress` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `target="_blank"` + `<Link.ExternalIcon />` | `external: true` |
| `className` | not ported |

Deviation: Flutter text decorations have no offset, so the underline sits at the font's default position instead of Kumo's 0.15em offset.

# KumoLoader

Kumo's `Loader`: a spinner for work of unknown length.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/loader

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoLoader()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it inline (in buttons, next to a status) or for a panel that is loading. For content with a known shape, prefer skeleton placeholders (`KumoSkeletonLine`). Pair a long wait with text that says what is loading.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `KumoLoaderSize` | `base` | `sm` 16, `base` 24, `lg` 32 |
| `dimension` | `double?` | | Exact size; overrides `size` |
| `color` | `KumoColor?` | | Defaults to the surrounding text color |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.loading` | Accessible name; pass `''` when nearby text already says what is loading |

## Examples

### Panel loading state

```dart
const Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
  KumoLoader(size: KumoLoaderSize.lg, semanticLabel: 'Loading deployments'),
  SizedBox(height: 8),
  KumoText('Loading deployments', variant: KumoTextVariant.secondary),
])
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a live region with its label.

## Motion

The arc grows, travels and shrinks around a faint track (Kumo's SVG timing: 2s rotation, 1.5s dash). It runs only while mounted and on screen; under reduced motion it shows a still arc. Inside `KumoButton` the spinner cross-fades with the icon it replaces.

## Mobile

No changes.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `size="sm"` / `size={20}` | `size: KumoLoaderSize.sm` / `dimension: 20` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |

# KumoMapChart

A choropleth map: Kumo's `ChoroplethMap`, drawn over region shapes you provide. Each region is filled from a continuous color scale by its value; regions without a value keep the neutral no-data fill.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts/maps

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoMapChart(
  regions: [
    KumoMapRegion(id: 'weur', name: 'Western Europe', path: Path()..addRect(const Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, 10, 10))),
    KumoMapRegion(id: 'eeur', name: 'Eastern Europe', path: Path()..addRect(const Rect.fromLTWH(11, 0, 10, 10))),
  ],
  values: const {'weur': 1200, 'eeur': 860},
  showLegend: true,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the geography matters: traffic by region, requests by country. When the exact ranking matters more than the place, a sorted bar list reads faster.

## Supplying geometry

The package ships no map geometry (it would add megabytes and a data license to every app). Bring your own shapes in any coordinate space shared by all regions; the chart fits them to its box.

- **GeoJSON** (for example Natural Earth, which is public domain): parse the file you bundle with your app and pass each feature's coordinate rings to `KumoMapRegion.fromPolygons`. It applies an equirectangular projection with north up and cuts holes with the even-odd rule. Simplify the geometry first (mapshaper or similar) so paths stay small.
- **SVG paths**: convert each path to a `Path` and pass it to `KumoMapRegion(id:, path:)`.
- **Tile maps**: hexagons or squares per region work well on phones and need no projection.

```dart
final france = KumoMapRegion.fromPolygons(
  id: 'FR',
  name: 'France',
  rings: const [
    [Offset(-4.8, 48.4), Offset(2.5, 51.1), Offset(8.2, 49.0), Offset(7.6, 43.8), Offset(3.1, 42.4), Offset(-1.8, 43.4)],
  ],
);
```

(The ring above is a rough six-point outline for illustration only.)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `regions` | `List<KumoMapRegion>` | required | `id`, `path`, optional `name` |
| `values` | `Map<String, double>` | required | Value per region id |
| `colorRange` | `List<Color>?` | `KumoChartColors.map.scale` | Low to high stops, interpolated in OKLCH |
| `min` / `max` | `double?` | data min / max | Scale bounds |
| `noDataColor` | `Color?` | `KumoChartColors.map.area` | Fill for regions without a value |
| `showLegend` | `bool` | `false` | `Low` to `High` gradient under the map |
| `showTooltip` | `bool` | `true` | Name and value on hover or tap |
| `valueFormat` | `String Function(double)?` | grouped digits | |
| `tooltipBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, KumoMapRegion, double)?` | | Custom tooltip content |
| `onRegionHover` | `ValueChanged<KumoMapRegion?>?` | | Region with data under the pointer, or null |
| `onRegionPress` | `ValueChanged<KumoMapRegion>?` | | |
| `height` | `double?` | from aspect | Fixed height |
| `aspectRatio` | `double?` | shapes' bounds | Width over height when `height` is null |
| `bounds` | `Rect?` | all regions | Part of the coordinate space to show |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shapes in the skeleton color |
| `error` / `onRetry` | `String?` / `VoidCallback?` | | Error state with a Retry button |
| `emptyMessage` | `String` | `'No data for these regions'` | When `values` is empty |
| `emptyDescription` | `String?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Leads the screen reader summary |

## Examples

### Custom scale and press handling

```dart
KumoMapChart(
  regions: regions,
  values: requestsByRegion,
  colorRange: KumoChartColors.of(context).sequential(),
  valueFormat: (v) => '${v.round()} req/s',
  onRegionPress: (region) => setState(() => selected = region.id),
)
```

## Accessibility

The summary lists every region with data, highest first ("Map, 9 regions, 8 with data. Asia Pacific: 2,400. ..."). With keyboard focus, arrow keys move between regions with data, the value reads the active region, Enter or Space calls `onRegionPress` and Escape clears. The legend reads its range ("Color scale from 100 to 2,400").

## Motion

Value changes cross-fade region fills over 300ms; instant under reduced motion. Hover changes instantly, fading other regions to 45% like Kumo.

## Mobile

Tap a region to highlight it and show its tooltip above the finger; tap outside to clear. The height follows the width, so the whole map stays visible on a phone.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `echarts`, `mapName` | (not needed) |
| `geoJson` | `regions` (`KumoMapRegion.fromPolygons` for GeoJSON rings) |
| `data` + `name` / `value` accessors | `values: {regionId: value}` |
| `nameProperty` | `KumoMapRegion.id` |
| `colorRange`, `min`, `max`, `noDataColor`, `showLegend`, `showTooltip`, `valueFormat` | same |
| `tooltipFormatter(row)` | `tooltipBuilder(context, region, value)` |
| `onRegionHover`, `onRegionClick` | `onRegionHover`, `onRegionPress` |
| `center`, `zoom`, `roam`, `projection` | `bounds` (pan and zoom are not supported) |
| `aspectRatio`, `height` | same |
| `BubbleMap`, `GlobeMap` | not ported |

# KumoMenuPanel

The shared parts of every menu and option list: `KumoMenuPanel` (surface), `KumoMenuRow` (row), `KumoMenuSeparator`, `KumoMenuGroupLabel` and `KumoMenuKeyboard` (arrow-key movement).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoMenuPanel(children: [
  const KumoMenuGroupLabel('Worker'),
  KumoMenuRow(label: 'Rename', icon: KumoIcons.pencilSimple, onPress: () {}),
  KumoMenuRow(label: 'Duplicate', icon: KumoIcons.copy, shortcut: '⌘D', onPress: () {}),
  const KumoMenuSeparator(),
  KumoMenuRow(label: 'Delete', icon: KumoIcons.trash, destructive: true, onPress: () {}),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `KumoDropdownMenu`, `KumoSelect` and the other finished components first. These parts are for custom lists that must look and behave like Kumo menus.

## Parameters

`KumoMenuPanel`: `children`, `minWidth` (144), `maxHeight`, `padding` (6), `scrollController`, `semanticLabel`. The panel scrolls when its content is taller than the room it has.

`KumoMenuRow`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | |
| `icon` / `leading` | `IconData?` / `Widget?` | | |
| `description` | `String?` | | Second line in subtle text |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | | A check, a caret |
| `shortcut` | `String?` | | Shortcut hint |
| `selected`, `checked`, `inMutuallyExclusiveGroup`, `expanded` | `bool?` | | Semantic state |
| `highlighted` | `bool` | `false` | Force the highlight (combobox lists driven from a text field) |
| `disabled`, `destructive`, `inset` | `bool` | `false` | `inset` aligns labels with checkable rows |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus`, `semanticLabel` | | | |

## Accessibility

Rows are focusable buttons; Up and Down move between them, Home and End jump to the ends. Group labels are headings.

## Motion

Rows highlight instantly on hover or focus. They do not scale on press.

## Mobile

Rows grow to 40px minimum height on touch platforms.

# KumoMenubar

A horizontal bar of menus (File, View, Deploy) in Kumo's `MenuBar` look: a recessed track where the open menu's trigger is raised onto the base surface.

Kumo reference: `MenuBar` in `packages/kumo/src/components/menubar` (deprecated in Kumo, no docs page)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoMenubar(
  semanticLabel: 'Worker editor',
  menus: [
    KumoMenubarMenu(label: 'File', items: [
      KumoDropdownItem(label: 'New Worker', icon: KumoIcons.plus, onPress: createWorker),
      KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Save', shortcut: '⌘S', onPress: save),
    ]),
    KumoMenubarMenu(label: 'View', items: [
      KumoDropdownCheckboxItem(label: 'Live logs', checked: logs, onCheckedChange: (v) => setState(() => logs = v)),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for editor-style screens with several groups of commands.
- For one group of commands, use `KumoDropdownMenu`. For switching views, use segmented tabs (Kumo deprecated its icon `MenuBar` in their favor). For a row of direct actions, use `KumoToolbar`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menus` | `List<KumoMenubarMenu>` | required | Left to right (start to end) |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Menus open as bottom sheets below 768px |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the bar |

### KumoMenubarMenu

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | Trigger text; with `icon`, the tooltip and accessible name |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | required | Dropdown items (`KumoDropdownItem`, `KumoDropdownSubmenu`, ...) |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Icon-only trigger, 18px, as in Kumo's `MenuBar` |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Skipped by arrow keys and hover |

## Examples

### Icon menus

```dart
KumoMenubar(
  menus: [
    KumoMenubarMenu(label: 'Settings', icon: KumoIcons.gearSix, items: [
      KumoDropdownItem(label: 'Variables', onPress: openVariables),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Triggers are buttons with an expanded state; icon triggers are named by `label`.
- One Tab stop for the whole bar. Left and Right move between triggers (mirrored in RTL, skipping disabled menus, wrapping), Home and End jump. Enter, Space or Down open the focused menu on its first item.
- Inside an open menu, Left and Right move to the neighboring menu; on a submenu row, Right opens the submenu instead. Escape or choosing an item closes the menu and, from the keyboard, focus returns to its trigger.

## Motion

Menus open from their trigger with `KumoAnchoredOverlay`'s scale-from-anchor spring and close along the same path. While one menu is open, hovering another trigger, clicking it or pressing Left/Right switches to it: the panels swap in place in one frame, with no shrink-and-grow between them (as in desktop menu bars). Closing the last open menu animates out as usual. The raised trigger switches instantly (Kumo never animates hover colors).

## Mobile

Below 768px menus open as bottom sheets with the same items. The bar scrolls sideways if its triggers do not fit, and triggers are 44px tall on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `MenuBar options` | `menus` |
| option `icon` | `KumoMenubarMenu.icon` |
| option `tooltip` | `KumoMenubarMenu.label` |
| option `onClick` | each menu's `items` |
| `isActive` | the open menu is raised automatically |
| `useMenuNavigation` (horizontal) | built in |

# KumoMeter

Kumo's `Meter`: a labeled bar for a measured value within a known range, such as storage used or request quota.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/meter

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoMeter(label: 'Storage used', value: 65)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a meter for a level that can go up and down: quota, storage, memory. For work that finishes (an upload, a deployment) use `KumoProgress`. For a single figure without a range, use text.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | 12px subtle text above the track |
| `value` | `double` | required | Clamped to `min`..`max` |
| `min` | `double` | `0` | |
| `max` | `double` | `100` | |
| `customValue` | `String?` | | Replaces the percentage, for example `'750 / 1,000'` |
| `showValue` | `bool` | `true` | Shows the percentage next to the label (13px medium, tabular digits) |
| `tone` | `KumoMeterTone` | `brand` | Indicator color when no threshold applies: `brand`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` |
| `thresholds` | `List<KumoMeterThreshold>` | `[]` | Levels that switch the tone and add a status line |
| `indicatorColor` | `KumoColor?` | | Overrides the indicator color |

`KumoMeterThreshold(value:, tone:, label:)` applies once `value` is at or above its `value`; the highest matching threshold wins. Its `label` appears under the track with the tone's icon and text color, and is read by screen readers.

`KumoMeterTrack(fraction:, color:, height:)` is the bare 8px track and indicator, for table cells and compact cards.

## Examples

### Custom value

```dart
const KumoMeter(label: 'API requests', value: 750, max: 1000, customValue: '750 / 1,000')
```

### Thresholds

```dart
KumoMeter(
  label: 'R2 storage in assets',
  value: usedGb,
  max: 10,
  customValue: '${usedGb.toStringAsFixed(1)} / 10 GB',
  thresholds: const [
    KumoMeterThreshold(value: 8, tone: KumoMeterTone.warning, label: 'Approaching the 10 GB limit'),
    KumoMeterThreshold(value: 10, tone: KumoMeterTone.danger, label: 'Limit reached. Uploads are paused'),
  ],
)
```

### In a table cell

```dart
const SizedBox(width: 120, child: KumoMeterTrack(fraction: 0.42))
```

## Accessibility

The meter is one node: its label, with the value text (and the threshold label, if any) as the value, for example "R2 storage, 9 / 10 GB, Approaching the 10 GB limit". A state is never shown by color alone: every threshold writes its label under the track with an icon.

## Motion

When the value changes the indicator eases from its current width to the new one (300ms ease-out, Kumo's `transition-[width] duration-300 ease-out`). A change mid-animation continues from where the bar is. Crossing a threshold eases the indicator to its new tone at the same time. Under reduced motion the bar and tone jump.

## Mobile

The label and the value share one row; the label wraps at 2x text, the value stays whole. The status line wraps under the track.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | `label` |
| `value`, `min`, `max` | `value`, `min`, `max` |
| `customValue` | `customValue` |
| `showValue` | `showValue` |
| `indicatorClassName="from-kumo-success ..."` | `tone: KumoMeterTone.success` or `indicatorColor:` |
| `trackClassName` | not ported; use `KumoMeterTrack` for custom layouts |

Addition: `thresholds` and `tone` are not in Kumo, whose meter is always brand blue.

---
source: doc/components/KumoNumberInput.md
---

# KumoNumberInput

A numeric field with minus and plus steppers, bounds, decimals and keyboard stepping, in Kumo's input style. Use it for counts, ports, rates and durations.

Kumo has no number input of its own; this follows shadcn's feature set, drawn with Kumo's field chrome and compact ghost buttons (the same as `KumoInputGroupButton`). Kumo reference for the styling: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoNumberInput(
  label: 'Max retries',
  value: retries,
  min: 0,
  max: 10,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => retries = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a number the user may type or nudge. For a value picked along a range by feel use `KumoSlider`; for an ID or a phone number (digits that are not quantities) use `KumoInput` with `keyboardType: TextInputType.number`.

## Behavior

- Steppers add or remove `step`. Holding one steps once at pointer-down, waits `repeatDelay` (400ms), then repeats every `repeatInterval` (60ms) until the finger lifts or a bound is reached. Release always stops it.
- ArrowUp and ArrowDown step; PageUp, PageDown and Shift+Arrow step by `largeStep` (ten steps by default).
- While typing, a number inside `min` and `max` is reported at once. Text that is not a number, or is out of range, shows the error ring and is not reported. On blur or submit it is clamped into range and rounded, or reverted to the last valid value if it is not a number. A lone `-` or `.` while typing is not flagged.
- Clearing the field reports `null`. Stepping from empty starts at `min` (or 0).
- Steps never drift (0.1 + 0.2 lands on 0.3): results are rounded to `fractionDigits`, or to the decimals of `step`.
- The default filter accepts digits, one decimal point (unless `fractionDigits` is 0) and a leading minus (only when `min` is null or negative).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double?` | | The number, or null when empty |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<double?>?` | | Next number, or null when cleared |
| `min`, `max` | `double?` | | Bounds; steppers disable at them |
| `step` | `double` | `1` | Stepper and arrow-key amount |
| `largeStep` | `double?` | `step * 10` | PageUp, PageDown, Shift+Arrow |
| `fractionDigits` | `int?` | | Fixed decimals for display and rounding; null shows integers without decimals |
| `format` | `String Function(double)?` | | Custom display text; pair with `parse` and `inputFormatters` |
| `parse` | `double? Function(String)?` | | Reads typed text; return null for invalid |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | As in `KumoInput` |
| `required`, `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder`, `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Steppers and keys do nothing |
| `showSteppers` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | `done` | |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | | Replaces the default numeric filter |
| `onSubmitted` | `ValueChanged<double?>?` | | Called with the committed number |
| `repeatDelay` | `Duration` | `400ms` | Hold time before repeating |
| `repeatInterval` | `Duration` | `60ms` | Time between repeated steps |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `(20, 56, 20, 56)` | |

## Examples

### Decimals

```dart
KumoNumberInput(
  label: 'Sample rate',
  value: rate,
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  step: 0.05,
  fractionDigits: 2,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => rate = v),
)
```

### Required with validation

```dart
KumoNumberInput(
  label: 'Origin port',
  required: true,
  value: port,
  min: 1,
  max: 65535,
  error: port == null ? 'Enter a port.' : null,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => port = v),
)
```

### Large steps and an empty default

```dart
KumoNumberInput(
  label: 'Cache TTL in seconds',
  showOptional: true,
  placeholder: 'Respect origin',
  value: ttl,
  min: 0,
  step: 60,
  largeStep: 3600,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => ttl = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- One text-field node named by the label, with increase and decrease actions (swipe up and down with TalkBack and VoiceOver) that announce the next value.
- The steppers are buttons named "Increase" and "Decrease" from `KumoStrings`. They stay out of the Tab order; the arrow keys step from the field.
- Errors mark the field invalid and are announced.

## Motion

A stepper press or arrow key lands the new number with a 4px rise (or drop, when decreasing) and fade over 150ms. While a stepper is held the repeats come faster than that, so the number just counts. Steppers press with the standard spring scale. The press-and-hold repeat runs only while a finger or pointer is down and stops at the bounds. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once. Under reduced motion the number does not move.

## Mobile

- The keyboard is numeric (`numberWithOptions`, signed and decimal as the bounds and `fractionDigits` allow).
- Stepper hit areas are 44px wide and as tall as the field, so the field keeps Kumo's height.
- The first step fires on pointer-down, not after release.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no number input. It maps to the native `<Input type="number">` this way:

| HTML / Kumo | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type="number"` | `KumoNumberInput` |
| `min`, `max`, `step` | `min`, `max`, `step` |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `value` (`double?`), `onValueChange` |
| `label`, `description`, `error`, `size`, `disabled`, `readOnly` | same names |

source: doc/components/KumoPageHeader.md
