# KumoPageHeader

The top of a page: breadcrumbs, a title and description, then segmented tabs with the page's actions.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/blocks/page-header

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoPageHeader(
  title: 'image-resizer',
  description: 'Resizes and converts images at the edge.',
  tabs: const [
    KumoPageHeaderTab(label: 'Overview', value: 'overview'),
    KumoPageHeaderTab(label: 'Settings', value: 'settings'),
  ],
  value: tab,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => tab = v),
  actions: [
    KumoButton(label: 'Edit code', icon: KumoIcons.code, size: KumoButtonSize.sm, onPress: () {}),
    KumoButton(label: 'Visit', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, size: KumoButtonSize.sm, onPress: () {}),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one at the top of every resource and settings page. For a section heading inside a page, use `KumoText` with `KumoTextVariant.heading`. For a list page with an aside, `KumoResourceList` already draws its own title.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `breadcrumbs` | `Widget?` | | Breadcrumb trail, drawn above a bottom border |
| `title` | `String?` | | 30px semibold, the level 1 heading |
| `description` | `String?` | | Subtle 14px text, at most about 65 characters wide |
| `tabs` | `List<KumoPageHeaderTab>?` | | `KumoPageHeaderTab(label:, value:)`, drawn as a segmented `KumoTabs` |
| `value` | `String?` | first tab | Selected tab |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `[]` | At the end of the tab row, or beside the title without tabs |
| `spacing` | `KumoPageHeaderSpacing` | `base` | Gap between sections: `compact` 4, `base` 8, `relaxed` 16 |
| `narrowBreakpoint` | `double` | `640` | Below this width, actions stack under the title or tabs |

## Examples

### Breadcrumbs and title

```dart
KumoPageHeader(
  breadcrumbs: myBreadcrumbs,
  title: 'assets',
  description: 'Object storage for the images and fonts your sites serve.',
)
```

### Title with actions, no tabs

```dart
KumoPageHeader(
  title: 'API tokens',
  actions: [KumoButton(label: 'Create token', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {})],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The title is announced as a level 1 heading.
- Tabs are buttons in a mutually exclusive group; the selected one is announced as selected. Left and Right arrows move focus between tabs, Enter and Space select.

## Motion

The tabs are a segmented `KumoTabs`: the indicator springs from wherever it is to the selected tab (a tap mid-flight turns it around), and on touch the pill can be dragged across tabs. Under reduced motion it moves at once. Tab hover color is instant.

## Mobile

Below 640px of width the actions move under the tabs (or under the title) and wrap; the tab strip scrolls sideways. Tabs keep a 44px minimum width on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `breadcrumbs` | `breadcrumbs` (any widget) |
| `title`, `description` | `title`, `description` |
| `tabs: TabsItem[]` | `tabs: List<KumoPageHeaderTab>` |
| `defaultTab` | `value` (controlled) |
| `onValueChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `children` (actions in the tab row) | `actions` |
| `spacing` | `spacing` |

source: doc/components/KumoPagination.md

# KumoPagination

Page navigation under a table or list: "Showing 1-25 of 500" on one side, joined first, previous, page number, next and last buttons on the other.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/pagination

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoPagination(
  page: page,
  onPageChange: (p) => setState(() => page = p),
  perPage: 25,
  totalCount: 500,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for server-paged data where people jump between pages. For feeds that only grow, load more on scroll instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `int` | required | Current page, 1-based |
| `onPageChange` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | required | Next page. Null disables every control |
| `perPage` | `int?` | | Items per page |
| `totalCount` | `int?` | | Total items. Null when unknown |
| `hasNextPage` | `bool?` | | With an unknown total: whether another page exists |
| `controls` | `KumoPaginationControls` | `full` | `full` or `simple` (previous and next only) |
| `pageSelector` | `KumoPaginationPageSelector` | `input` | `input` (typed, 50px) or `dropdown` (menu of every page) |
| `perPageOptions` | `List<int>?` | `[25, 50, 100, 250]` | |
| `onPerPageChange` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Shows the "Per page" select (with `perPage`) |
| `showInfo` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `infoBuilder` | `KumoPaginationInfoBuilder?` | | Replaces the info text; gets `KumoPaginationInfo` (`page`, `maxPage`, `perPage`, `totalCount`, `from`, `to`) |
| `compact` | `bool?` | narrow window | Drops first and last, puts the page size under the controls |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Where the page size and page menus open |
| `perPageLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.perPage` | |
| `pageNumberLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.pageNumber` | Accessible name of the page field or menu |
| `pageSizeLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.pageSize` | Accessible name of the page size select |

The info text comes from `KumoStrings.showingRange` and the button names from `KumoStrings.firstPage`, `previousPage`, `nextPage`, `lastPage` and `pagination`, so `KumoLocale` translates them.

## Examples

### Page size

```dart
KumoPagination(
  page: page,
  onPageChange: (p) => setState(() => page = p),
  perPage: perPage,
  totalCount: 500,
  onPerPageChange: (v) => setState(() {
    perPage = v;
    page = 1;
  }),
)
```

### Unknown total

```dart
KumoPagination(
  page: page,
  onPageChange: (p) => setState(() => page = p),
  hasNextPage: cursor != null,
  infoBuilder: (context, info) => KumoText('Page ${info.page}', variant: KumoTextVariant.secondary, size: KumoTextSize.sm),
)
```

Only previous and next show; next is enabled while `hasNextPage` is true.

### Empty, loading and error

The table owns those states. With `totalCount: 0` pagination shows one empty page, no info text and disabled buttons. While a page loads, keep the old `page` until data arrives, or pass `onPageChange: null` to disable the controls.

## Accessibility

The button group is a labelled container ("Pagination"); each icon button has its name and enabled state. The page field accepts digits only, commits on Enter or when it loses focus, clamps to the last page and restores the current page for empty or invalid input. The info text is a live region, so screen readers hear the new range. Selects announce their name and value.

## Motion

The "Showing 1-25 of 500" range cross-fades in 150ms when the page or page size changes; the outgoing text is hidden from screen readers and the live region announces the new one. Kumo's pagination has no page list, so there is no highlight to move: the page number field updates in place. The page size picker is a `KumoSelect` and the `dropdown` page selector a menu joined to the buttons; both open with the popover motion on wide screens and as a bottom sheet that follows the finger on narrow ones. Reduced motion swaps the range text in one frame.

## Mobile

Below 768px the compact layout keeps previous, the page field and next (about 150px) beside the info text, and moves the page size select under them, so it fits at 390px with 2x text. On touch, every button is 44x44. Chevrons mirror in RTL.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `page` / `setPage` | `page` / `onPageChange` |
| `perPage`, `totalCount`, `hasNextPage` | same names |
| `controls` | `controls` |
| `Pagination.Controls pageSelector` | `pageSelector` |
| `Pagination.PageSize value / onChange / options / label` | `perPage` / `onPerPageChange` / `perPageOptions` / `perPageLabel` |
| `Pagination.Info children`, legacy `text` | `infoBuilder` |
| `labels.pageNumber`, `labels.pageSize` | `pageNumberLabel`, `pageSizeLabel` |
| other `labels` | `KumoStrings` |
| `Pagination.Separator` | drawn between the info and the page size |

The compound layout is fixed (info, separator, page size, controls); `compact` is an addition for phones.

source: doc/components/KumoPopover.md

# KumoPopover

Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger: a notification list, a small settings form, a confirmation with buttons.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/popover

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoPopover(
  triggerBuilder: (context, popover) => KumoButton(
    icon: KumoIcons.bell,
    shape: KumoButtonShape.square,
    semanticLabel: 'Notifications',
    onPress: popover.toggle,
  ),
  children: const [
    KumoPopoverTitle('Notifications'),
    KumoPopoverDescription('No new alerts for example.com.'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use a popover when people interact with the content (links, buttons, inputs).
- For a short label on an icon button, use `KumoTooltip`. For a list of commands, use `KumoDropdownMenu`. For a preview on hover, use `KumoHoverCard`. For a blocking decision, use a dialog.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Stacked top to bottom (Kumo's `flex flex-col`), stretched to the popup width |
| `triggerBuilder` | `KumoPopoverTriggerBuilder?` | | `(context, popover) => Widget`; call `popover.toggle`, `open` or `close` |
| `trigger` | `Widget?` | | Non-interactive content made pressable. Pass exactly one of `trigger` and `triggerBuilder` |
| `open` | `bool?` | `null` | Controls the open state; null lets the popover manage it |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | Flips when there is no room |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `center` | |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `8` | The arrow sits in this gap |
| `alignOffset` | `double` | `0` | |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `true` | Kumo's `Popover.Arrow` |
| `width` | `double?` | `null` | Fixed width (Kumo demos use 288); null fits the content |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `360` | Upper bound when `width` is null |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | `symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12)` | Kumo's `px-4 py-3` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | first `KumoPopoverTitle` | Accessible name of the popup |
| `dismissOnOutsideTap` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `closeOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `onClosed` | `VoidCallback?` | | After the close animation |

### Parts

| Widget | Parameters | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KumoPopoverTitle` | `text` (positional) | 14px medium, 24px line height, announced as a header |
| `KumoPopoverDescription` | `text` (positional) | 14px subtle, 24px line height |
| `KumoPopoverClose` | `label` (default `KumoStrings.close`), `onPress`, `variant = secondary`, `size = sm`, `icon`, `alignment = centerStart` | A button that runs `onPress`, then closes |

`KumoPopover.closeFrom(context)` closes the popover from any widget inside it and returns false when there is none.

## Examples

### Close button

```dart
KumoPopover(
  triggerBuilder: (context, popover) => KumoButton(label: 'Cache settings', onPress: popover.toggle),
  children: [
    const KumoPopoverTitle('Browser cache TTL'),
    const KumoPopoverDescription('How long browsers keep cached files.'),
    const SizedBox(height: 12),
    KumoPopoverClose(label: 'Save', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: saveTtl),
  ],
)
```

### Placement

```dart
KumoPopover(
  side: KumoSide.right,
  align: KumoAlign.start,
  triggerBuilder: (context, popover) => KumoButton(label: 'Details', onPress: popover.toggle),
  children: const [KumoPopoverDescription('Opens to the right.')],
)
```

### Close from custom content

```dart
KumoPopover(
  width: 288,
  triggerBuilder: (context, popover) => KumoButton(label: 'Rename', onPress: popover.toggle),
  children: [
    Builder(
      builder: (context) => KumoButton(
        label: 'Apply',
        onPress: () {
          applyRename();
          KumoPopover.closeFrom(context);
        },
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The popup is a semantics container named by `semanticLabel` or its first title; the title is a header.
- Focus moves into the popover when it opens and Tab cycles inside it. Escape, an outside tap or a close button closes it, and focus returns to what had it before (the trigger, when opened from the keyboard).
- `trigger` slots announce as buttons with an expanded state.

## Motion

Kumo's popup motion: scale from 0.9 with a fade, anchored on the trigger, through `KumoAnchoredOverlay`'s spring; it closes along the same path and turns around if reopened mid-close. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

The popup stays inside the screen and the safe area, shifting along its edge; tall content scrolls inside the room it has. It does not switch to a sheet: on narrow screens keep popovers short, or use a sheet directly for long forms.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Popover.Root open / onOpenChange` | `open` / `onOpenChange` |
| `Popover.Trigger render={<Button/>}` | `triggerBuilder` |
| `Popover.Positioner side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset` | `side` / `align` / `sideOffset` / `alignOffset` |
| `Popover.Arrow` | `showArrow` |
| `Popover.Popup className="w-72"` | `width: 288` |
| `Popover.Title` / `Popover.Description` | `KumoPopoverTitle` / `KumoPopoverDescription` |
| `Popover.Close render={<Button/>}` | `KumoPopoverClose` |
| `Popover.Trigger openOnHover delay` | not ported; use `KumoHoverCard` |
| `Popover.Content anchor` (virtual anchor) | not ported |

source: doc/components/KumoPressable.md

# KumoPressable

The interaction primitive under every tappable Kumo component. Use it for custom rows, tiles and chips.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoPressable(
  onPress: () {},
  semanticLabel: 'Open image-resizer',
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(KumoRadius.lg),
  builder: (context, state) => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KumoSpace.s3),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: state.active ? context.kumo.colors.tint : context.kumo.colors.base,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(KumoRadius.lg),
    ),
    child: const KumoText('image-resizer'),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for any custom surface a finger or pointer activates. For standard actions use `KumoButton`; for menu rows use `KumoMenuRow`. Do not use `GestureDetector` or `InkWell` for tappable UI.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` / `builder` | `Widget?` / `KumoPressableBuilder?` | | One is required; `builder` receives `KumoPressState` (`hovered`, `pressed`, `focused`, `disabled`, `active`) |
| `onPress`, `onLongPress`, `onPressIn`, `onPressOut` | callbacks | | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Blocks presses without the disabled look |
| `borderRadius` | `BorderRadius` | `zero` | Shape of the focus ring |
| `focusRingColor` | `KumoColor` | `brand` | |
| `focusRingWidth`, `focusRingOffset` | `double` | `2`, `0` | |
| `showFocusRing` | `bool` | `true` | Off when the component draws its own focus treatment |
| `scaleOnPress`, `pressScale` | `bool`, `double` | `true`, `0.98` | |
| `haptic` | `KumoHaptic` | `none` | |
| `debounce` | `Duration` | `zero` | Ignore repeat presses inside the window |
| `minTapTargetSize` | `double?` | theme | 44 on touch, 0 with a mouse |
| `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint`, `semanticValue` | `String?` | | |
| `selected`, `toggled`, `checked`, `mixed`, `expanded`, `inMutuallyExclusiveGroup` | `bool?` | | Semantic state |
| `isButton`, `isLink` | `bool` | `true`, `false` | |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus`, `canRequestFocus` | | | `canRequestFocus: false` keeps it out of Tab order (roving groups) |
| `excludeChildSemantics`, `mergeChildSemantics` | `bool` | `false`, `true` | |

## Accessibility

Exposes button (or link) semantics with label and state, is focusable, activates with Enter and Space, and shows the focus ring only for keyboard focus.

## Motion

Pointer-down scales to `pressScale` with `KumoSprings.press`; release springs back from the current scale, so rapid taps never jump. Hover state switches instantly. Reduced motion turns the scale off.

## Mobile

On touch platforms the layout grows to at least 44x44 around the visual (centered), so small controls stay reachable.

source: doc/components/KumoProgress.md

# KumoProgress

Linear and circular progress for work that finishes: an upload, a deployment, a migration.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no progress component; this one is inspired by shadcn's progress and built from `KumoMeter`'s track and indicator tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoProgress(value: uploaded, max: total, label: 'Uploading assets', showValue: true)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when work is running and you know (or will soon know) how much is done. Pass a `value` whenever the amount is known. A null `value` is indeterminate: show it only while the work runs (preparing, waiting for the first byte) and replace or remove it when the work ends.

For a level that goes up and down (quota, storage) use `KumoMeter`. For a short wait inside a button use `KumoButton(loading: true)`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double?` | | Work done, 0 to `max`. Null is indeterminate |
| `max` | `double` | `100` | |
| `variant` | `KumoProgressVariant` | `linear` | `linear` or `circular` |
| `size` | `KumoProgressSize` | `base` | `sm` (4px track, 16px ring), `base` (8px, 24px), `lg` (12px, 40px) |
| `label` | `String?` | | What is in progress, 12px subtle text |
| `showValue` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the percentage. Ignored while indeterminate |
| `tone` | `KumoMeterTone` | `brand` | Indicator color: `brand`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a visible label. Defaults to `KumoStrings.loading` |

## Examples

### Preparing, then uploading

```dart
KumoProgress(
  value: preparing ? null : percent,
  label: preparing ? 'Preparing 1,204 objects' : 'Uploading to assets',
  showValue: true,
)
```

### Circular

```dart
const KumoProgress(value: 35, variant: KumoProgressVariant.circular, label: 'Migrating tables', showValue: true)
```

### Finished

```dart
const KumoProgress(value: 100, label: 'Uploaded to assets', showValue: true, tone: KumoMeterTone.success)
```

## Accessibility

One node with the label (or `semanticLabel`) and the percentage as its value. Indeterminate progress has no value. Write the finished state in the label ("Uploaded to assets") rather than relying on the green tone.

## Motion

Determinate changes ease from the current value (300ms ease-out). Switching between indeterminate and measured cross-fades the indicator (150ms). Linear indeterminate progress slides a 40% segment across the track every 1.5s; circular indeterminate progress is `KumoLoader`. Both loops run only while the widget is mounted and on screen (`TickerMode`), and only while `value` is null. Under reduced motion the linear track shows a still, half-strength bar, the ring a still arc, and swaps are instant.

## Mobile

The label wraps at 2x text; the percentage stays whole. The indeterminate segment travels toward the end edge in RTL.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | |
| shadcn `value` | `value` |
| shadcn indeterminate | `value: null` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoRadio.md
---

# KumoRadio

Kumo's `Radio.Item`: one option of a `KumoRadioGroup`. It is only valid as an item of a group, which supplies its selection, focus and appearance.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/radio

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoRadio(value: 'standard', label: 'Standard', description: 'Cached at every data center.')
```

## When to use / when not to

Always inside `KumoRadioGroup.items`. A lone radio makes no sense; for a single yes or no choice use `KumoCheckbox` or `KumoSwitch`. Placing a `KumoRadio` outside a group asserts in debug builds.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | required | The value the group reports when this item is chosen |
| `label` | `String` | required | Label text and accessible name |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label; `label` stays the accessible name |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the label (base and card appearances) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Skipped by arrow keys, dimmed to 50% |
| `variant` | `KumoRadioVariant?` | group's | `error` red ring for this item only |
| `appearance` | `KumoRadioAppearance?` | group's | Overrides a `base` or `card` group; `segmented` is group-only |

## Examples

### Mixed appearances

```dart
KumoRadioGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Origin',
  value: origin,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => origin = next),
  items: const [
    KumoRadio(value: 'r2', label: 'R2 bucket'),
    KumoRadio(
      value: 'custom',
      label: 'Custom origin',
      description: 'Any HTTPS server you run.',
      appearance: KumoRadioAppearance.card,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a radio button in a radio group with its checked state. See `KumoRadioGroup` for keyboard behavior.

## Motion

The 8px inner dot lands with `KumoCurves.bounce` (150ms) when selected, and the circle presses in to 0.9 with a press spring while the row is held. In a segmented group the selected fill slides between segments (see `KumoRadioGroup`). Static under reduced motion.

## Mobile

The circle stays 16px; the whole row is the hit area, padded to 44px tall on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` |
| `label` | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `appearance` | `appearance` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoRadioGroup.md

# KumoRadioGroup

Kumo's `Radio.Group`: a legend over mutually exclusive `KumoRadio` items, as circles, choice cards or a compact segmented bar.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/radio

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoRadioGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Caching level',
  value: level,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => level = next),
  items: const [
    KumoRadio(value: 'basic', label: 'No query string'),
    KumoRadio(value: 'simplified', label: 'Ignore query string'),
    KumoRadio(value: 'aggressive', label: 'Standard'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a radio group for exactly one choice out of a few visible options. Use `segmented` only for a small group of short labels that fits on one line (`1h`, `12h`, `24h`); use the default appearance for long labels, descriptions, many options or narrow layouts. When the choice switches which content panel is shown, use tabs. For many options, use a select.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoRadio<T>>` | required | The options |
| `value` | `T?` | required | Selected value; null for none |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<T>?` | | Called with the newly selected value. Null disables the group |
| `legend` | `String?` | | Group title (14px medium) |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Keep the legend for screen readers only |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the items |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error under the items (announced). Items switch to the error ring |
| `orientation` | `Axis` | `vertical` | `horizontal` wraps items in rows; cards become a two-column grid. Segmented is always one row |
| `appearance` | `KumoRadioAppearance` | `base` | `base`, `card`, `segmented` |
| `controlPosition` | `KumoRadioControlPosition?` | `start`, `end` for cards | Circle before or after the label |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every item |

See `KumoRadio` for the item parameters.

## Examples

### Segmented

```dart
KumoRadioGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Time range',
  appearance: KumoRadioAppearance.segmented,
  value: range,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => range = next),
  items: const [
    KumoRadio(value: '1h', label: '1h'),
    KumoRadio(value: '12h', label: '12h'),
    KumoRadio(value: '24h', label: '24h'),
  ],
)
```

### Cards

```dart
KumoRadioGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Plan',
  appearance: KumoRadioAppearance.card,
  value: plan,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => plan = next),
  items: const [
    KumoRadio(value: 'free', label: 'Free', description: 'For personal projects and testing.'),
    KumoRadio(value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'Image optimization and more page rules.'),
  ],
)
```

### Error

```dart
KumoRadioGroup<String>(
  legend: 'Data localization region',
  error: region == null ? 'Choose where logs are stored.' : null,
  value: region,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => region = next),
  items: const [
    KumoRadio(value: 'us', label: 'United States'),
    KumoRadio(value: 'eu', label: 'European Union'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The items sit in a radio group; each is announced as a radio button with its checked state and label.
- Tab reaches the group once: at the selected item, or the first enabled item when nothing is selected. Tab again leaves the group.
- Arrow keys move the selection to the previous or next enabled item, wrapping at the ends (Left and Right are mirrored in RTL). Home and End select the first and last enabled items. Disabled items are skipped.
- Keyboard focus draws a 2px brand ring on the circle (inside the segment for segmented groups).

## Motion

- Base and card items: the inner dot lands with `KumoCurves.bounce` over 150ms when an item becomes selected and disappears at once from the old item. The circle presses in to 0.9 on pointer-down.
- Segmented: the dark fill slides from the previous segment to the new one with `KumoSprings.standard`, starting from where it is, so a tap mid-slide retargets it without a jump. Labels blend from the default to the inverse color as the fill covers them, and the seams hide while the fill passes. Clearing or setting the value from none fades the fill in place. A selection haptic marks each change.
- Reduced motion: the dot appears at once, the circle does not scale, and the segmented fill moves at once.

## Mobile

Rows are padded to 44px hit areas on touch (single-line rows drop the 8px gap; rows with descriptions keep it). Segmented bars keep Kumo's 34px visual height while each segment's hit area extends to 44px above and below. A segmented bar never wraps; when it is wider than the screen it scrolls sideways instead of overflowing.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `legend` / `Radio.Legend` | `legend` |
| `Radio.Legend className="sr-only"` | `hideLegend: true` |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `value` (controlled only) |
| `onValueChange(value, details)` | `onValueChange(value)` |
| `orientation` | `orientation` (`Axis`) |
| `appearance` | `appearance` |
| `controlPosition` | `controlPosition` |
| `error`, `description`, `disabled` | same |
| `name` | not ported (no HTML forms) |
| `Radio.Item` | `KumoRadio` |

source: doc/components/KumoResourceList.md
---

# KumoResourceList

The page for a list of resources (Workers, buckets, namespaces): a title with an icon and description, resource cards with metadata, status and actions, an aside for usage notes, and loading, empty and error states.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/blocks/resource-list

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoResourceList(
  title: 'KV namespaces',
  description: 'Store key-value data globally with low-latency reads.',
  icon: KumoIcons.database,
  actions: [KumoButton(label: 'Create namespace', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {})],
  children: [
    KumoResourceListItem(
      title: 'production-cache',
      mono: true,
      metadata: const ['Created 2 days ago', 'Bound to 3 Workers'],
      status: const KumoResourceListStatus(label: 'Active', tone: KumoResourceListStatusTone.success),
      actions: [KumoButton(label: 'View keys', size: KumoButtonSize.sm, onPress: () {})],
      onPress: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a top-level list of things a user owns. For dense, sortable data with many columns, put a table in `children` instead of item cards. It scrolls by itself; pass `scrollable: false` when it sits in a scroll view already.

## Parameters

### KumoResourceList

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` | | 30px semibold, the level 1 heading |
| `description` | `String?` | | 16px subtle; shown from 768px up, as in Kumo |
| `icon` / `iconWidget` | `IconData?` / `Widget?` | | 32px subtle icon before the title |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `[]` | After the title; wrap below it under 768px |
| `usage` | `Widget?` | | Aside: a quick start or snippet |
| `additionalContent` | `Widget?` | | Aside: links, limits |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | `[]` | Usually `KumoResourceListItem`s, 16px apart. Give each a `Key` (the resource ID) and added or removed cards grow in or collapse out |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Placeholder cards in place of `children` |
| `loadingLabel` | `String?` | `'Loading'` | Announced while loading |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error panel in place of the list; say what failed |
| `onRetry` | `VoidCallback?` | | Shows a retry button in the error panel |
| `retryLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.retry` ("Retry") | Label of the error state's retry button |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | `KumoResourceListEmpty()` | Shown when `children` is empty |
| `scrollable` | `bool` | `true` | Wrap in a vertical scroll view |
| `controller` | `ScrollController?` | | |

Precedence: `loading`, then `error`, then `empty`, then `children`.

### KumoResourceListItem

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | One line, truncates |
| `metadata` | `List<String>` | `[]` | Joined with a middle dot under the title |
| `status` | `KumoResourceListStatus?` | | `label`, `tone` (`neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`), optional `icon` |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` | `[]` | Stay separate targets from the card |
| `leading` | `Widget?` | | Before the title |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the card a button |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `title` | |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace title for IDs and hostnames |

### KumoResourceListEmpty

`title` (default `'No resources yet'`), `description`, `icon` (default folder), `action`.

## Examples

### States

```dart
KumoResourceList(
  title: 'R2 buckets',
  loading: loading,
  error: failed ? 'Could not load buckets. Check your connection and try again.' : null,
  onRetry: reload,
  empty: KumoResourceListEmpty(
    title: 'No buckets yet',
    description: 'Create a bucket to store objects without egress fees.',
    action: KumoButton(label: 'Create bucket', variant: KumoButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
  ),
  children: const [],
)
```

### With an aside

```dart
KumoResourceList(
  title: 'API tokens',
  usage: const KumoLayerCard(child: KumoText('Send the token in the Authorization header.')),
  additionalContent: const KumoLayerCard(child: KumoText('Tokens can be scoped to one zone.')),
  children: const [KumoResourceListItem(title: 'Deploy Workers')],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The title is the level 1 heading; empty-state titles are headings too.
- Status pairs color with an icon and text.
- A pressable card is one button named by its title; its action buttons stay separately reachable.
- Loading and error states are live regions, so screen readers hear the change.

## Motion

- Pressable cards scale to 0.98 on press; hover tint is instant. Placeholders do not shimmer.
- Loading, error, empty and the list cross-fade over 150ms while the space they take eases to its new height over 200ms, so the page never flashes between states.
- With keyed `children`, a removed card fades and collapses over 200ms and the cards below slide up, gap included; an added card grows in the same way. A card that comes back while leaving turns around from where it is.
- Reduced motion: state changes and card removals happen in one frame.

## Mobile

Page padding is 24px below 768px, 32px from 768px and 40px from 1024px. Below 480px of card width, status and actions move under the title. Below 1280px the `usage` aside moves above the list and `additionalContent` below it.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo `ResourceListPage` | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `description`, `icon` | `title`, `description`, `icon` / `iconWidget` |
| `usage`, `additionalContent` | `usage`, `additionalContent` |
| `children` | `children` |
| (not in Kumo) | `actions`, `loading`, `error`, `onRetry`, `empty`, `KumoResourceListItem` |

# KumoSankeyChart

A Sankey diagram: flows between nodes, each link as wide as its value. Kumo's `SankeyChart`, laid out with the d3/ECharts Sankey algorithm and drawn with `CustomPainter`.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts/sankey

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoSankeyChart(
  height: 300,
  nodes: [
    KumoSankeyNode(name: 'Users'),
    KumoSankeyNode(name: 'Devices'),
    KumoSankeyNode(name: 'Workers'),
    KumoSankeyNode(name: 'Tunnels'),
  ],
  links: [
    KumoSankeyLink(source: 0, target: 2, value: 80000),
    KumoSankeyLink(source: 0, target: 3, value: 23600),
    KumoSankeyLink(source: 1, target: 2, value: 42600),
    KumoSankeyLink(source: 1, target: 3, value: 8200),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show how a total splits and recombines across stages: traffic by source and destination, requests by method and status. For values over time use `KumoTimeseriesChart`; for a single split, a bar or meter reads faster.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `List<KumoSankeyNode>` | required | `name`, optional `id`, `color`, `value`, `tooltipData` |
| `links` | `List<KumoSankeyLink>` | required | `source`, `target` (indexes into `nodes`), `value`, optional `id` |
| `height` | `double` | `400` | |
| `nodeWidth` | `double` | `8` | Node bar thickness |
| `nodePadding` | `double` | `10` | Gap between nodes in a column |
| `showTooltip` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `showNodeValues` | `bool?` | true when any node has a value | Value with each label |
| `nodeLabelLayout` | `KumoSankeyLabelLayout` | `stacked` | `stacked` (value over name) or `inline` |
| `formatValue` | `String Function(double)?` | grouped digits | Node and link values |
| `tooltipBuilder` | `Widget? Function(BuildContext, KumoSankeyTooltipDetails)?` | | Custom tooltip content; return null to hide |
| `defaultNodeColor` | `Color?` | | Before the categorical palette |
| `left` / `right` | `double` | `0` | Horizontal padding in px |
| `linkColor` | `KumoSankeyLinkColor` | `gradient` | `gradient` (source to target) or `gray` |
| `linkOpacity` | `double` | `0.5` | Gradient link opacity |
| `nodeAlign` | `KumoSankeyNodeAlign` | `justify` | `justify`, `left`, `right` |
| `focus` | `KumoSankeyFocus` | `adjacency` | Highlight neighbours, or the whole `path` through a node |
| `onNodePress` | `void Function(KumoSankeyNode, int)?` | | |
| `onLinkPress` | `void Function(KumoSankeyLink)?` | | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Skeleton of nodes and flows |
| `error` / `onRetry` | `String?` / `VoidCallback?` | | Error state with a Retry button |
| `emptyMessage` | `String` | `'No flows to show'` | When no link is valid |
| `emptyDescription` | `String?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Leads the screen reader summary |

A node is as tall as the larger of its inflows and outflows (or its `value`, if larger). Links with an out-of-range index, a self link or a value of zero or less are skipped. Nodes without links are not drawn.

## Examples

### Path highlighting and gray links

```dart
KumoSankeyChart(
  nodes: nodes,
  links: links,
  focus: KumoSankeyFocus.path,
  linkColor: KumoSankeyLinkColor.gray,
  nodeLabelLayout: KumoSankeyLabelLayout.inline,
)
```

### Drill down on press

```dart
KumoSankeyChart(
  nodes: nodes,
  links: links,
  onNodePress: (node, index) => setState(() => selected = node.name),
  tooltipBuilder: (context, details) => details.isNode ? KumoText(details.node!.name) : null,
)
```

## Accessibility

One semantics node summarises the diagram ("Sankey chart, 8 nodes, 12 flows. Users to Apps: 80,000. ...") so every flow is readable without the picture. With keyboard focus, arrow keys move between nodes in column order, the value reads the node with its inflows and outflows, Enter or Space calls `onNodePress` and Escape clears.

## Motion

Changing nodes or links morphs node positions and link widths from the current layout over 300ms (new nodes fade in). Hovering or pressing a node or link eases the other flows down and the highlighted ones up (150ms), from wherever they are, so moving across the diagram never flickers. The skeleton, diagram, error and empty message cross-fade (150ms). All of it is instant under reduced motion.

## Mobile

Tap a node or flow to highlight it and show its tooltip above the finger; tap outside to clear. Labels of nodes in the right half sit to the left of the node so nothing runs off a phone screen. Labels grow with text scale and truncate to the column gap.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `echarts` | (not needed) |
| `nodes`, `links`, `height`, `nodeWidth`, `nodePadding` | same |
| `showTooltip`, `showNodeValues`, `nodeLabelLayout`, `formatValue` | same |
| `tooltipFormatter` (HTML string) | `tooltipBuilder` (widget) |
| `defaultNodeColor`, `left`, `right`, `linkColor`, `linkOpacity` | same (`left`/`right` in px) |
| `onNodeClick(node)` | `onNodePress(node, index)` |
| `onLinkClick(link)` | `onLinkPress(link)` |
| `isDarkMode`, `className` | follows `KumoTheme` |
| (ECharts `nodeAlign`, `emphasis.focus`) | `nodeAlign`, `focus` |

# KumoSelect

A field-styled trigger that opens a list of options. Reach for it when the user picks one value (or a few) from a known list: a region, a plan, an environment.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/select

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSelect<String>(
  label: 'Region',
  placeholder: 'Choose a region',
  value: region,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => region = v),
  options: const [
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'enam', label: 'Eastern North America'),
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'weur', label: 'Western Europe'),
    KumoSelectOption(value: 'apac', label: 'Asia Pacific'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a closed list of up to a few thousand options where the user knows what they want.
- When the user should search by typing, use `KumoCombobox`. When any text is acceptable and options are only suggestions, use `KumoAutocomplete`.
- For two to five options that should all be visible, use a radio group or segmented tabs.
- For actions (Rename, Delete), use `KumoDropdownMenu`; a select holds a value.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<KumoSelectItem<T>>` | required | `KumoSelectOption`, `KumoSelectGroup` and `KumoSelectSeparator` entries in display order |
| `value` | `T?` | `null` | Chosen value (single). Null shows `placeholder`. Compared with `==` |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | | Called with the picked value |
| `values` | `List<T>` | required in `.multiple` | Chosen values, in pick order |
| `onValuesChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | | `.multiple` only: next list after a toggle |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | `xs` 20, `sm` 26, `base` 36, `lg` 40 px tall |
| `label` | `String?` | | Visible label; also the accessible name |
| `description` | `String?` | | Help text under the trigger |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error text under the trigger; red ring; announced |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon with a tooltip after the label |
| `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | Shows "(optional)" after the label |
| `required` | `bool` | `false` | Announces the field as required |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Shown while nothing is chosen |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Skeleton in the trigger; cannot open |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dimmed; cannot open |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | `auto` uses a bottom sheet below 768px; `popover` or `sheet` force one |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `bottom` | Flips when there is no room |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `start` | |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `4` | Gap between trigger and list |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | `null` | Caps the list; by default it may use all the room on its side |
| `renderValue` | `KumoSelectValueBuilder<T>?` | | `(context, selected) => Widget` for the trigger; `selected` is never empty |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a visible label (Kumo's `aria-label`) |
| `sheetTitle` | `String?` | `label` | Heading at the top of the sheet |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

### Option types

| Type | Parameters | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KumoSelectOption<T>` | `value`, `label`, `description`, `icon`, `disabled`, `keywords` | `KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(['a', 'b'])` builds string options |
| `KumoSelectGroup<T>` | `label`, `options` | Heading plus its options |
| `KumoSelectSeparator<T>` | | Hairline between options |

## Examples

### Groups, separators and disabled options

```dart
KumoSelect<String>(
  label: 'Region',
  value: region,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => region = v),
  options: const [
    KumoSelectGroup(label: 'Americas', options: [
      KumoSelectOption(value: 'enam', label: 'Eastern North America', icon: KumoIcons.globeHemisphereWest),
      KumoSelectOption(value: 'sam', label: 'South America', disabled: true),
    ]),
    KumoSelectSeparator(),
    KumoSelectGroup(label: 'Europe', options: [
      KumoSelectOption(value: 'weur', label: 'Western Europe', description: 'London, Paris, Amsterdam'),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

### Multiple with a summary

```dart
KumoSelect<String>.multiple(
  label: 'Visible columns',
  values: columns,
  onValuesChange: (v) => setState(() => columns = v),
  options: KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(['Name', 'Route', 'Status', 'Last deploy', 'Requests']),
  renderValue: (context, selected) => Text(
    selected.length > 3
        ? '${selected.take(2).map((o) => o.label).join(', ')} and ${selected.length - 2} more'
        : selected.map((o) => o.label).join(', '),
  ),
)
```

### Loading

```dart
KumoSelect<String>(
  label: 'Zone',
  placeholder: 'Choose a zone',
  loading: zones == null,
  options: KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(zones ?? const []),
  value: zone,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => zone = v),
)
```

### Error and sizes

```dart
KumoSelect<String>(
  size: KumoFieldSize.sm,
  label: 'Environment',
  error: environment == null ? 'Choose an environment to deploy to' : null,
  options: KumoSelectOption.fromLabels(['production', 'staging']),
  value: environment,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => environment = v),
)
```

### Thousands of options

Lists longer than 100 rows are built lazily with measured row heights, so they open at once and jump to any row (the current value, End) without building the rows in between. Nothing changes in the API:

```dart
KumoSelect<String>(
  label: 'Worker',
  options: [for (final w in workers) KumoSelectOption(value: w, label: w)],
  value: worker,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => worker = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a button with the label as its name, the selection as its value and an expanded state.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the trigger. Enter, Space, Up or Down open the list. In the list, Up and Down move the highlight (skipping disabled options), Home and End (and Page Up/Down) jump to the ends, Enter or Space picks, Escape closes, Tab closes and moves on. Typing letters jumps to the next option that starts with them; typing the same letter again cycles. With the list closed, typing letters picks the match directly, like a native select.
- Focus never leaves the trigger while the list is open, so it is where the user left it after closing.
- Multiple-select rows are announced as checked or unchecked; single-select rows as selected.
- The error message is a live region.

## Motion

The list scales in from the trigger and fades (Kumo's 150ms popup motion, as a spring that reverses mid-flight). Under reduced motion it only fades. The trigger's value cross-fades over 100ms when it changes. The caret is Kumo's up-down caret, which is symmetric, so it does not rotate. The loading placeholder is a static `KumoSkeletonLine`. The sheet follows the finger, snaps by release velocity and dismisses with a downward flick; picking in the sheet fires a selection haptic. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

Below 768px the list opens in a bottom sheet with the label as its title and the current option checked. Rows are 40px tall and the trigger's hit area is 44px on touch platforms. Force either presentation with `presentation`. The trigger fills its parent's width; inside a `Row` without bounds it takes Kumo's default width for its size (160, 200, 280, 320).

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` / `Select.Option` | `options` with `KumoSelectOption` |
| `Select.Group` + `Select.GroupLabel` | `KumoSelectGroup(label:, options:)` |
| `Select.Separator` | `KumoSelectSeparator()` |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `multiple` | `KumoSelect.multiple(values:, onValuesChange:)` |
| `renderValue` | `renderValue` (receives the selected options) |
| `size` | `size` (`KumoFieldSize`) |
| `label`, `description`, `error`, `labelTooltip` | same names |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| `placeholder`, `loading`, `disabled` | same names |
| `side`, `align`, `sideOffset` | same names |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `isItemEqualToValue` | value `==` |
| `alignItemWithTrigger`, `container` | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/KumoSensitiveInput.md
---

# KumoSensitiveInput

Kumo's `SensitiveInput`: a field for secrets (API tokens, signing keys, passwords) that shows a mask until it is tapped, with a hide toggle and a copy button.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/sensitive-input

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSensitiveInput(
  label: 'API token',
  value: token,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => token = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show or edit a secret the user may need to read or copy once: an API token, a webhook secret, an environment variable marked secret. For a login password that the user types and never reads back, a `KumoInput` with `obscureText: true` and `autofillHints: [AutofillHints.password]` works better with password managers.

## Behavior

| State | Shown | Changes to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Masked | Eight dots, whatever the length; "Click to reveal" (mouse) or "Tap to reveal" (touch) on hover or focus | Revealed on tap, Enter or Space; the field gets focus |
| Revealed | The value in a normal text field, with a hide button | Masked on the hide button, Escape (focus stays on the field), or when focus leaves the field |
| Empty | A normal empty text field | Revealed as soon as something is typed |

A new value from outside (a rolled token) is masked unless the field has focus. Copying never reveals the value.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | | The secret. Null leaves the field uncontrolled |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `controller`, `focusNode` | | | |
| `onCopy` | `VoidCallback?` | | Called after the value is on the clipboard |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text above; also the accessible name |
| `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | As in `KumoInput` |
| `required`, `showOptional` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Shown in the empty state |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Sensitive value'` | Accessible name without a `label` |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Cannot reveal or copy |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Reveal and copy, no editing |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace, which keeps similar characters in tokens apart |
| `revealText` | `String?` | `'Click to reveal'` / `'Tap to reveal'` | Shown over the mask and read as the hint |
| `hiddenAnnouncement` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.valueHidden` | Announced when the value is masked again |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `(20, 56, 20, 56)` | |

The copy and hide buttons are named from `KumoStrings` (`copy`, `copied`, `hide`), and the copy result is announced with `copied` or `copyFailed`.

## Examples

### Copy feedback

```dart
KumoSensitiveInput(
  label: 'Webhook secret',
  value: secret,
  mono: true,
  onCopy: () => setState(() => copies++),
)
```

### States

```dart
Column(children: const [
  KumoSensitiveInput(label: 'Signing key', value: 'invalid-key', error: 'This key is not valid for the zone.'),
  KumoSensitiveInput(label: 'Disabled', value: 'cannot-edit', disabled: true),
  KumoSensitiveInput(label: 'Read-only', value: 'view-only-secret', readOnly: true),
  KumoSensitiveInput(label: 'Webhook secret', placeholder: 'Paste the secret from your provider'),
])
```

### Sizes

```dart
Column(children: [
  for (final s in KumoFieldSize.values) KumoSensitiveInput(size: s, label: '${s.name} size', value: 'secret-api-key-123'),
])
```

## Accessibility

- Masked, the field is a button named by the label with the reveal text as its hint; the secret is not in the semantics tree.
- Revealed, it is a text field named by the label, with suggestions and autocorrect off and the `visiblePassword` keyboard so the keyboard does not learn the secret.
- Hiding announces `hiddenAnnouncement`; copying announces "Copied".
- Keyboard: Tab to the field, Enter or Space to reveal, Escape to mask, Tab to the hide and copy buttons.

## Motion

Revealing and masking fade the new text in over 100ms instead of flashing it. The mouse Copy tab fades in over 100ms on hover and focus. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once. Under reduced motion every change is instant.

## Mobile

- With a mouse, the Copy tab sits on the field's top edge as in Kumo. On touch, where there is no hover, a copy button sits inside the field next to the hide button, each with a 44px-wide hit area.
- Tap the mask to reveal and focus; the keyboard opens only when the field is editable.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `value` / `controller` |
| `onValueChange`, `onChange` | `onValueChange` |
| `onCopy` | `onCopy` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `variant="error"` (deprecated) | `error` |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | same names |
| `required={false}` | `showOptional: true` |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | same names |
| `autoComplete="off"` | always off |
| "Click to reveal" | `revealText` |

# KumoSeparator

A 1px hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centered label.

Kumo reference: none as a component. It is the `h-px bg-kumo-hairline` divider Kumo's dropdown menu uses between groups.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoSeparator()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it between sections of a card, panel or form. Prefer spacing alone when the groups are already clearly apart; a line is for content that would otherwise run together. Inside menus use `KumoMenuSeparator`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `KumoSeparatorOrientation` | `horizontal` | Use `KumoSeparator.vertical()` for vertical |
| `label` | `String?` | | Short text centered in a horizontal line (12px subtle). Wraps when long |
| `length` | `double?` | | Fixed extent along the line. Null fills the parent |
| `color` | `KumoColor` | `hairline` | `line` gives a stronger divider |
| `thickness` | `double` | `1` | |

## Examples

### With a label

```dart
const KumoSeparator(label: 'or sign in with an API token')
```

### Vertical, in a toolbar

```dart
const IntrinsicHeight(
  child: Row(children: [
    KumoText('Workers'),
    SizedBox(width: 12),
    KumoSeparator.vertical(),
    SizedBox(width: 12),
    KumoText('Pages'),
  ]),
)
```

## Accessibility

The line is decorative and hidden from screen readers; a `label` is read as text.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

A horizontal separator fills the width it is given. A vertical one fills the height its parent gives it: wrap the row in `IntrinsicHeight` or pass `length`.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<div className="h-px bg-kumo-hairline" />` | `KumoSeparator()` |

# KumoSheet

A sheet attached to a screen edge that follows the finger. Open one with `showKumoSheet`.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Future<void> pickRegion(BuildContext context) async {
  final region = await showKumoSheet<String>(
    context: context,
    semanticLabel: 'Choose a region',
    builder: (context) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KumoSpace.s4),
      child: KumoButton(label: 'Use Frankfurt', block: true, onPress: () => KumoSheetScope.closeFrom(context, 'fra')),
    ),
  );
  debugPrint(region);
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Use sheets for short tasks and choices on phones. Menus, selects and pickers already switch to a sheet below 768px. For confirmations on wide screens use a dialog.

## Parameters (`showKumoSheet`)

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context`, `builder` | | required | |
| `edge` | `KumoSheetEdge` | `bottom` | `bottom`, `top`, `start`, `end` |
| `snapPoints` | `List<double>?` | | Heights as fractions of the screen; null sizes to content |
| `initialSnapPointIndex` | `int?` | | |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `true` | Drag, flick, scrim tap and Escape close it |
| `showHandle` | `bool` | `true` | `KumoSheetHandle` on bottom sheets |
| `maxExtentFraction` | `double` | `0.85` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the sheet for screen readers |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

`KumoSheetScope.closeFrom(context, [result])` closes the sheet from inside it, or pops its route from the builder's context.

## Accessibility

The sheet scopes the route for screen readers, traps focus and returns it on close. The handle is a "Close" button for screen reader users. Escape closes.

## Motion

The sheet springs in from its edge. A drag follows the finger 1:1 and rubberbands past the open position. On release, the velocity is projected to choose a snap point or dismissal; a flick toward the edge dismisses, a push back keeps it open. Scrolling content hands off to the sheet at its top. It leaves along the path it came in on. Reduced motion fades instead.

## Mobile

Respects the safe area and keeps content above the home indicator.

source: doc/components/KumoSidebar.md

# KumoSidebar

App navigation: a header, scrolling groups of rows with icons, badges and nested collapsible sections, and a footer with the collapse button. Collapses to a 57px icon rail.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/sidebar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSidebar(
  header: const KumoSidebarHeader(children: [
    KumoIcon(KumoIcons.cubeFill, color: KumoColor.brand),
    Expanded(child: KumoText('Acme Inc', bold: true, truncate: true)),
  ]),
  footer: const KumoSidebarFooter(children: [KumoSidebarTrigger()]),
  child: KumoSidebarContent(children: [
    KumoSidebarGroup(children: [
      KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.house, label: 'Account home', active: true, onPress: () {}),
      KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.chartBar, label: 'Analytics and logs', onPress: () {}),
    ]),
    KumoSidebarGroup(label: 'Build', children: [
      KumoSidebarCollapsible(
        icon: KumoIcons.code,
        label: 'Compute',
        initialOpen: true,
        children: [
          KumoSidebarMenuSubButton(label: 'Workers', active: true, onPress: () {}),
          KumoSidebarMenuSubButton(label: 'Containers', badge: 'Beta', onPress: () {}),
        ],
      ),
    ]),
  ]),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for an app's primary navigation. For a whole app frame that switches between a persistent sidebar, an icon rail and a phone drawer, put it in a `KumoAppShell` instead of laying it out yourself. For a handful of sections inside one page, use tabs.

## Parameters

### KumoSidebar

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Body between header and footer: `KumoSidebarContent` or `KumoSidebarSlidingViews` |
| `header` | `Widget?` | | Usually `KumoSidebarHeader` |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Usually `KumoSidebarFooter` |
| `open` | `bool?` | null | Expanded (true) or collapsed. Null keeps the state inside, starting from `initialOpen` |
| `initialOpen` | `bool` | `true` | Uncontrolled start state |
| `onOpenChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Called by the trigger, the resize handle and collapsible rows in the rail |
| `onOpenChangeComplete` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | After the width animation settles (immediately under reduced motion) |
| `side` | `KumoSidebarSide` | `start` | `start` or `end`; follows text direction |
| `variant` | `KumoSidebarVariant` | `sidebar` | `sidebar` (end border) or `floating` (8px inset, rounded, ring and shadow) |
| `collapsible` | `KumoSidebarCollapseMode` | `icon` | `icon` (57px rail), `offcanvas` (0px), `none` |
| `width` | `double` | `260` | Expanded width (`KumoSidebar.defaultWidth`) |
| `collapsedWidth` | `double` | `57` | Rail width (`KumoSidebar.iconWidth`) |
| `minWidth` / `maxWidth` | `double` | `200` / `480` | Resize limits; dragging below `minWidth` collapses |
| `onWidthChange` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | | Shows a resize handle on the inner edge. Hold the width in your state and pass it back as `width` |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows `KumoSidebarLoading` in place of `child` |
| `loadingLabel` | `String?` | `'Loading'` | Announced while loading |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.navigation` ("Navigation") | Name of the navigation region |
| `animationDuration` | `Duration` | 250ms | Collapse and expand duration |

`KumoSidebar.of(context)` / `maybeOf(context)` return `KumoSidebarData`: `open`, `collapsed`, `drawer`, `side`, `collapse` (animation, 0 expanded to 1 collapsed), `toggle()`, `setOpen(bool)`, `close` (drawer only).

### Parts

| Part | Key parameters |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoSidebarHeader` | `children` (row, 4px gap), `padding` (12px). 58px min height, bottom border |
| `KumoSidebarContent` | `children` (groups), `controller`. Scrolls; rows fade under the edges while more is hidden |
| `KumoSidebarGroup` | `label` (`String?`), `children`. The label folds into a divider in the rail; the first group has no divider |
| `KumoSidebarMenuButton` | `label`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `active`, `onPress`, `badge`, `trailing`, `tooltip` (defaults to `label`), `size` (`base` 34px, `sm` 28px), `disabled`, `isLink`, `semanticLabel`, `focusNode` |
| `KumoSidebarCollapsible` | `label`, `children`, `icon`, `badge`, `open` (`bool?`), `initialOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `onOpenChangeComplete`, `autoScrollOnOpen`. Nest one inside another for a second level |
| `KumoSidebarMenuSub` | `children`: an indented list with a guide line (collapsibles wrap their children in one) |
| `KumoSidebarMenuSubButton` | `label`, `active`, `onPress`, `badge`, `trailing`, `disabled`, `isLink` |
| `KumoSidebarMenuBadge` | `text`: dashed pill, also reachable through the `badge` parameters |
| `KumoSidebarSeparator` | Divider between sections |
| `KumoSidebarFooter` | `children` (row, 16px gap). 48px min height, top border |
| `KumoSidebarTrigger` | `onPress`, `collapseLabel`, `expandLabel`. Panel icon whose divider slides with the sidebar |
| `KumoSidebarClose` | `semanticLabel`. X button that closes the drawer; renders nothing outside a drawer |
| `KumoSidebarLoading` | `label`. Still placeholder rows |
| `KumoSidebarSlidingViews` | `activeKey`, `children` (`KumoSidebarSlidingView(value:, child:)`) |
| `KumoSidebarHost` | For custom shells: `open`, `onOpenChange`, `drawer`, `drawerWidth`, `onClose`, `onNavigate` |

## Examples

### Controlled collapse

```dart
KumoSidebar(
  open: expanded,
  onOpenChange: (v) => setState(() => expanded = v),
  onOpenChangeComplete: (open) => debugPrint(open ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed'),
  footer: const KumoSidebarFooter(children: [KumoSidebarTrigger()]),
  child: const KumoSidebarContent(children: []),
)
```

### Loading

```dart
const KumoSidebar(loading: true, loadingLabel: 'Loading navigation', child: SizedBox())
```

### Resizable

```dart
KumoSidebar(
  width: width,
  minWidth: 180,
  maxWidth: 400,
  onWidthChange: (w) => setState(() => width = w),
  child: const KumoSidebarContent(children: []),
)
```

### Sliding views (account and zone)

```dart
KumoSidebarSlidingViews(
  activeKey: surface,
  children: [
    KumoSidebarSlidingView(
      value: 'account',
      child: KumoSidebarContent(children: [
        KumoSidebarGroup(children: [
          KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.globe, label: 'Domains', onPress: () => setState(() => surface = 'zone')),
        ]),
      ]),
    ),
    KumoSidebarSlidingView(
      value: 'zone',
      child: KumoSidebarContent(children: [
        KumoSidebarGroup(label: 'example.com', children: [
          KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon: KumoIcons.arrowLeft, label: 'All domains', onPress: () => setState(() => surface = 'account')),
        ]),
      ]),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The sidebar is a semantics region named `semanticLabel` (`KumoStrings.navigation`, "Navigation" in English).
- Rows are buttons (or links with `isLink`); the active row is announced as selected. Collapsible triggers announce expanded or collapsed. Collapsed rows keep their full label for screen readers.
- Tab moves through rows, Up and Down arrows move between rows (text fields keep their arrows), Enter and Space activate. Tabbing onto a collapsible opens it; it closes when focus leaves unless it was opened on purpose or holds the active row.
- Hidden sub rows and inactive sliding views are removed from focus, taps and the semantics tree.
- The resize handle is an adjustable slider ("Resize sidebar"): arrows change the width by 10px, Home collapses, End goes to `maxWidth`.
- Badges are text, not color.

## Motion

- Collapse animates the width over 250ms with Kumo's sidebar easing (`cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1)`). The content keeps its expanded size and is clipped, so labels never re-wrap; rows narrow into 34px icon tiles and group labels fold into dividers alongside.
- Collapsible sections reveal their rows with a clip over 250ms. The chevron turns with the same animation, so it stays in step with the rows and reverses with them when a section is toggled mid-flight.
- When the active row changes inside a `KumoSidebarContent`, the tint travels from the old row to the new one over 200ms (`KumoCurves.standard`) and hands over when it lands; a change mid-flight turns it around from where it is. At rest each active row paints its own tint, so collapsing and scrolling never leave it behind.
- Sliding views slide sideways over 250ms.
- Hover tints are instant. Rows scale to 0.98 on press.
- Reduced motion: every change is instant (the active tint moves at once) and `onOpenChangeComplete` fires right away.

## Mobile

- On touch platforms rows grow to 44px tall; the visual tile stays 34px.
- Inside `KumoAppShell` on narrow screens the sidebar becomes a drawer: always expanded, no resize handle, the trigger and `KumoSidebarClose` close it, and pressing a row closes it.
- The sidebar pads its own top and bottom safe areas.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `Sidebar.Provider` `defaultOpen` / `open` / `onOpenChange` | `KumoSidebar(initialOpen:, open:, onOpenChange:)` |
| `onOpenChangeComplete` | `onOpenChangeComplete` |
| `variant="sidebar" \| "floating"` | `KumoSidebarVariant.sidebar` / `.floating` |
| `variant="inset"` | not ported (only changes the page background) |
| `collapsible="icon" \| "offcanvas" \| "none"` | `KumoSidebarCollapseMode` |
| `side="left" \| "right"` | `KumoSidebarSide.start` / `.end` |
| `resizable`, `defaultWidth`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `onWidthChange` | `onWidthChange` + `width`, `minWidth`, `maxWidth` |
| `mobileBreakpoint`, `fullScreenOnMobile` | `KumoAppShell(narrowBreakpoint:, fullScreenDrawer:)` |
| `peekable` | not ported |
| `useSidebar()` | `KumoSidebar.of(context)` |
| `Sidebar.Header` / `Content` / `Footer` | `KumoSidebarHeader` / `KumoSidebarContent` / `KumoSidebarFooter` |
| `Sidebar.Group` + `GroupLabel` + `Menu` | `KumoSidebarGroup(label:, children:)` |
| `Sidebar.MenuButton` `icon` `active` `size` `tooltip` `href` | `KumoSidebarMenuButton(icon:, active:, size:, tooltip:, isLink:)` |
| `Sidebar.MenuBadge` | `badge:` or `KumoSidebarMenuBadge` |
| `Sidebar.Collapsible` + `CollapsibleTrigger` + `CollapsibleContent` + `MenuChevron` | `KumoSidebarCollapsible` |
| `autoScrollOnOpen` | `autoScrollOnOpen` |
| `Sidebar.MenuSub` / `MenuSubButton` | `KumoSidebarMenuSub` / `KumoSidebarMenuSubButton` |
| `Sidebar.Separator` / `Trigger` / `Close` / `Loading` | `KumoSidebarSeparator` / `KumoSidebarTrigger` / `KumoSidebarClose` / `KumoSidebarLoading` |
| `Sidebar.ResizeHandle` | built in when `onWidthChange` is set |
| `Sidebar.Rail` | not ported (use the trigger) |
| `Sidebar.SlidingViews` / `SlidingView` | `KumoSidebarSlidingViews` / `KumoSidebarSlidingView` |
| `scrollToItem(id)` | give the row a `GlobalKey` and call `Scrollable.ensureVisible(key.currentContext!)` |

# KumoSkeletonLine

Kumo's `SkeletonLine`: a placeholder bar that stands in for a line of text while it loads.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/skeleton-line

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoSkeletonLine()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use skeleton lines for content with a known shape (a card, a list row, a settings panel) while it loads. For a wait without a known shape, or inside a button, use `KumoLoader`. For work with a known amount, use `KumoProgress`.

The line needs a bounded width: place it in a `Column`, an `Expanded` or a `SizedBox`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `widthFactor` | `double?` | | Exact width as a fraction (0 to 1) of the available width |
| `minWidth` | `double` | `30` | Lower bound of the random width, in percent |
| `maxWidth` | `double` | `100` | Upper bound of the random width, in percent |
| `height` | `double` | `8` | Bar height (Kumo's 0.5rem) |
| `blockHeight` | `double?` | | Height of a box that centers the bar, to match a known line height |
| `animate` | `bool` | `false` | Runs the shimmer. Pass the loading flag |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Announces the placeholder. Set it on one line per group |

Without `widthFactor`, each line picks a width between `minWidth` and `maxWidth` once, when it mounts, so a stack of lines looks like ragged text.

## Examples

### Card loading state

```dart
KumoLayerCard(
  child: Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      KumoSkeletonLine(widthFactor: 0.5, blockHeight: 24, animate: loading, semanticLabel: 'Loading zone settings'),
      KumoSkeletonLine(blockHeight: 21, animate: loading),
      KumoSkeletonLine(blockHeight: 21, minWidth: 50, maxWidth: 70, animate: loading),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Fixed widths

```dart
const Column(children: [
  KumoSkeletonLine(widthFactor: 0.9),
  SizedBox(height: 12),
  KumoSkeletonLine(widthFactor: 0.6),
])
```

## Accessibility

Lines are hidden from screen readers unless they have a `semanticLabel`. Label one line per group ("Loading DNS records") so the wait is announced once.

## Motion

**Static by default.** Kumo's web shimmer loops forever. Here a line only shimmers while `animate` is true, and callers should tie that to a real loading flag, never a constant: a placeholder that stays on screen (a stalled request, a list that never fills) then stops moving instead of drawing the eye indefinitely, and no ticker runs for a placeholder nobody is waiting on. The shimmer pauses off screen (`TickerMode`) and is replaced by the still line under reduced motion. Its timing follows Kumo: a gradient sweeps across in 1.3 to 1.7s with a random 0 to 0.5s offset per line.

**Skeleton to content.** Swap the placeholder for the content with a brief cross-fade rather than a cut, and give the skeleton the content's height (`blockHeight`) so nothing below moves:

```dart
AnimatedSwitcher(
  duration: KumoMotion.duration(context, KumoDurations.fast),
  child: loading
      ? const KumoSkeletonLine(key: ValueKey('skeleton'), blockHeight: 20, animate: true)
      : const Text('image-resizer', key: ValueKey('content')),
)
```

## Mobile

No changes.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `minWidth`, `maxWidth` | `minWidth`, `maxWidth` (same percent units) |
| `blockHeight` (number) | `blockHeight` |
| `className="h-4"` | `height: 16` |
| `minDuration`, `maxDuration`, `minDelay`, `maxDelay` | not ported; Kumo's defaults apply |
| (always shimmering) | `animate: true` while loading |

The colors are Kumo's hard-coded skeleton colors (`#f3f4f6` in light mode, white at 6% in dark), not theme tokens, matching Kumo's CSS.

---
source: doc/components/KumoSlider.md
---

# KumoSlider

Kumo's `Slider`: pick a number, or a range between two numbers, by dragging a thumb along a recessed track. The value shows in a badge under each thumb, with the min and max at the ends.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/slider

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSlider(
  label: 'Edge cache TTL (minutes)',
  value: ttl,
  onValueChange: (value) => setState(() => ttl = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a slider when an approximate value within a known range is fine and seeing it change helps (a sampling rate, a TTL). When people need an exact number, use a number input. The track, badges and end labels are laid out for a horizontal slider only, as in Kumo.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | required (single) | The value of a one-thumb slider |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | | Called while the value changes, snapped to `step`. Null disables the slider |
| `onValueCommitted` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | | Called once when a drag, tap or key press finishes |
| `values` | `KumoSliderRange` | required (`.range`) | `(start: 25, end: 75)` |
| `onValuesChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoSliderRange>?` | | Range form of `onValueChange` |
| `onValuesCommitted` | `ValueChanged<KumoSliderRange>?` | | Range form of `onValueCommitted` |
| `min`, `max` | `double` | `0`, `100` | |
| `step` | `double` | `1` | Granularity; values snap to `min + n * step` |
| `largeStep` | `double` | `10` | Page Up/Down and Shift+arrow, in value units |
| `size` | `KumoSliderSize` | `base` | `sm` 24px track (12px text), `base` 32px (13px text) |
| `label` | `String?` | | Medium label above the track; also the thumbs' accessible name |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | 50% opacity, no input, not focusable |
| `format` | `KumoSliderFormat?` | decimals of `step` | Formats the badge, end labels and the announced value |
| `thumbSemanticLabel` | `String Function(int index)?` | | Accessible name per thumb (0 is the start thumb) |

## Examples

### Range

```dart
KumoSlider.range(
  label: 'Response time (ms)',
  values: window,
  max: 1000,
  step: 10,
  thumbSemanticLabel: (i) => i == 0 ? 'Minimum response time' : 'Maximum response time',
  onValuesChange: (range) => setState(() => window = range),
)
```

### Formatted values

```dart
KumoSlider(
  label: 'Log sampling rate',
  value: rate,
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  step: 0.05,
  format: (v) => '${(v * 100).round()}%',
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => rate = v),
)
```

### Save on release

```dart
KumoSlider(
  label: 'Retry attempts',
  value: retries,
  max: 5,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => retries = v),
  onValueCommitted: (v) => saveRetries(v.round()),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each thumb is a slider in the semantics tree with its label, formatted value, and increase and decrease actions (one `step`).
- The visible label, the badges and the end labels are hidden from screen readers, because each thumb already announces its name and value.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses each thumb in turn. Arrow keys move one `step` (Left and Right mirrored in RTL), Page Up/Down and Shift+arrow move `largeStep`, Home and End go to the ends (or to the other thumb of a range). Keyboard focus draws a 2px `focus` ring on the thumb, as Kumo does.

## Motion

- The thumb follows the finger 1:1, keeping the offset from where it was grabbed; a drag that starts on the track brings the thumb under the finger. Range thumbs never cross.
- The grip line darkens on pointer-down, so a held thumb answers before any drag starts.
- On release the thumb springs (`KumoSprings.standard`) onto the snapped step value. Taps on the track and value changes from outside (keys, the parent) spring from the thumb's current position. The value badge rides with the thumb throughout.
- When the slider has 20 steps or fewer, each step crossed during a drag gives a selection haptic.
- Reduced motion jumps the thumb to its value.

## Mobile

The gesture area covers the track and the label row below it (about 60px tall), so the hit area clears 44px. The drag recognizer starts after 8px instead of Flutter's 18px so the thumb does not stick under the finger. Badges stay inside the slider's width at the ends of the range, so they never spill off a phone screen.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `defaultValue` (number) | `value` (controlled only) |
| `value` (array) | `KumoSlider.range(values: ...)` |
| `onValueChange` | `onValueChange` / `onValuesChange` |
| `onValueCommitted` | `onValueCommitted` / `onValuesCommitted` |
| `min`, `max`, `step`, `largeStep` | same |
| `size` | `size` |
| `label` | `label` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `format`, `locale` (`Intl.NumberFormat`) | `format` (a function) |
| `getAriaLabel` | `thumbSemanticLabel` |
| `orientation` | not supported (Kumo forces horizontal) |

source: doc/components/KumoSparkline.md

# KumoSparkline

A compact trend line for table cells, stat tiles and list rows: no axes, no tooltip, just the shape of the data. Kumo has no sparkline; this one follows its chart styling.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoSparkline(values: [12, 18, 15, 22, 30, 27, 34], semanticLabel: 'Requests, last 7 days')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it next to a number to show its direction. When people need to read values, times or compare series, use `KumoTimeseriesChart`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `List<double>` | required | Evenly spaced; `double.nan` leaves a gap |
| `color` | `Color?` | `categorical(0)` | Line color |
| `area` | `bool` | `false` | Fill under the line, 40% to clear |
| `showEndDot` | `bool` | `false` | Dot on the latest value |
| `showMinMax` | `bool` | `false` | Small dots on the lowest and highest values |
| `width` | `double?` | available width, or 120 | |
| `height` | `double` | `32` | |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` | `1.5` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Static skeleton line |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `'Trend'` | What the trend measures |
| `valueFormat` | `String Function(double)?` | grouped digits | Values in the summary |

## Examples

### In a list row

```dart
Row(children: [
  const Expanded(child: KumoText('image-resizer', variant: KumoTextVariant.mono)),
  SizedBox(
    width: 120,
    child: KumoSparkline(values: hourly, area: true, showEndDot: true, semanticLabel: 'Requests per hour for image-resizer'),
  ),
])
```

## Accessibility

Announced as an image with a summary: "Requests, last 7 days, 7 points, from 12 to 34, low 12, high 34". Empty data reads "no data" and loading reads "loading". The vertical range is the data's own minimum to maximum, so state the absolute values in nearby text.

## Motion

When values change the line morphs from where it is over 300ms (resampled by position if the length changes); instant under reduced motion. The loading skeleton never animates.

## Mobile

No changes; it fills the width it is given.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | `KumoSparkline` |
