# KumoStepper

A multi-step flow: `KumoSteps`, the current step's content and Back / Continue buttons, with a named final action. For onboarding flows such as adding a zone or creating a Worker.

Kumo reference: none (shadcn-inspired, Kumo-styled)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoStepper(
  value: step,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => step = v),
  completeLabel: 'Activate zone',
  onComplete: () {},
  steps: const [
    KumoStepperStep(title: 'Add site', child: KumoText('Enter example.com')),
    KumoStepperStep(title: 'Review DNS', child: KumoText('12 records found')),
    KumoStepperStep(title: 'Change nameservers', child: KumoText('Update them at your registrar')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when a task has ordered steps that each need input or review. For a long single form, use sections; for showing progress only, use `KumoSteps`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `List<KumoStepperStep>` | required | |
| `value` | `int` | required | Current step, 0-based |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | required | Back, Continue and step presses |
| `onComplete` | `VoidCallback?` | | The primary button on the last step |
| `completeLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.finish` | Name the outcome: "Create Worker", "Activate zone" |
| `nextLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.next` | |
| `backLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.previous` | |
| `orientation` | `KumoStepsOrientation` | `auto` | |
| `linear` | `bool` | `true` | Only earlier steps can be pressed; later ones need Continue |
| `completing` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the final button as loading |
| `stateLabels` | `Map<KumoStepsState, String>` | `kumoStepsStateLabels` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

`KumoStepperStep(title:, child:, description:, state:, canContinue:)`. Set `canContinue: false` until the step is valid, and `state: KumoStepsState.error` to flag a failed check.

## Examples

### Validation

```dart
KumoStepper(
  value: step,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => step = v),
  completeLabel: 'Create Worker',
  completing: creating,
  onComplete: () {},
  steps: [
    KumoStepperStep(
      title: 'Name',
      canContinue: name.isNotEmpty,
      child: const KumoText('Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes'),
    ),
    const KumoStepperStep(title: 'Deploy', child: KumoText('Deploys to image-resizer.example.workers.dev')),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Steps are announced as in `KumoSteps`; earlier steps are buttons in linear mode. Back and Continue are `KumoButton`s in Tab order after the content. When the step changes, the new content replaces the old; move focus into it yourself if the step starts with a field.

## Motion

The steps animate as in `KumoSteps`: the connector fills from the start, the check lands with a small bounce. Horizontal layouts cross-fade the content in 200ms while the content area eases to the new step's height, so the buttons below slide instead of jumping; the outgoing content is excluded from focus and screen readers. Vertical layouts open the current step's content under its title with `KumoCollapsiblePanel` and close the previous one. Reduced motion switches instantly.

## Mobile

Vertical below 768px, with the content and buttons under the current step, so the flow reads top to bottom at 390px. Buttons wrap to a second line at 2x text.

---
source: doc/components/KumoSteps.md
---

# KumoSteps

A progress indicator for multi-step flows: numbered markers joined by connectors, horizontal on wide layouts and vertical on narrow ones. Shaped after shadcn's steps and drawn with Kumo tokens; Kumo has no steps component.

Kumo reference: none (see `KumoStepper` for the flow with content and buttons)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoSteps(
  current: 1,
  steps: [
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Choose a plan'),
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Add DNS records'),
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Change nameservers'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show where someone is in a flow of three to six steps. For the flow itself (content plus Back and Continue), use `KumoStepper`. Do not use it for navigation between unrelated pages.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `List<KumoStepsItem>` | required | |
| `current` | `int` | required | Step in progress, 0-based; `steps.length` marks all complete |
| `orientation` | `KumoStepsOrientation` | `auto` | `auto`, `horizontal` or `vertical` |
| `onStepPress` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Makes steps buttons |
| `stateLabels` | `Map<KumoStepsState, String>` | `kumoStepsStateLabels` | Screen reader names per state |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

`KumoStepsItem(title:, description:, state:)`. `state` overrides the derived state (before `current`: complete; at `current`: current; after: upcoming).

States and markers (24px circles), so status never rests on color:

| `KumoStepsState` | Marker | Title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `upcoming` | outlined circle, number | subtle |
| `current` | filled brand circle with a soft halo, number | medium weight |
| `complete` | filled brand circle, check | default |
| `error` | filled danger circle, cross | danger text |

`auto` is horizontal when the window is at least 768px wide and every step gets 150px; vertical otherwise.

## Examples

### Every state

```dart
const KumoSteps(
  orientation: KumoStepsOrientation.vertical,
  current: 2,
  steps: [
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Create R2 bucket', description: 'assets'),
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Upload files', description: '48 files'),
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Connect domain', description: 'cdn.example.com'),
    KumoStepsItem(title: 'Verify certificate', description: 'DNS record not found', state: KumoStepsState.error),
  ],
)
```

### Going back

```dart
KumoSteps(
  steps: const [KumoStepsItem(title: 'Plan'), KumoStepsItem(title: 'DNS'), KumoStepsItem(title: 'Done')],
  current: step,
  onStepPress: (i) {
    if (i < step) setState(() => step = i);
  },
)
```

## Accessibility

Each step is one node: label "title, state" (for example "Add DNS records, Current step") and value "Step 2 of 3". With `onStepPress` it is a button, reachable with Tab and Enter. Translate the state names with `stateLabels`.

## Motion

Markers change fill over 200ms. When a step completes, the brand fill grows along the connector after it from the start (top in vertical layouts) and the number gives way to a check that lands with Kumo's small bounce (`KumoCurves.bounce`); the error cross lands the same way. Stepping back drains the connector from wherever it is. Reduced motion is instant.

## Mobile

Vertical below 768px, with descriptions under each title. Pressable steps are 44px tall on touch. Titles wrap at 2x text; the marker number stays at its size because the step's accessible label carries it.

# KumoStrings

All built-in copy (labels, announcements, month names) in one place, provided by `KumoLocale`.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoLocale(
  strings: KumoStrings(close: 'Tutup', cancel: 'Batal', optional: '(opsional)', firstDayOfWeek: DateTime.monday),
  child: SizedBox(),
)
```

Read them with `context.kumoStrings`.

## Parameters

Every field has an English default matching Kumo: `optional`, `moreInformation`, `close`, `cancel`, `confirm`, `dismiss`, `loading`, `copy`, `copied`, `copyFailed`, `show`, `hide`, `clear`, `search`, `noResults`, `select`, `selectAll`, `selectRow`, `remove`, `more`, `menu`, `expand`, `collapse`, `increment`, `decrement`, `previous`, `next`, `previousPage`, `nextPage`, `firstPage`, `lastPage`, `previousMonth`, `nextMonth`, `today`, `sortAscending`, `sortDescending`, `openSidebar`, `closeSidebar`, `breadcrumbs`, `pagination`, `notifications`, `required`, `monthNames`, `monthNamesShort`, `weekdayNames`, `weekdayNamesShort` (Monday first), `firstDayOfWeek` (Sunday).

Methods: `pageOf(page, total)`, `removeItem(item)`, `showingRange(from, to, total)`, `monthYear(date)`, `shortDate(date)`, `fullDate(date)`.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `KumoLocaleProvider translations={...}` | `KumoLocale(strings: KumoStrings(...))` |
| `label.optional`, `layerDialog.close` | `optional`, `close` |

# KumoSwitch

Kumo's `Switch`: an on/off control for a setting that takes effect at once, with a thumb you can tap or drag.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/switch

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSwitch(
  label: 'Always use HTTPS',
  checked: httpsOnly,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => httpsOnly = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a switch when flipping it changes something immediately (a zone setting, a feature flag). When the choice is saved later with a form, use `KumoCheckbox`. For several switches under one title, wrap them in `KumoSwitchGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | Controlled value |
| `onCheckedChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Called after a tap, key press or a drag that changes sides. Null disables the switch |
| `label` | `String?` | | Label text, 14px medium. Also the accessible name |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label in place of `label` |
| `labelTooltip` | `String?` | | Info icon with a tooltip after the label |
| `required` | `bool?` | | `false` shows "(optional)" after the label |
| `controlFirst` | `bool?` | group's, else `true` | Switch before the label, or after it |
| `size` | `KumoSwitchSize` | `base` | `sm` 32x16, `base` 36x18, `lg` 40x20 |
| `variant` | `KumoSwitchVariant` | `base` | `base` blue track when on; `neutral` monochrome |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `transitioning` | `bool` | `false` | A save is in flight: keeps the look, ignores input, adds a "Loading" hint |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a label (defaults to "Switch") |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Sizes and neutral

```dart
KumoSwitch(
  label: 'Compact table rows',
  size: KumoSwitchSize.sm,
  variant: KumoSwitchVariant.neutral,
  checked: compact,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => compact = value),
)
```

### Saving to an API

```dart
KumoSwitch(
  label: 'Proxy status',
  checked: proxied,
  transitioning: saving,
  onCheckedChange: (value) async {
    setState(() => saving = true);
    await updateProxy(value);
    setState(() {
      proxied = value;
      saving = false;
    });
  },
)
```

### Label first

```dart
KumoSwitch(
  label: 'Development mode',
  controlFirst: false,
  checked: devMode,
  onCheckedChange: (value) => setState(() => devMode = value),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Announced as a switch (toggled state) with its label; not as a button.
- Tab focuses it; Space or Enter toggles. Keyboard focus draws a 2px brand ring around the track.
- Without a visible label pass `semanticLabel`; otherwise it is announced as "Switch", Kumo's fallback.

## Motion

- Tap: the thumb springs to the other side (`KumoSprings.standard`), starting from wherever it is, so rapid taps never jump. Track and thumb colors follow the thumb's position.
- Press: the thumb widens by a quarter while held (a press spring), toward the side it can travel to.
- Drag: the thumb follows the finger 1:1 from the touch point and rubberbands past either end. On release the side is chosen from the position plus the projected flick (`KumoMotion.project`); a flick settles with `KumoSprings.momentum` (a slight overshoot), a slow release with `KumoSprings.standard`.
- A selection haptic marks every change. If the parent does not accept the new value, the thumb springs back.
- Reduced motion moves the thumb without animation and drops the press stretch.

## Mobile

The track keeps Kumo's size; the row (track and label) is padded to a 44px hit area on touch. The drag recognizer uses a 4px slop instead of Flutter's 18px, which is as long as the thumb's whole travel. Labels wrap at 2x text.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onCheckedChange` | `onCheckedChange` |
| `label` | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `labelTooltip` | `labelTooltip` |
| `required` | `required` |
| `controlFirst` | `controlFirst` |
| `size` | `size` |
| `variant` (`default`, `neutral`) | `variant` (`base`, `neutral`) |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `transitioning` | `transitioning` (also blocks input) |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |
| `Switch.Item` | `KumoSwitch` inside `KumoSwitchGroup` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoSwitchGroup.md
---

# KumoSwitchGroup

Kumo's `Switch.Group`: a legend over related `KumoSwitch`es, each with its own value, with an error and a description below.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/switch

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoSwitchGroup(
  legend: 'Notifications',
  description: 'Delivered to the account owner.',
  children: [
    KumoSwitch(label: 'Deploy failures', checked: failures, onCheckedChange: (v) => setState(() => failures = v)),
    KumoSwitch(label: 'Weekly usage report', checked: report, onCheckedChange: (v) => setState(() => report = v)),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to title a few switches that belong together on a settings page. Each switch stays independently controlled. For a set of choices saved together with a form, use `KumoCheckboxGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Usually `KumoSwitch`es |
| `legend` | `String?` | | Group title (14px medium) |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Keep the legend for screen readers only |
| `description` | `String?` | | Helper text under the switches |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error under the switches, announced |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every switch in the group |
| `controlFirst` | `bool` | `true` | Default for switches that do not set their own |

## Examples

### Label first, disabled

```dart
KumoSwitchGroup(
  legend: 'Managed settings',
  controlFirst: false,
  disabled: true,
  children: [
    KumoSwitch(label: 'Enforced by policy', checked: true, onCheckedChange: (_) {}),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Each switch keeps its own Tab stop and announcement. The legend is read before them; the error is a live region.

## Motion

See `KumoSwitch`.

## Mobile

On touch, switch rows are padded to 44px hit areas, which replace Kumo's 8px gap between rows.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `legend` / `Switch.Legend` | `legend` |
| `Switch.Legend className="sr-only"` | `hideLegend: true` |
| `error`, `description`, `disabled` | same |
| `controlFirst` | `controlFirst` |
| `children` (`Switch.Item`) | `children` (`KumoSwitch`) |

source: doc/components/KumoTable.md

# KumoTable

Kumo's `Table`: rows of data under a header, with sorting, row selection, pinned columns, lazy rows and a card layout for phones.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/table

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTable<String>(
  rows: const ['image-resizer', 'auth-proxy'],
  columns: [
    KumoTableColumn(id: 'name', label: 'Worker', cell: (context, name) => Text(name)),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a table for records people compare across columns: Workers, DNS records, API tokens. For a short list of resources with one or two facts each, a list of rows or cards reads better. For key and value details of one resource, use a description layout, not a one-row table.

Put the table in a `KumoLayerCard` with `padding: EdgeInsets.zero`, as Kumo's docs do.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `List<KumoTableColumn<T>>` | required | Column definitions |
| `rows` | `List<T>` | required | Already sorted and filtered; the table never reorders them |
| `rowId` | `Object Function(T)?` | the row itself | Stable id for selection and keys. Required with `selected` |
| `layout` | `KumoTableLayout` | `table` | `table`, `cards`, or `auto` (cards below 768px) |
| `headerVariant` | `KumoTableHeaderVariant` | `standard` | `compact`: 12px `text-kumo-strong` on `bg-kumo-elevated` |
| `density` | `KumoTableDensity` | `standard` | `compact` rows use 8px vertical padding |
| `striped` | `bool` | `true` | Every other row on `bg-kumo-elevated` (Kumo `even:`) |
| `stickyHeader` | `bool` | `true` | With a bounded height, the header stays above the scrolling rows |
| `sort` | `KumoTableSort?` | | Current sort; drives the header arrow and sort semantics |
| `onSortChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoTableSort>?` | | Called with the next sort when a sortable header is pressed |
| `selected` | `Set<Object>?` | | Selected row ids. Non-null adds the checkbox column |
| `onSelectionChange` | `ValueChanged<Set<Object>>?` | | Called with the new set from row and select-all checkboxes |
| `rowLabel` | `String Function(T)?` | | Names a row for screen readers ("Select image-resizer") |
| `onRowPress` | `ValueChanged<T>?` | | Makes rows pressable |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a loader in place of the rows |
| `error` | `Widget?` | | Shown in place of the rows, usually a `KumoTablePlaceholder` |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | "No results" placeholder | Shown when `rows` is empty |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Below the last row, after a `kumo-fill` border |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the table |
| `controller` | `ScrollController?` | | Vertical controller for the lazy rows |

`KumoTableColumn<T>`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String` | required | Used by `KumoTableSort` |
| `label` | `String` | required | Header text; may be empty for an actions column |
| `cell` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, T)` | required | Builds a cell; text wraps rather than clips |
| `header` | `Widget?` | | Custom header content |
| `width` | `KumoTableColumnWidth` | `.flex(1, 120)` | `.fixed(px)` or `.flex(flex, minWidth)` |
| `align` | `KumoTableAlign?` | `end` if `numeric`, else `start` | |
| `numeric` | `bool` | `false` | End-aligned, tabular figures |
| `sortable` | `bool` | `false` | Header becomes a sort button |
| `pin` | `KumoTableColumnPin?` | | `start` or `end`: stays visible while scrolling sideways |
| `showInCards` | `bool` | `true` | Include in the card layout |

`KumoTablePlaceholder(title:, icon:, description:, action:, iconColor:)` builds empty and error bodies.

## Examples

### Sorting and selection

The table is controlled. Sort `rows` yourself when `onSortChange` fires, and keep the selection in your state.

```dart
class WorkersTable extends StatefulWidget {
  const WorkersTable({super.key, required this.workers});
  final List<(String, int)> workers;

  @override
  State<WorkersTable> createState() => _WorkersTableState();
}

class _WorkersTableState extends State<WorkersTable> {
  KumoTableSort sort = const KumoTableSort('requests', KumoTableSortDirection.descending);
  Set<Object> selected = {};

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rows = [...widget.workers]..sort((a, b) {
        final c = sort.columnId == 'name' ? a.$1.compareTo(b.$1) : a.$2.compareTo(b.$2);
        return sort.direction == KumoTableSortDirection.ascending ? c : -c;
      });
    return KumoLayerCard(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: KumoTable<(String, int)>(
        rows: rows,
        rowId: (w) => w.$1,
        rowLabel: (w) => w.$1,
        columns: [
          KumoTableColumn(id: 'name', label: 'Worker', sortable: true, cell: (context, w) => Text(w.$1)),
          KumoTableColumn(
            id: 'requests',
            label: 'Requests',
            numeric: true,
            sortable: true,
            width: const KumoTableColumnWidth.fixed(120),
            cell: (context, w) => Text('${w.$2}'),
          ),
        ],
        sort: sort,
        onSortChange: (next) => setState(() => sort = next),
        selected: selected,
        onSelectionChange: (ids) => setState(() => selected = ids),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Lazy rows with a sticky header

Give the table a bounded height and only visible rows are built.

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 400,
  child: KumoTable<int>(
    rows: List.generate(5000, (i) => i),
    columns: [
      KumoTableColumn(id: 'host', label: 'Hostname', cell: (context, i) => Text('host-$i.example.com')),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Pinned actions column

```dart
KumoTableColumn<String>(
  id: 'actions',
  label: '',
  pin: KumoTableColumnPin.end,
  showInCards: false,
  width: const KumoTableColumnWidth.fixed(56),
  cell: (context, name) => KumoButton(
    icon: KumoIcons.dotsThree,
    shape: KumoButtonShape.square,
    size: KumoButtonSize.sm,
    variant: KumoButtonVariant.ghost,
    semanticLabel: 'Actions for $name',
    onPress: () {},
  ),
)
```

### Empty, loading and error

```dart
KumoTable<String>(
  rows: const [],
  columns: [KumoTableColumn(id: 'name', label: 'Worker', cell: (context, n) => Text(n))],
  empty: KumoTablePlaceholder(
    icon: KumoIcons.cloud,
    title: 'No Workers yet',
    description: 'Deploy a Worker with Wrangler to see it here.',
    action: KumoButton(label: 'Create Worker', onPress: () {}),
  ),
)
```

### Cards on phones

```dart
KumoTable<String>(
  rows: const ['image-resizer', 'auth-proxy'],
  layout: KumoTableLayout.auto,
  columns: [KumoTableColumn(id: 'name', label: 'Worker', cell: (context, n) => Text(n))],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Sortable headers are buttons named by the column label. Their value is the current sort ("Sorted ascending", like `aria-sort`) and their hint is the next action ("Sort descending", from `KumoStrings`).
- Checkboxes announce checked or mixed. The header one is named `KumoStrings.selectAll`; row ones are "Select" plus `rowLabel`, or `KumoStrings.selectRow` without it.
- Pressable rows are buttons named by `rowLabel` and report `selected`. Their cells stay separate nodes, so buttons inside a row are still reachable.
- Status in a cell is never color alone: pair a status color with an icon or text.

## Motion

- Hover and pressed tints change instantly. Rows do not scale on press. Inside a scroll view the pressed tint waits out Flutter's 100ms press timeout so scrolling never flashes rows.
- Selecting a row eases its tint in and out (100ms) and the checkbox mark lands with Kumo's small bounce.
- The sort arrow turns over (200ms) when the direction flips, from wherever it is if pressed again mid-turn; the unsorted caret cross-fades into the arrow.
- After a sort, and when the body switches between loading, error, empty and rows, the new rows fade in (150ms). Rows never animate their layout, so thousands of rows cost nothing extra.
- Reduced motion makes all of this instant.

## Mobile

- Columns never shrink below their `minWidth`; when they do not fit, the table scrolls sideways and the hidden edge fades (24px, Kumo's sticky-column fade), with a thin scrollbar while scrolling. Pinned columns stay at their edge with the same fade on their inner side.
- `layout: KumoTableLayout.auto` switches to cards below 768px: the first visible column is the card title, the others become label and value pairs (each label centered against its value, so a tall cell such as a switch stays level with its label), and a select-all row sits above the cards.
- Touch rows and sortable headers are at least 44px tall; checkbox cells widen to 44px.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Table>` + `<Table.Header>` + `<Table.Body>` | `KumoTable(columns:, rows:)` |
| `<Table.Head>` | `KumoTableColumn(label:, header:)` |
| `<Table.Cell>` | `KumoTableColumn.cell` |
| `<Table.Header variant="compact">` | `headerVariant: KumoTableHeaderVariant.compact` |
| `<Table.Header sticky>` | `stickyHeader` (default on) |
| `<Table.Row variant="selected">` | rows whose id is in `selected` |
| `<Table.CheckHead>`, `<Table.CheckCell>` | `selected` + `onSelectionChange` |
| `sticky="left"` / `"right"` | `pin: KumoTableColumnPin.start` / `.end` |
| `layout="fixed"` + `<colgroup>` | `KumoTableColumnWidth.fixed` / `.flex` |
| `<Table.Footer>` | `footer` |
| `<Table.ResizeHandle>` | not ported |

---
source: doc/components/KumoTableOfContents.md

# KumoTableOfContents

"On this page" navigation beside a long page: section links with a brand rule on the active one, which follows the scroll position. It combines Kumo's `TableOfContents` with its `useTableOfContentsActiveId` hook.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/table-of-contents

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class WorkerSettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const WorkerSettingsPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<WorkerSettingsPage> createState() => _WorkerSettingsPageState();
}

class _WorkerSettingsPageState extends State<WorkerSettingsPage> {
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  final Map<String, GlobalKey> _anchors = {'routes': GlobalKey(), 'bindings': GlobalKey()};

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SizedBox(
          width: 200,
          child: KumoTableOfContents(
            title: 'On this page',
            scrollController: _scroll,
            anchors: _anchors,
            items: const [
              KumoTableOfContentsItem(id: 'routes', label: 'Routes'),
              KumoTableOfContentsItem(id: 'bindings', label: 'Bindings'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            controller: _scroll,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                KumoText('Routes', key: _anchors['routes'], variant: KumoTextVariant.heading),
                const SizedBox(height: 800),
                KumoText('Bindings', key: _anchors['bindings'], variant: KumoTextVariant.heading),
                const SizedBox(height: 800),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it on long settings or documentation pages with four or more sections. Short pages do not need it; for switching between views use `KumoTabs`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoTableOfContentsItem>` | required | Sections in page order |
| `title` | `String?` | | Small uppercase heading above the list |
| `scrollController` | `ScrollController?` | | The page's scroll view; enables tracking and tap-to-scroll |
| `anchors` | `Map<String, GlobalKey>` | `const {}` | A key on each section heading, by item id |
| `offset` | `double` | `0` | Activation line below the top (a sticky header's height); taps scroll the heading to it |
| `activeId` | `String?` | | Forces the highlighted item |
| `onActiveIdChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Tracking moved to another section |
| `onSelect` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | An item was tapped |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.tableOfContents` | |

`KumoTableOfContentsItem(id:, label:, children:, selectable:)`. An item with `children` is Kumo's `TableOfContents.Group`: the label heads an indented list. `selectable: false` makes a group label a plain title.

## Examples

### Driven by the app

```dart
KumoTableOfContents(
  activeId: section,
  onSelect: (id) => setState(() => section = id),
  items: const [
    KumoTableOfContentsItem(id: 'intro', label: 'Introduction'),
    KumoTableOfContentsItem(id: 'api', label: 'API reference', selectable: false, children: [
      KumoTableOfContentsItem(id: 'fetch', label: 'fetch handler'),
    ]),
  ],
)
```

## How tracking works

On each scroll, the active section is the first heading (in item order) that is inside the viewport below `offset`, the same rule as Kumo's IntersectionObserver hook. Inside a long section with no heading in view, the last active one stays. A tap selects the section at once, scrolls its heading to the activation line (300ms, standard curve) and pins it until scrolling has been quiet for 150ms, so a short last section stays highlighted even though it cannot reach the top. Headings in lazy lists that are not built yet are skipped.

## Accessibility

The list is a labelled container; the title is a header. Items are links with a selected state on the active one, reachable with Tab and activated with Enter. The active item is marked by a brand rule and medium weight, not color alone.

## Motion

Tapping scrolls with a 300ms animation that the user can interrupt by touching the page. The active item's brand rule is one indicator that springs along the rail from the previous item (`KumoSprings.standard`, continuing from where it is when the active section changes again mid-flight), so it follows the reading position as the page scrolls. Layout changes move it without animating. Hover rules change instantly. Reduced motion jumps the scroll and the rule.

## Mobile

On touch, rows are 44px tall and the 8px gaps between them drop. On phones, place it at the top of the page or in a sheet rather than beside the content.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `<TableOfContents aria-label>` | `semanticLabel` |
| `<TableOfContents.Title>` | `title` |
| `<TableOfContents.Item href active onClick>` | `KumoTableOfContentsItem(id:, label:)`, `activeId`, `onSelect` |
| `<TableOfContents.Group label href>` | item with `children` (`selectable: false` without `href`) |
| `useTableOfContentsActiveId({ ids, offset, root })` | `anchors`, `offset`, `scrollController` |
| `selectSection(id)` | tapping an item |
| `trackHash` | not ported (no URL hash) |

Deviation: the title keeps Kumo's uppercase but not its `tracking-wide`, following the package rule against changing letter spacing.

source: doc/components/KumoTabs.md

# KumoTabs

A row of tabs with a moving active indicator, for switching between views of one resource (a Worker's overview, metrics and settings). `KumoTabPanels` adds content pages that swipe with the finger.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/tabs

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class WorkerTabs extends StatefulWidget {
  const WorkerTabs({super.key});

  @override
  State<WorkerTabs> createState() => _WorkerTabsState();
}

class _WorkerTabsState extends State<WorkerTabs> {
  String _tab = 'overview';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return KumoTabs(
      tabs: const [
        KumoTab(value: 'overview', label: 'Overview'),
        KumoTab(value: 'metrics', label: 'Metrics'),
        KumoTab(value: 'settings', label: 'Settings'),
      ],
      value: _tab,
      onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => _tab = v),
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Use tabs for sibling views of the same thing, where only one is shown at a time. Use `KumoBreadcrumbs` or a sidebar for moving between different pages, and a radio group or segmented control in a form for choosing a value that gets saved.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `List<KumoTab>` | required | An empty list renders nothing |
| `value` | `String?` | required | Active tab's `value`. Null or unknown shows no indicator |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | required | Next value. Null makes the tabs read-only |
| `variant` | `KumoTabsVariant` | `segmented` | `segmented` (pill on a recessed track) or `underline` (2px brand bar) |
| `size` | `KumoTabsSize` | `base` | `base` 36px track, 14px text; `sm` 26px track, 12px text |
| `activateOnFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Select as arrow keys move focus |
| `pageController` | `PageController?` | | Shared with `KumoTabPanels`; the indicator follows page drags |
| `haptic` | `KumoHaptic?` | selection for segmented, none for underline | Fires on selection change |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the tab list |
| `scrollStartLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.scrollTabsStart` | Accessible name of the start chevron |
| `scrollEndLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.scrollTabsEnd` | Accessible name of the end chevron |

`KumoTab`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | Identifies the tab |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading icon, 16px (14px at `sm`) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Dimmed, skipped by arrow keys, cannot be selected |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

`KumoTabPanels`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `panels` | `List<KumoTabPanel>` | required | `KumoTabPanel(value:, child:)`, one per tab, same order |
| `value` | `String?` | required | The visible panel; match `KumoTabs.value` |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | required | Called when a swipe lands on another panel |
| `controller` | `PageController?` | created internally | Pass the same controller to `KumoTabs.pageController` |
| `swipeable` | `bool` | `true` | False switches panels only through the tabs |

`KumoTabPanels` is a `PageView`: give it a bounded height (`Expanded` or a `SizedBox`). Offscreen panels are not kept alive; keep their state above the panels or with `AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin`.

## Examples

### Underline, small

```dart
KumoTabs(
  variant: KumoTabsVariant.underline,
  size: KumoTabsSize.sm,
  tabs: const [
    KumoTab(value: 'logs', label: 'Logs', icon: KumoIcons.listBullets),
    KumoTab(value: 'metrics', label: 'Metrics', icon: KumoIcons.chartBar),
    KumoTab(value: 'traces', label: 'Traces', disabled: true),
  ],
  value: tab,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => tab = v),
)
```

### Many tabs

When the tabs are wider than their parent, the row scrolls: the edges fade (Kumo's scroll-fade, 48px) and the segmented variant shows chevron buttons that page by the width of the visible tabs. The selected tab scrolls into view, clear of the fades. A mouse can drag the row.

### Swipeable panels

```dart
class WorkerSections extends StatefulWidget {
  const WorkerSections({super.key});

  @override
  State<WorkerSections> createState() => _WorkerSectionsState();
}

class _WorkerSectionsState extends State<WorkerSections> {
  final PageController _pages = PageController();
  String _tab = 'overview';

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pages.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const tabs = [
      KumoTab(value: 'overview', label: 'Overview'),
      KumoTab(value: 'logs', label: 'Logs'),
    ];
    return Column(
      children: [
        KumoTabs(tabs: tabs, value: _tab, pageController: _pages, onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => _tab = v)),
        Expanded(
          child: KumoTabPanels(
            controller: _pages,
            value: _tab,
            onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => _tab = v),
            panels: const [
              KumoTabPanel(value: 'overview', child: KumoText('Deployed from main')),
              KumoTabPanel(value: 'logs', child: KumoText('No logs in the last hour')),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

The list is a tab bar; each tab has the tab role with its selected state. Focus is roving, like Base UI's tabs: Tab reaches the active tab only, Left and Right move between tabs (wrapping, skipping disabled ones, mirrored in RTL), Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space selects. Focus shows Kumo's 2px brand ring (inset on segmented tabs). The overflow chevrons are buttons with their own labels and leave the Tab order while hidden. Panels have the tab panel role.

## Motion

The indicator springs (`KumoSprings.standard`, an unbounded controller driven by `KumoMotion.springTo`) from wherever it is to the new tab, carrying its velocity, so a second tap mid-flight turns it around without a jump; resizes and text scale changes move it without animating. On touch, the segmented pill can be grabbed: it shrinks slightly, follows the finger with rubber-banding past the ends, gives a selection tick as it crosses tabs, and on release the projected fling picks the tab (disabled tabs are skipped). With a `pageController`, the indicator tracks the page 1:1 as it is dragged and springs to the active tab when the page settles; `KumoTabPanels` pages follow the finger and settle with the page physics, and a tab tap slides the pages over 300ms. The overflow chevrons fade in and out in 150ms. Reduced motion moves the indicator instantly and jumps the scroll and the pages.

## Mobile

Tabs stay their visual size (36px or 26px track), but on touch the hit area of every tab is 44px tall. Labels never wrap; a row wider than the screen scrolls with fades instead of overflowing, including at 2x text. Panels swipe with the finger on touch only.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `tabs` (`KumoTab` instead of `TabsItem`) |
| `value` / `onValueChange` | `value` / `onValueChange` |
| `selectedValue` | not ported (controlled only) |
| `variant`, `size` | `variant`, `size` |
| `activateOnFocus` | `activateOnFocus` |
| `labels.scrollStart` / `labels.scrollEnd` | `scrollStartLabel` / `scrollEndLabel` |
| `TabsItem.render` (link tabs) | navigate in `onValueChange` |
| `className`, `listClassName`, `indicatorClassName` | not ported |

Additions over Kumo: `KumoTab.icon`, `KumoTab.disabled`, the draggable pill and `KumoTabPanels`. Underline tabs fill the available width so the hairline spans it; segmented tabs shrink to their content.

---
source: doc/components/KumoTagInput.md

# KumoTagInput

A field that collects short values as removable tags. Reach for it for lists the user types: email recipients, allowed origins, labels.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/tag-input

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTagInput(
  label: 'Alert recipients',
  placeholder: 'name@example.com',
  value: recipients,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => recipients = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it when values are free-form and there are several of them.
- When the values come from a known list, use `KumoCombobox.multiple` or `KumoSelect.multiple`.
- For one value, use `KumoInput`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `List<String>` | required | The tags, in order |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<List<String>>?` | | Next list after an add or remove |
| `validateValue` | `KumoTagValidator?` | | `(value, accepted) => String?`: null accepts, a message rejects, `''` rejects with `labels.invalidValue` |
| `maxValues` | `int?` | | Largest number of tags |
| `allowDuplicates` | `bool` | `false` | Off: repeated tags are skipped silently |
| `labels` | `KumoTagInputLabels` | from `KumoStrings` | `input` (`addTag`), `removeValue` (`removeItem`), `invalidValue` (`invalidValue`), `maxValuesReached` (`maxValuesReached`) |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description` | `String?` | | Field parts |
| `error` | `String?` | | Caller's error; replaces the field's own message |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Tags shown; no adding or removing; input still focusable |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace input |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | `text` | Such as `TextInputType.emailAddress` |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Validation

```dart
KumoTagInput(
  label: 'Allowed origins',
  value: origins,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => origins = v),
  validateValue: (v, accepted) => v.startsWith('https://') ? null : 'Origins must start with https://',
)
```

### Limit and localized copy

```dart
KumoTagInput(
  label: 'Etiquetas',
  maxValues: 3,
  labels: KumoTagInputLabels(
    input: 'Agregar etiqueta',
    removeValue: (v) => 'Eliminar $v',
    invalidValue: (v) => '$v no es valido.',
    maxValuesReached: (n) => 'Maximo de $n etiquetas.',
  ),
  value: tags,
  onValueChange: (v) => setState(() => tags = v),
)
```

### Read only

```dart
const KumoTagInput(label: 'Assigned teams', readOnly: true, value: ['billing', 'dns', 'workers'])
```

## Behavior

- Enter, a typed comma, the keyboard's done key, Tab and leaving the field add what was typed, trimmed.
- Text pasted with commas or line breaks becomes one tag per part.
- Tags are checked in order. The first rejected one, and everything after it, stays in the input with the message under the field; tags before it are added. Editing clears the message.
- At `maxValues` the rest stays in the input with `KumoStrings.maxValuesReached` ("You can add up to N").

## Accessibility

- Each tag's X is a button named "Remove <tag>" (`labels.removeValue`).
- Backspace in the empty input removes the last tag (hardware keyboards).
- A rejected Tab keeps focus in the field so the value can be fixed.
- The validation message is a live region and is announced.

## Motion

A new tag grows in from zero width and fades in over 150ms; a removed tag (X button or Backspace) shrinks and fades the way it came while the tags after it slide over. Typing never waits for a tag to finish animating. A rejected value does not shake the field: the message under it opens and fades in over 150ms, and closes the same way once the text is edited. Under reduced motion tags and messages appear and leave at once.

## Mobile

Tags wrap onto new lines and the field grows; it never scrolls sideways. Remove buttons get touch targets up to 44px wide inside the field without changing its density.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `onValueChange` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
| `validateValue` (returns `bool`) | `validateValue` (returns the message or null) |
| `maxValues` | `maxValues` |
| `labels` | `labels` (`KumoTagInputLabels`) |
| `label`, `labelTooltip`, `description`, `error` | same names |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `placeholder`, `required` | same names |
| duplicates skipped | `allowDuplicates: false` |
| `name`, `form` | not ported (no HTML forms) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoText.md
---

# KumoText

Kumo's `Text`: every string in a Kumo UI, with Kumo's variants and sizes.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/text

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoText('Deployed 3 minutes ago', variant: KumoTextVariant.secondary, size: KumoTextSize.sm)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for all visible text so size, color and weight stay on the Kumo scale. Content text is 14px (`base`); 16px and up is for headings.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required, positional | |
| `variant` | `KumoTextVariant` | `body` | `heading`, `body`, `secondary`, `success`, `error`, `mono`, `monoSecondary` |
| `size` | `KumoTextSize` | `base` | `xs` 12, `sm` 13, `base` 14, `lg` 16. Headings: `lg` is 20px. Mono: `lg` is 14px, otherwise 13px |
| `bold` | `bool` | `false` | Medium weight (500). Ignored by headings and mono |
| `truncate` | `bool` | `false` | One line with an ellipsis |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | | |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign?` | | |
| `color` | `KumoColor?` | | Overrides the variant color |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | | Raw color escape hatch |
| `headingLevel` | `int?` | | Marks the text as a heading (1 to 6) for screen readers |
| `tabularNumbers` | `bool` | `false` | Fixed-width digits |
| `semanticsLabel` | `String?` | | |

`KumoText.styleOf(context, variant:, size:, bold:)` returns the resolved `TextStyle`.

## Examples

### Page title and section heading

```dart
const Column(children: [
  KumoText('Workers', variant: KumoTextVariant.heading, size: KumoTextSize.lg, headingLevel: 1),
  KumoText('Recent deployments', variant: KumoTextVariant.heading, headingLevel: 2),
])
```

### Inline code

```dart
const KumoText('wrangler.toml', variant: KumoTextVariant.mono)
```

## Accessibility

Text scales with the platform setting. `headingLevel` adds heading semantics. Use `selectable` regions by wrapping a subtree in Flutter's `SelectionArea`.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Use `truncate` or `maxLines` for resource names in narrow rows; never place text in a fixed-height box.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `text` |
| `variant="mono-secondary"` | `variant: KumoTextVariant.monoSecondary` |
| `as="h2"` | `headingLevel: 2` |
| `size`, `bold`, `truncate` | same names |
| `DANGEROUS_className` | `color` / `dangerouslySetColor` |

source: doc/components/KumoThemeProvider.md

# KumoThemeProvider

The root of a Kumo app: resolves light or dark mode, applies a theme variant and typography, provides `context.kumo`, and cross-fades a mode change.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoThemeProvider(
  mode: KumoThemeMode.system,
  child: Builder(builder: (context) => MaterialApp(theme: kumoMaterialTheme(context.kumo), home: const SizedBox())),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `KumoThemeMode` | `system` | `system`, `light`, `dark` |
| `variant` | `KumoThemeVariant` | `kumo` | `kumo` or `fedramp` |
| `typography` | `KumoTypography` | Inter + JetBrains Mono | |
| `tapTargetSize` | `KumoTapTargetSize?` | platform | `padded` (44px hit areas) on touch, `shrinkWrap` with a mouse |
| `light`, `dark` | `KumoThemeData?` | | Full theme overrides |
| `animationDuration` | `Duration` | 300ms | Mode cross-fade |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | |

`KumoTheme(data:, child:)` forces a theme for a subtree. `KumoThemeData` exposes `colors`, `color(token)`, `text()`, `heading()`, `code()`, `shadow()`, `minTapTarget`, `isDark`, `copyWith`, `lerp`.

## Motion

Mode changes interpolate every color token over `animationDuration`, instantly under reduced motion.

source: doc/components/KumoTimeInput.md

# KumoTimeInput

A typed time field: hours, minutes and optionally seconds as separate parts in one Kumo field, with an AM/PM toggle in 12-hour mode. Kumo has no time component; this follows shadcn's time input in Kumo's field style.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/input (field styling)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTimeInput(
  label: 'Backup window starts',
  value: start,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => start = time),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when people type exact times or work from the keyboard. Use `KumoTimePicker` when picking from a set of times on touch matters more.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `KumoTimeValue?` | | Shown whenever the field is not being edited |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoTimeValue?>?` | | Called with a complete time, or `null` when every part is cleared |
| `use24Hour` | `bool` | `false` | 00-23 hours, no AM/PM |
| `showSeconds` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a seconds part |
| `minuteStep` | `int` | `1` | Step for Arrow Up and Down in the minutes part (snaps to the grid) |
| `label`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | Rendered through `KumoField` |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `labels` | `KumoTimeLabels` | English | Accessible names of the parts, AM/PM text |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | | Content at the end of the field |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the hour part on first build |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | Label markers |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a `label` |

See [KumoTimePicker](KumoTimePicker.md) for `KumoTimeValue`.

## Examples

### 24-hour with seconds

```dart
KumoTimeInput(
  label: 'Rate limit resets at',
  use24Hour: true,
  showSeconds: true,
  value: resetAt,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => resetAt = time),
)
```

### Validating against another time

```dart
KumoTimeInput(
  label: 'Backup window ends',
  value: end,
  error: end != null && start != null && end!.compareTo(start!) <= 0 ? 'End the window after it starts.' : null,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => end = time),
)
```

### Five-minute steps

```dart
KumoTimeInput(
  minuteStep: 5,
  value: start,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => start = time),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each part is a text field named by `KumoTimeLabels`, which default to `KumoStrings.hours`, `minutes` and `seconds` ("Hours", "Minutes", "Seconds"); the AM/PM toggle is a button named by `KumoStrings.dayPeriod` ("AM or PM") with the current period as its value.
- Typing fills a part and moves to the next once it is complete ("7" in the hour part is already 07); `:` also moves on. Arrow Up and Down step the focused part and wrap. Left and Right at the edge of a part move between parts, Backspace in an empty part goes back. In the AM/PM toggle, A and P (the first letter of the labels) set it, Up and Down flip it.
- Errors from `error` are shown and announced by `KumoField`.

## Motion

The field changes state instantly, like Kumo's inputs. The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.

## Mobile

- Parts open the number keyboard. The AM/PM toggle has a 36px hit area on touch within the 36px field.
- At 2x text the parts grow with the text; the field keeps a minimum height and never clips.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no time input.

| Kumo / shadcn | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| Kumo `Input` `size`, `error`, `disabled` | `size`, `error`, `disabled` |
| Kumo `Field` `label`, `description` | `label`, `description` |
| shadcn `use24HourFormat`, `showSeconds` | `use24Hour`, `showSeconds` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoTimePicker.md
---

# KumoTimePicker

A time field that opens a picker: scrolling columns in a popover on wide screens, snapping wheels in a bottom sheet on phones. Kumo has no time component; this follows shadcn's time picker in Kumo's field style.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/date-picker (field and popover styling)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTimePicker(
  label: 'Cron trigger time',
  value: runAt,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => runAt = time),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when people choose a time from a set (a schedule, a maintenance slot), especially on touch. Use `KumoTimeInput` when people type exact times, such as log timestamps.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `KumoTimeValue?` | | The time shown |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<KumoTimeValue?>?` | | Called on every column or wheel change, and with `null` from Clear |
| `use24Hour` | `bool` | `false` | 00-23 hours instead of 1-12 with AM/PM |
| `showSeconds` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a seconds column |
| `minuteStep` | `int` | `1` | Minutes listed (15 lists 00, 15, 30, 45). 1 to 30 |
| `label`, `description`, `error` | `String?` | | Rendered through `KumoField` |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.pickTime` | |
| `size` | `KumoFieldSize` | `base` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `clearable` | `bool` | `true` | Clear button in the field |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Popover, or bottom sheet below 768px |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | `bool?`, `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Control the panel from outside |
| `labels` | `KumoTimeLabels` | from `KumoStrings` | Column names (`hours`, `minutes`, `seconds`, `dayPeriod`), AM/PM text, Done (`done`) |
| `showOptional`, `required` | `bool` | `false` | Label markers |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a `label` |

`KumoTimeValue(hour:, minute:, second:)` is a time of day with `hour` 0-23, `hour12`, `isPm`, `format(use24Hour:, showSeconds:, am:, pm:)`, `on(day)` to build a `DateTime`, `KumoTimeValue.fromDateTime` and `KumoTimeValue.now()` (from `clock.now()`).

## Examples

### 24-hour with seconds

```dart
KumoTimePicker(
  label: 'Purge cache at (UTC)',
  use24Hour: true,
  showSeconds: true,
  value: purgeAt,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => purgeAt = time),
)
```

### 15-minute slots with validation

```dart
KumoTimePicker(
  label: 'Maintenance slot',
  minuteStep: 15,
  value: slot,
  error: slot != null && slot!.hour < 6 ? 'Pick a slot after 6:00 AM.' : null,
  onValueChange: (time) => setState(() => slot = time),
)
```

### Translated labels

```dart
KumoTimePicker(
  labels: const KumoTimeLabels(hour: 'Jam', minute: 'Menit', done: 'Selesai'),
  use24Hour: true,
  value: time,
  onValueChange: (t) => setState(() => time = t),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The field is a button with the label, the formatted time as value and expanded state.
- In the popover each column is one Tab stop announced as an adjustable value ("Minutes, 30") with increase and decrease actions. Arrow Up and Down change it, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter closes, Escape closes and returns focus to the field.
- Wheels in the sheet are adjustable values too, so screen reader swipe up and down turns them.
- The selected option is filled with `contrast`, not only colored.

## Motion

- The field shows its focus ring on pointer-down, before the panel opens.
- Popover columns scroll the chosen value into view only when it is out of view, so a click never moves the row under the pointer.
- Wheels follow the finger 1:1; on release the velocity carries them and they snap to the nearest value (`FixedExtentScrollPhysics`), with a selection haptic on each value. Hours and minutes loop like a clock. A wheel drag never drags the sheet.
- The error or description under the field opens and fades in over 150ms when it appears, closes the same way when it goes, and cross-fades when one replaces the other, so the content below slides instead of jumping. Gaining or losing the message never rebuilds the field, so it keeps focus and text. Reduced motion shows and hides it at once.
- Reduced motion: column and wheel adjustments jump instead of animating.

## Mobile

- Below 768px the picker is a bottom sheet with the label as heading, one wheel per part over a tinted selection band, and Clear and Done. Done on an empty value commits the time the wheels show (the current time on the minute grid).
- Wheel rows are 44px tall.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no time picker. The closest pieces:

| Kumo / shadcn | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| Kumo `Input` field chrome | `KumoFieldBox` trigger (`size`, `error`, `disabled`) |
| Kumo `Popover` | popover panel (`presentation`) |
| shadcn `use24HourFormat` | `use24Hour` |
| shadcn `showSeconds` | `showSeconds` |
| shadcn `value`, `onChanged` | `value`, `onValueChange` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoTimeline.md
---

# KumoTimeline

A vertical list of events, each with a status marker, title, time and description: deployment history, audit logs, rollout steps.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no timeline; this one is built from Kumo tokens (status tints, `kumo-line` rail, Kumo text sizes).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const KumoTimeline(items: [
  KumoTimelineItem(
    title: 'Deployed to production',
    time: '2 min ago',
    status: KumoTimelineStatus.success,
    statusLabel: 'Succeeded',
  ),
  KumoTimelineItem(title: 'Worker created', time: 'Feb 27'),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a timeline when order in time is the point. For a log people filter and sort, use `KumoTable`. For steps someone completes, use a stepper or a numbered list.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoTimelineItem>` | required | Newest first by convention. Empty renders nothing: show your own empty message |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the list ("Deployment history") |

`KumoTimelineItem`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | required | Medium weight |
| `time` | `String?` | | Pre-formatted, 12px subtle, tabular figures |
| `description` | `String?` | | 13px subtle |
| `status` | `KumoTimelineStatus` | `neutral` | `neutral` dot, `success` check, `warning` triangle, `danger` cross, `info` "i", `active` hourglass |
| `statusLabel` | `String?` | | The status in words, read with the item |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Replaces the status icon |
| `content` | `Widget?` | | Below the description |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | | End of the title row |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Makes the item pressable |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Overrides what is read |
| `id` | `Object?` | | Stable identity; an item with an id that appears after the first build slides open and fades in |

## Examples

### Failed build with details

```dart
const KumoTimeline(items: [
  KumoTimelineItem(
    title: 'Build failed',
    time: 'Yesterday',
    description: 'wrangler.toml is missing compatibility_date.',
    status: KumoTimelineStatus.danger,
    statusLabel: 'Failed',
    content: KumoCode.block(code: 'Error: compatibility_date is required'),
  ),
])
```

### Pressable item

```dart
KumoTimeline(items: [
  KumoTimelineItem(
    title: 'Deployed version 7d1e9b3',
    status: KumoTimelineStatus.success,
    statusLabel: 'Succeeded',
    onPress: () {},
    semanticLabel: 'Open deployment 7d1e9b3',
  ),
])
```

## Accessibility

- Each item is one node: status label, title, time and description read together.
- Status is never color alone: every status has its own icon shape, and `statusLabel` says it in words.
- `active` is static (an hourglass). Nothing spins: a running deployment does not loop an animation forever.

## Motion

- Changing an item's `status` (running to succeeded) eases the marker's tint and ring and cross-fades its icon (150ms). The old status is dropped from the semantics tree at once.
- Items with an `id` that appear after the timeline first shows (a new event at the top) slide open and fade in over 200ms, so the events below move down instead of jumping. Items present on the first build never animate.
- Hover tints on pressable items are instant. Reduced motion makes every change instant.

## Mobile

Titles and descriptions wrap; the time stays on the title's first line. The rail and markers mirror in right-to-left layouts.

## Kumo React mapping

Not in Kumo.

| Concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| Event | `KumoTimelineItem` |
| Status color + icon | `status` + `statusLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoTimeseriesChart.md
---

# KumoTimeseriesChart

Lines, area fills or stacked bars over time, with nice value ticks, time labels that adapt to the range, thresholds, reference markers and a crosshair tooltip. Kumo's `TimeseriesChart`, drawn with `CustomPainter` (no ECharts).

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/charts/timeseries

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTimeseriesChart(
  xAxisName: 'Time (UTC)',
  yAxisName: 'Requests',
  data: [
    KumoTimeseriesData(
      name: 'Requests',
      color: KumoChartColors.of(context).semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.neutral),
      data: [(DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 4, 14), 120), (DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 4, 14, 1), 132)],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for metrics over time: requests, latency percentiles, memory, error counts. For a trend inside a table cell or tile, use `KumoSparkline`. For flows between resources, use `KumoSankeyChart`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `List<KumoTimeseriesData>` | required | Series in legend and stacking order |
| `type` | `KumoTimeseriesChartType` | `line` | `line` or `bar` (stacked per timestamp) |
| `gradient` | `bool` | `false` | Area fill under lines, 40% to clear |
| `markers` | `List<KumoTimeseriesMarker>` | `[]` | Vertical reference lines (deploys, changes) |
| `thresholds` | `List<KumoTimeseriesThreshold>` | `[]` | Horizontal lines, or bands with `endValue` |
| `incomplete` | `KumoTimeseriesIncomplete?` | | Dashes segments before `before` and after `after` |
| `xAxisName` / `yAxisName` | `String?` | | Axis titles |
| `xAxisTickCount` / `yAxisTickCount` | `int` | `5` | Approximate tick counts |
| `yAxisMinInterval` | `double?` | | Minimum tick step; `1` for counts |
| `xAxisHideLabelOverlap` | `bool` | `true` | Skip time labels that would collide |
| `xAxisTickFormat` | `String Function(DateTime)?` | adaptive | `14:05:30`, `14:05`, `Mar 4`, `Mar`, `2026` |
| `yAxisTickFormat` | `String Function(double)?` | grouped digits | Value labels |
| `tooltipValueFormat` | `String Function(double)?` | grouped digits | Tooltip, legend and screen reader values |
| `tooltipTimestampFormat` | `String Function(DateTime)?` | `Mar 4, 14:05:09` | Tooltip header |
| `tooltipFooter` | `String?` | | Note under the tooltip rows |
| `tooltipMode` | `KumoTimeseriesTooltipMode` | `all` | `all` series or the `single` nearest one |
| `tooltipMaxItems` | `int` | `10` | Rows before `+N more` |
| `tooltipFollowCursor` | `KumoTimeseriesTooltipFollow` | `both` | `both` axes, or `x` (pinned to the top) |
| `showLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Toggle legend above the chart with latest values |
| `hiddenSeries` | `Set<String>?` | | Controlled hidden set; null tracks legend toggles internally |
| `onHiddenSeriesChange` | `ValueChanged<Set<String>>?` | | Next hidden set when a legend item is pressed |
| `highlightedSeries` | `String?` | | Emphasise one series, fade the others |
| `onTimeRangeChange` | `void Function(DateTime, DateTime)?` | | Mouse drag selects a range |
| `height` | `double?` | 350, or 260 below `md` | Chart height |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Wave skeleton |
| `error` | `String?` | | Error message shown in place of the chart |
| `onRetry` | `VoidCallback?` | | Adds a Retry button to the error state |
| `emptyMessage` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.noDataInRange` | Shown when no series has points |
| `emptyDescription` | `String?` | `'Choose a longer time range to see earlier data.'` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Leads the screen reader summary |
| `scrubHaptic` | `KumoHaptic` | `selection` | Fired when a touch scrub snaps to a new point |

`KumoTimeseriesData(name, data, color, lineStyle)`: `data` is `List<(DateTime, double)>`; unsorted input is sorted and `double.nan` leaves a gap. Times keep their zone: pass UTC times to label the axis in UTC.

`KumoTimeseriesMarker(time, label, description, color, lineStyle)`: markers closer than about one tick merge into a line labelled "N changes".

`KumoTimeseriesThreshold(value, color, label, endValue)`: the value axis always extends to include thresholds.

## Examples

### Deploy markers and a memory limit

```dart
final palette = KumoChartColors.of(context);
KumoTimeseriesChart(
  yAxisName: 'Memory (MB)',
  data: [KumoTimeseriesData(name: 'Memory used', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.neutral), data: points)],
  markers: [KumoTimeseriesMarker(time: DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 4, 14, 15), label: 'Deploy 4f2c1a9', description: 'image-resizer v42')],
  thresholds: [KumoTimeseriesThreshold(value: 128, label: 'Memory limit', color: palette.semantic(KumoChartSemanticColor.attention))],
  tooltipValueFormat: (v) => '${v.round()} MB',
);
```

### Stacked bars with a toggle legend

```dart
KumoTimeseriesChart(
  type: KumoTimeseriesChartType.bar,
  showLegend: true,
  yAxisMinInterval: 1,
  data: series,
)
```

### Data states

```dart
KumoTimeseriesChart(
  data: series,
  loading: isLoading,
  error: failed ? 'Could not load requests. Check your connection, then retry.' : null,
  onRetry: reload,
)
```

### Range selection

```dart
KumoTimeseriesChart(
  data: series,
  onTimeRangeChange: (from, to) => setState(() => range = (from, to)),
)
```

## Accessibility

The chart is one semantics node whose label summarises it: kind, series count and time range, then each series' range and latest value, thresholds, markers and hidden series (`semanticLabel` leads). Screen reader increase and decrease actions step through points and the value reads the active point ("Mar 4, 14:05:09. Requests 132. Errors 3"). With keyboard focus (a 2px focus ring) Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Escape hides the tooltip. The error state is a live region with an icon and text; the loading skeleton announces "Loading chart".

## Motion

When data, the hidden set or thresholds change, series morph from the geometry on screen to the new values over 300ms with Kumo's standard curve; the value and time axes slide to their new range, entering line series fade in and bars grow from zero, and series hidden from the legend fade out rather than pop. Under reduced motion changes are instant. The skeleton, chart, error and empty message cross-fade (150ms). The loading sheen sweeps every 1.8s only while `loading` is true and only on screen; under reduced motion it stays still. The crosshair and tooltip follow the pointer 1:1 with no easing. Moving the pointer repaints only the crosshair layer; the series layer is cached and repaints only when its data changes.

## Mobile

Touch: the tooltip appears under the finger on contact, follows a horizontal drag 1:1 with a selection haptic on each new point, and stays after lifting until the next touch or a tap outside. Vertical drags still scroll the page. On touch the tooltip pins to the top of the plot so the finger never covers it. Range selection is mouse only; on touch offer explicit range controls. Default height drops to 260 below the `md` breakpoint, and labels and padding grow with text scale.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `echarts` | (not needed) |
| `type: "line" \| "bar"` | `type` |
| `data: { name, data: [ms, value][], color }` | `data: KumoTimeseriesData(name, data: [(DateTime, double)], color)` |
| `markers`, `thresholds` | same (`time: DateTime` instead of `timestamp`) |
| `xAxisName`, `yAxisName`, `xAxisTickCount`, `yAxisTickCount`, `yAxisMinInterval`, `xAxisHideLabelOverlap` | same |
| `xAxisTickFormat(ms)` | `xAxisTickFormat(DateTime)` |
| `yAxisTickFormat`, `tooltipValueFormat`, `tooltipFooter`, `tooltipMaxItems` | same |
| `yAxisTickLabelFormat` (deprecated) | `tooltipValueFormat` |
| `tooltipTimestampFormat(ms)` | `tooltipTimestampFormat(DateTime)` |
| `tooltipMode: "all" \| "single"` | `tooltipMode` |
| `tooltipFollowCursor: "both" \| "x"` | `tooltipFollowCursor` |
| `tooltipBoundary` | (tooltip always stays inside the chart) |
| `incomplete: { before, after }` | `incomplete: KumoTimeseriesIncomplete(before:, after:)` |
| `enableLegendSelection` + `legendSelect` actions | `hiddenSeries` / `onHiddenSeriesChange`, or `showLegend` |
| `dispatchAction({ type: "highlight" })` | `highlightedSeries` |
| `height` (350) | `height` (350, 260 on phones) |
| `onTimeRangeChange(from, to)` | same, with `DateTime`s |
| `gradient`, `loading` | same |
| `isDarkMode` | follows `KumoTheme` |
| `ariaDescription` | `semanticLabel` (plus a generated summary) |
| `optionUpdateBehavior` | (not applicable) |

---
source: doc/components/KumoToast.md
---

# KumoToast

Brief, non-blocking notifications that stack in a corner of the screen, pause while the user looks at them and swipe away.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/toast

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

Place one `KumoToaster` near the root, above the navigator, then raise toasts from anywhere below it.

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

void main() {
  runApp(
    KumoThemeProvider(
      child: MaterialApp(
        builder: (context, child) => KumoToaster(child: child!),
        home: Builder(
          builder: (context) => KumoButton(
            label: 'Purge cache',
            onPress: () => showKumoToast(context, title: 'Cache purged', description: 'example.com serves fresh content.'),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for the outcome of an action the user just took ("Worker deployed", "DNS record deleted"), optionally with one or two actions such as Undo.
- Do not put information the user must act on only in a toast: it disappears. Use `KumoBanner` for persistent page-level messages and `KumoDialog` for decisions.
- Give repeated notifications a stable `id` so they bump one toast instead of stacking copies.

## Parameters

### KumoToaster

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The app. It sizes the toaster. |
| `manager` | `KumoToastManager?` | `null` | A manager created outside the tree, for toasts raised from code without a `BuildContext`. Null creates one. |
| `limit` | `int` | `3` | Toasts shown at once; older ones wait hidden until a slot frees up. |
| `timeout` | `Duration` | `KumoToaster.defaultTimeout` (5s) | Auto-dismiss time for toasts that do not set their own. |

### KumoToast.of / showKumoToast

`KumoToast.of(context)` returns the nearest toaster's `KumoToastManager` and throws a `FlutterError` that explains the fix when there is none; `KumoToast.maybeOf(context)` returns null instead. `showKumoToast(context, ...)` is `KumoToast.of(context).add(...)` and returns the toast id.

### KumoToastManager.add

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String?` | generated | Reusing the id of a toast on screen bumps it and restarts its timer instead of adding a copy. |
| `title` | `String?` | `null` | Medium weight, colored by the variant. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | 70% default text. |
| `variant` | `KumoToastVariant` | `neutral` | `neutral`, `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`. Non-neutral variants add an icon. |
| `content` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content in place of icon, title, description and actions. The close button stays. |
| `actions` | `List<KumoToastAction>` | `const []` | Buttons under the text; they scroll sideways if they do not fit. |
| `timeout` | `Duration?` | toaster timeout | `Duration.zero` keeps the toast until closed. |
| `bump` | `bool?` | `null` | `false` skips the bump on a repeated id. |
| `onClose` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called once when the toast starts closing, for any reason. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | title and description | What screen readers announce. |

Other members: `addToast(KumoToastData, {id, bump})`, `update(id, (toast) => toast.copyWith(...), {bump = false})` (a changed timeout restarts the timer), `promise<T>(future, loading:, success:, error:)` (one toast from loading to result; the loading toast stays until the future completes), `close(id)`, `closeAll()`, `ids`, `toastFor(id)`.

### KumoToastAction

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback` | required | |
| `variant` | `KumoButtonVariant` | `secondary` | |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | `null` | |
| `closesToast` | `bool` | `false` | Close the toast after `onPress`, for one-shot actions such as Undo. |

### KumoToast widget

`KumoToast({title, description, variant, content, actions, onClose})` renders one toast surface on its own, for previews and custom hosts.

## Examples

### Undo action

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

void recordDeleted(BuildContext context, VoidCallback restore) {
  showKumoToast(
    context,
    title: 'DNS record deleted',
    description: 'api.example.com, type CNAME',
    variant: KumoToastVariant.success,
    actions: [KumoToastAction(label: 'Undo', onPress: restore, closesToast: true)],
  );
}
```

### Promise

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<String> deployWorker() async => 'image-resizer';

Future<void> deploy(BuildContext context) async {
  await KumoToast.of(context).promise<String>(
    deployWorker(),
    loading: const KumoToastData(title: 'Deploying image-resizer', variant: KumoToastVariant.info),
    success: (name) => KumoToastData(title: '$name deployed', variant: KumoToastVariant.success),
    error: (e) => KumoToastData(title: 'Deployment failed', description: '$e', variant: KumoToastVariant.error),
  );
}
```

### Raising toasts outside the widget tree

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

final appToasts = KumoToastManager();

void onSyncFailed() => appToasts.add(title: 'Sync failed', variant: KumoToastVariant.error);

Widget withToasts(Widget app) => KumoToaster(manager: appToasts, child: app);
```

## Accessibility

- New toasts are announced: each toast is a live region (Android, web) and the toaster sends an announcement elsewhere, using `semanticLabel` or the title and description.
- Status is not color alone: variants add an icon, and the title says what happened.
- The close button is announced with `KumoStrings.close` and gets a 44x44 hit area on touch; actions are regular buttons in the Tab order.
- Hovering or focusing the stack pauses every timer, so reading or tabbing to an action never races the timeout. Timers also pause while the app is in the background.

## Motion

- A toast enters from the bottom edge with a spring and leaves the way it came (sliding down and fading).
- Older toasts peek 12px above the newest, each scaled down 10%, with their content hidden. Hovering or focusing the stack, or touching it on a phone, fans them out with 12px gaps; positions move on springs that start from where each toast is.
- When a toast leaves, the ones behind slide and grow into their new places from where they are.
- Updating a toast in place (`update`, a settled `promise`) cross-fades the old message into the new one over 150ms while the height springs to the new content.
- A repeated id bumps the toast: a quick rise to about 1.02 scale and back.
- Swipe down or toward the end edge to dismiss. The toast follows the finger; past 40px or with a flick it keeps the finger's velocity on the way out, otherwise it springs back. Swiping up or toward the start resists.
- Reduced motion replaces slides, scales and the bump with a short fade, and swaps updated content at once.

## Mobile

From 640px up, toasts are 340px wide in the bottom end corner, 32px from the edges. Below 640px they span the bottom with 16px gutters. They always sit above the safe area and the keyboard, and mirror to the bottom left in right-to-left layouts.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `<Toasty>` | `KumoToaster` |
| `Toasty toastManager` / `createKumoToastManager()` | `KumoToaster(manager:)` / `KumoToastManager()` |
| `useKumoToastManager()` | `KumoToast.of(context)` |
| `toastManager.add({ title, description, variant, content, actions, timeout, id, bump })` | `add(title:, description:, variant:, content:, actions:, timeout:, id:, bump:)` |
| `variant: "default"` | `KumoToastVariant.neutral` |
| `actions: ButtonProps[]` | `actions: List<KumoToastAction>` |
| `toastManager.update(id, fn)` | `update(id, fn)` |
| `toastManager.promise(p, { loading, success, error })` | `promise(p, loading:, success:, error:)` |
| `toastManager.close(id)` | `close(id)` |
