# KumoToggle

A two-state button that stays pressed: a filter, a view option, a formatting style. Not a Kumo component; it follows shadcn's Toggle with Kumo's segmented styling, where the pressed state fills with `contrast` and inverse text.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/radio (segmented appearance, which this styling follows)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoToggle(
  icon: KumoIcons.funnel,
  label: 'Errors only',
  pressed: errorsOnly,
  onPressedChange: (value) => setState(() => errorsOnly = value),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a toggle for an on/off option that lives with other buttons (a log viewer's "Errors only", a text editor's bold). For a setting on a form or a settings page, use `KumoSwitch` or `KumoCheckbox`. For several related toggles, use `KumoToggleGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed` | `bool` | required | Controlled state |
| `onPressedChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Called with the next state. Null disables the toggle |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text. Without it the toggle is square |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | Leading icon, or the only content |
| `variant` | `KumoToggleVariant` | `ghost` | `ghost`: no surface until hovered; `outline`: control surface with a ring |
| `size` | `KumoToggleSize` | `base` | `sm` 26px (12px text), `base` 34px (13px), `lg` 40px (14px) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `title` | `String?` | | Tooltip; doubles as the accessible name of icon-only toggles |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Required for icon-only toggles (or `title`) |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Icon-only

```dart
KumoToggle(
  icon: KumoIcons.textB,
  semanticLabel: 'Bold',
  pressed: bold,
  onPressedChange: (value) => setState(() => bold = value),
)
```

### Outline

```dart
KumoToggle(
  label: 'Wrap lines',
  variant: KumoToggleVariant.outline,
  pressed: wrap,
  onPressedChange: (value) => setState(() => wrap = value),
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a toggle button with its on or off state. Tab focuses it, Space or Enter flips it, and keyboard focus draws Kumo's 2px brand ring.

## Motion

Like a button: a 0.98 press-scale spring from pointer down, instant hover and pressed colors, no scale under reduced motion.

## Mobile

The visual keeps its size; the hit area is padded to 44x44 on touch.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no Toggle. The closest Base UI API is `Toggle`:

| Base UI prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `pressed` / `defaultPressed` | `pressed` (controlled only) |
| `onPressedChange` | `onPressedChange` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `aria-label` | `semanticLabel` |

## KumoToggleGroup

A row of toggles that act together: one at a time (a view mode) or any number (HTTP methods, formatting). By default it draws Kumo's joined segmented bar.

```dart
KumoToggleGroup<String>(
  semanticLabel: 'Layout',
  value: view,
  allowDeselect: false,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => view = next),
  items: const [
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'list', icon: KumoIcons.rows, semanticLabel: 'List view'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'grid', icon: KumoIcons.squaresFour, semanticLabel: 'Grid view'),
  ],
)
```

```dart
KumoToggleGroup<String>.multiple(
  semanticLabel: 'HTTP methods',
  values: methods,
  onValuesChange: (next) => setState(() => methods = next),
  items: const [
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'GET', label: 'GET'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'POST', label: 'POST'),
  ],
)
```

See `KumoToggleGroup.md` for its parameters.

---
source: doc/components/KumoToggleGroup.md

# KumoToggleGroup

A row of toggles that act together: one pressed at a time (a view mode, a log level) or any number (HTTP methods, text formatting). Not a Kumo component; it follows shadcn's ToggleGroup and draws Kumo's segmented bar by default.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/radio (segmented appearance, which the `outline` variant matches)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoToggleGroup<String>(
  semanticLabel: 'Log level',
  value: level,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => level = next),
  items: const [
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'info', label: 'Info'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'warn', label: 'Warn'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'error', label: 'Error'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a toggle group for view options and filters that sit with other controls. For a required single choice inside a form, a segmented `KumoRadioGroup` (with a legend, error and description) fits better. When the choice switches content panels, use tabs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<KumoToggleGroupItem<T>>` | required | |
| `value` | `T?` | required (single) | The pressed value, or null |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | | Single: next value, null when cleared. Null disables the group |
| `allowDeselect` | `bool` | `true` | Single: pressing the pressed item clears the value |
| `values` | `List<T>` | required (`.multiple`) | The pressed values |
| `onValuesChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | | Multiple: next list; a newly pressed value is appended |
| `variant` | `KumoToggleVariant` | `outline` | `outline`: joined segmented bar; `ghost`: separate toggles 4px apart, for toolbars |
| `size` | `KumoToggleSize` | `base` | `sm` 26px, `base` 34px, `lg` 40px |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the group for screen readers |

### KumoToggleGroupItem

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | required | |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text. Without it the item is square |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Skipped by arrow keys |
| `title` | `String?` | | Tooltip; doubles as the accessible name of icon-only items |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Required for icon-only items (or `title`) |

## Examples

### Toolbar formatting (ghost, multiple)

```dart
KumoToggleGroup<String>.multiple(
  semanticLabel: 'Text formatting',
  variant: KumoToggleVariant.ghost,
  values: formats,
  onValuesChange: (next) => setState(() => formats = next),
  items: const [
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'bold', icon: KumoIcons.textB, title: 'Bold'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'italic', icon: KumoIcons.textItalic, title: 'Italic'),
  ],
)
```

### Small, required

```dart
KumoToggleGroup<String>(
  semanticLabel: 'Chart interval',
  size: KumoToggleSize.sm,
  allowDeselect: false,
  value: interval,
  onValueChange: (next) => setState(() => interval = next),
  items: const [
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'hour', label: 'Hour'),
    KumoToggleGroupItem(value: 'day', label: 'Day'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Single selection is a radio group: each item is announced as a radio with its checked state. Multiple selection items are toggle buttons with their on or off state.
- Tab reaches the group once (the last focused item, else the first pressed, else the first enabled). Arrow keys move focus between enabled items, wrapping and mirrored in RTL; Home and End jump to the ends. Space or Enter toggles the focused item. Arrows do not change the value, as in Radix and shadcn.

## Motion

- Single choice, outline (segmented): the dark fill slides from the previous item to the new one with `KumoSprings.standard`, from where it is, and labels blend to the inverse color as it covers them. Clearing the value fades the fill out in place.
- Multiple choice: each item fills instantly, like Kumo's segmented radio.
- Segments do not scale on press (it would open gaps at the seams); their pressed fill shows on pointer-down. Ghost items use the standard press-scale spring. A selection haptic marks each change.
- Reduced motion: the fill moves at once.

## Mobile

Segments keep the bar's visual height while their hit area extends to 44px; icon-only segments widen to 44px. A bar wider than the screen scrolls sideways instead of overflowing. Inside an unbounded row (a scrolling toolbar) it lays out at its intrinsic width.

## Kumo React mapping

Kumo has no ToggleGroup; the segmented look comes from `Radio.Group appearance="segmented"`.

| shadcn / Radix prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type="single"` | `KumoToggleGroup(...)` |
| `type="multiple"` | `KumoToggleGroup.multiple(...)` |
| `value` / `onValueChange` | `value` / `onValueChange`, or `values` / `onValuesChange` |
| `variant` (`default`, `outline`) | `variant` (`ghost`, `outline`) |
| `size` | `size` |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `ToggleGroupItem` | `KumoToggleGroupItem` |

# KumoToolbar

Controls grouped into one compact card, with shared borders between items and only the outer corners rounded. Items that do not fit move into a "More" menu.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/toolbar

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoToolbar(
  semanticLabel: 'DNS records',
  children: [
    KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.uploadSimple, label: 'Import', onPress: importRecords),
    KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.downloadSimple, label: 'Export', onPress: exportRecords),
    KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.gearSix, semanticLabel: 'Settings', onPress: openSettings),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a row of related actions or filters over a table, editor or file list.
- For one action, use a `KumoButton`. For many commands in categories, use `KumoMenubar`. For tabs, use tabs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | `KumoToolbarButton`, `KumoToolbarGroup`, `KumoToolbarSlot` (any other widget is placed as a fixed slot) |
| `overflowMenu` | `bool` | `true` | Move items that do not fit into a "More" menu; false clips |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the toolbar |
| `moreLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.more` | Accessible name of the overflow button |
| `presentation` | `KumoPresentation` | `auto` | Overflow menu as a sheet below 768px |

### KumoToolbarButton

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | | Text; omit for icon-only buttons |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Null renders it disabled |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner in place of the icon; presses blocked |
| `toggled` | `bool?` | `null` | Pressed state for toggles (bold); becomes a checkbox row in the overflow menu |
| `isLink` | `bool` | `false` | Announce as a link (Kumo's `Toolbar.Link`) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Required for icon-only buttons; also their overflow menu label |
| `tooltip` | `String?` | | Hover tooltip |

### KumoToolbarGroup

`children` (`List<KumoToolbarButton>`) sit with no divider between them and move into the overflow menu together. `semanticLabel` names the group.

### KumoToolbarSlot

`child` (any widget, such as a search field), `flex` (`int`, default `0`; a share of the free width, like `flex-1`), `minWidth` (`double`, default `160`; width kept before other items overflow). Slots never move into the overflow menu.

## Examples

### Formatting toggles

```dart
KumoToolbar(
  semanticLabel: 'Editor',
  children: [
    KumoToolbarGroup(semanticLabel: 'Text formatting', children: [
      KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.textB, semanticLabel: 'Bold', toggled: bold, onPress: toggleBold),
      KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.textItalic, semanticLabel: 'Italic', toggled: italic, onPress: toggleItalic),
    ]),
    KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.linkSimple, semanticLabel: 'Insert link', onPress: insertLink),
  ],
)
```

### Search slot

```dart
KumoToolbar(
  children: [
    const KumoToolbarSlot(flex: 1, child: SearchRecordsField()),
    KumoToolbarButton(icon: KumoIcons.funnelSimple, semanticLabel: 'Filter', onPress: openFilters),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The toolbar is a named semantics container; buttons announce their label, toggles their toggled state, links as links.
- One Tab stop: Tab enters on the last focused button (the first one at the start), Left and Right move between buttons (mirrored in RTL, skipping disabled ones, wrapping), Home and End jump, and Tab leaves. Arrow keys inside a slot (a text field) are left to the slot.

## Motion

Buttons respond on pointer-down with `KumoPressable`'s press spring; hover colors switch instantly. The overflow menu opens from the More button with the scale-from-anchor spring, or as a sheet that follows the finger. Items move into the More menu in the same layout pass that runs out of room, so a resize never shows a clipped or overlapping button; they do not animate, so the toolbar never lags behind a window or panel resize.

## Mobile

On touch, buttons are 44px tall and icon-only buttons 44px wide. When the row does not fit (390px, 2x text), trailing buttons and groups move into the More menu instead of overflowing; on phones it opens as a bottom sheet.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Toolbar` children | `children` |
| `Toolbar.Button icon / children / aria-label / disabled / loading` | `KumoToolbarButton icon / label / semanticLabel / disabled / loading` |
| `Toolbar.Link` | `KumoToolbarButton(isLink: true)` |
| `Toolbar.Input`, `Toolbar.InputGroup`, Select or Combobox triggers | `KumoToolbarSlot(child: ...)` |
| `className="flex-1"` on an item | `KumoToolbarSlot(flex: 1)` |
| `size` (deprecated) | not ported |

source: doc/components/KumoTooltip.md

# KumoTooltip

Kumo's `Tooltip`: a short label for a control, shown on hover after a delay, at once on keyboard focus, and on long press with touch.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/tooltip

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTooltip(
  content: 'Copy API token',
  child: KumoButton(icon: KumoIcons.copy, shape: KumoButtonShape.square, semanticLabel: 'Copy', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use tooltips to name icon-only controls or add a short hint. Never put the only copy of information or anything interactive in a tooltip; touch users may never see it. `KumoButton(title: ...)` adds one for you.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `String` | required | |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The trigger |
| `side` | `KumoSide` | `top` | Flips when there is no room |
| `align` | `KumoAlign` | `center` | |
| `delay` | `Duration` | 600ms | Hover delay; after a tooltip closes the next opens without delay for 400ms |
| `closeDelay` | `Duration` | `zero` | |
| `touchDuration` | `Duration` | 1500ms | How long a long-press tooltip stays |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `true` | |

## Examples

### Below the trigger

```dart
const KumoTooltip(content: 'Cached at the edge', side: KumoSide.bottom, child: KumoIcon(KumoIcons.info))
```

## Accessibility

The content is also exposed as the child's semantic tooltip, so screen readers read it without the popup. Keyboard focus (not taps) opens it; Escape closes it.

## Motion

Scales in from 0.9 toward the trigger and fades, 150ms, and leaves the same way, starting as soon as the pointer leaves (`closeDelay` is zero). Within 400ms of any tooltip closing, the next one opens without delay and without its entrance animation (Base UI's `data-instant`), so scanning a toolbar is quick; hovering the same tooltip again while it is still leaving turns its exit around from where it is instead. Escape and outside taps close it at once. Reduced motion keeps only a short fade.

## Mobile

Opens on long press and closes after `touchDuration`.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `content`, `side`, `align`, `delay`, `closeDelay`, `disabled` | same names |
| `render` / `asChild` | `child` |

---
source: doc/components/KumoTracker.md
---

# KumoTracker

An uptime tracker: a row of day bars colored by status, a tooltip per bar with the date and status, a legend, and a spoken summary.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no tracker; this one is inspired by shadcn's tracker and colored with Kumo's status tokens.

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTracker(
  label: 'image-resizer',
  valueText: '99.9% uptime',
  startLabel: '90 days ago',
  endLabel: 'Today',
  days: days,
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for the health history of a service, a Worker or a health check, one bar per day (or per hour). For a single current status use a `KumoBadge`; for a trend over a continuous value use a chart.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` | `List<KumoTrackerDay>` | required | Oldest first; they draw from the start edge |
| `label` | `String?` | | Name of what is tracked, 14px medium |
| `valueText` | `String?` | | Figure opposite the label, such as `'99.95% uptime'` |
| `startLabel`, `endLabel` | `String?` | | Captions under the first and last bars |
| `showLegend` | `bool` | `true` | Swatch and name for each status present |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Placeholder bars, no input |
| `error` | `String?` | | Replaces the bars with this message and an icon |
| `emptyText` | `String` | `'No status checks ran in this period'` | Shown when `days` is empty |
| `statusLabels` | `Map<KumoTrackerStatus, String>?` | | Replaces the English status names |
| `height` | `double` | `32` | Bar height |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Replaces `label` as the accessible name |

`KumoTrackerDay(date:, status:, note:)` is one bar. `note` adds detail to the tooltip ("Origin unreachable for 41 min").

`KumoTrackerStatus`: `operational` (`success`), `degraded` (`warning`), `outage` (`danger`), `noData` (`fill`).

## Examples

### Building the days

```dart
final today = DateTime(2026, 10, 31);
final days = [
  for (var i = 29; i >= 0; i--)
    KumoTrackerDay(
      date: today.subtract(Duration(days: i)),
      status: i == 6 ? KumoTrackerStatus.outage : KumoTrackerStatus.operational,
      note: i == 6 ? 'DNS resolution failures for 12 min' : null,
    ),
];
```

### Loading and error

```dart
KumoTracker(
  label: 'api.example.com',
  days: days,
  loading: request.isLoading,
  error: request.failed ? 'Could not load health checks for api.example.com' : null,
)
```

## Accessibility

Status is never color alone. Each bar's tooltip names the date, the status and the note; the legend names every color; and the tracker is one screen reader node whose label is a summary ("image-resizer, 99.9% uptime. 90 days: 84 operational, 3 degraded, 1 outage, 2 no data"). Screen reader users step through days with the increase and decrease actions (swipe up and down), and hear each day as the value.

Keyboard: the tracker is one Tab stop. Focus shows the latest day; Left and Right move between days (mirrored in RTL), Home and End jump to the first and last, Escape hides the tooltip.

## Motion

Hovering, scrubbing or arrowing moves the tooltip between bars without reopening it: it springs from where it is to the next bar (`KumoSprings.popup`) while its content switches at once, and a fresh tooltip opens at its bar. The other bars dim instantly, like a hover. The tooltip opens and closes with Kumo's popup motion and keeps its content while it fades out. The placeholder bars, the history, the error and the empty message cross-fade into each other (150ms). Under reduced motion the tooltip jumps and swaps are instant.

## Mobile

Tap a bar to see its day, or long press and slide to scrub across days; the tooltip stays 1.5s after the finger lifts. Bars share the width with 2px gaps, 1px when dense, and none when very dense, so 90 days fit a 390px phone.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| (no Kumo component) | |
| shadcn `TrackerData(level, tooltip)` | `KumoTrackerDay(status, note)` |

source: doc/components/KumoTree.md

# KumoTree

A nested list of expandable items with selection, keyboard arrows and lazy children: files in a Worker bundle, objects in an R2 bucket, zones by account.

Kumo reference: none. Kumo has no tree; this follows the ARIA tree pattern with Kumo's row styling (32px rows, `rounded-md`, `bg-kumo-tint` for hover and selection).

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
KumoTree(
  nodes: const [
    KumoTreeNode(id: 'src', label: 'src', icon: KumoIcons.folder, children: [
      KumoTreeNode(id: 'src/index.ts', label: 'index.ts', icon: KumoIcons.fileTs),
    ]),
  ],
  expanded: expanded,
  onExpandedChange: (ids) => setState(() => expanded = ids),
  value: selected,
  onValueChange: (id) => setState(() => selected = id),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a tree when hierarchy matters and people browse it: folders, nested resources. For a flat list use a list or `KumoTable`; for two levels of navigation use the sidebar's groups.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `List<KumoTreeNode>` | required | Top-level nodes |
| `expanded` | `Set<Object>` | `{}` | Ids of expanded nodes |
| `onExpandedChange` | `ValueChanged<Set<Object>>?` | | Called with the next set |
| `value` | `Object?` | | Selected node id |
| `onValueChange` | `ValueChanged<Object>?` | | Called when a row is pressed or activated |
| `loadChildren` | `Future<List<KumoTreeNode>> Function(KumoTreeNode)?` | | Loads children of nodes with `hasChildren: true`; results are cached |
| `expandOnPress` | `bool` | `true` | Pressing a branch also toggles it |
| `showGuides` | `bool` | `false` | A hairline down each level |
| `indent` | `double` | `16` | Indent per level |
| `loadErrorText` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.loadFailedRetry` | Shown when `loadChildren` throws |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Names the tree |

`KumoTreeNode(id:, label:, icon:, expandedIcon:, children:, hasChildren:, trailing:, disabled:)`. Ids must be unique across the tree.

## Examples

### Lazy children

```dart
KumoTree(
  nodes: const [KumoTreeNode(id: 'assets', label: 'assets', icon: KumoIcons.folder, hasChildren: true)],
  expanded: expanded,
  onExpandedChange: (ids) => setState(() => expanded = ids),
  loadChildren: (node) async => const [KumoTreeNode(id: 'assets/logo.svg', label: 'logo.svg')],
)
```

### Guides

```dart
KumoTree(nodes: const [], showGuides: true, expanded: expanded, onExpandedChange: (ids) => setState(() => expanded = ids))
```

## Accessibility

- Rows are buttons named by the node label, with `expanded` state on branches, `selected` state when selection is on, and a hint ("Expand" or "Collapse" from `KumoStrings`).
- Keyboard: Up and Down move; Right expands, or moves to the first child when already open; Left collapses, or moves to the parent; Home and End jump; Enter and Space select. Left and Right swap in right-to-left layouts. The tree is one Tab stop: the last focused row, else the selected one, else the first.
- The loading row announces `KumoStrings.loading`.

## Motion

Children slide open and closed over 200ms while fading, clipped so rows never reflow mid-animation, and the caret turns with the same duration and curve, so all three finish together. Collapsing mid-open reverses from where it is. Lazy children cross-fade in over the loading row while the block eases to its new height. Reduced motion opens and closes instantly. Hover tints are instant.

## Mobile

Rows are 32px tall with a mouse and 44px on touch screens. Labels truncate with an ellipsis rather than wrap, so deep trees stay scannable; keep `indent` at 16 or less on phones.

## Kumo React mapping

Not in Kumo. Closest pieces: Kumo `Collapsible` for the open and close motion, and sidebar menu rows for the styling.

| Pattern | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `aria-expanded` | `expanded` + `onExpandedChange` |
| `aria-selected` | `value` + `onValueChange` |

---
source: doc/components/showKumoAlertDialog.md
---

# showKumoAlertDialog

Asks the user to confirm one action and returns `true` only when they pick it; Cancel, Escape and the back gesture return `false`.

Kumo reference: https://kumo-ui.com/components/dialog (Alert Dialog)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<void> deleteBucket(BuildContext context) async {
  final confirmed = await showKumoAlertDialog(
    context,
    title: 'Delete R2 bucket "assets"?',
    description: 'Every object in the bucket is removed. This cannot be undone.',
    confirmLabel: 'Delete bucket',
    destructive: true,
  );
  if (confirmed) debugPrint('Deleting assets');
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a single yes-or-no confirmation before a consequential action.
- Name the action in `confirmLabel` ("Delete bucket", "Purge cache"), never "OK" or "Yes".
- For confirmations that need extra content (a typed resource name, a list of affected routes), build a `KumoDialog` with `role: KumoDialogRole.alertDialog`, or a `KumoLayerDialog.alert`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `BuildContext` | required, positional | |
| `title` | `String` | required | The question, sentence case. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | The consequence. |
| `confirmLabel` | `String` | required | Text of the confirm button. |
| `cancelLabel` | `String?` | `KumoStrings.cancel` | Text of the cancel button. |
| `destructive` | `bool` | `false` | Red confirm button, a warning badge before the title, and initial focus on Cancel. |
| `icon` | `IconData?` | `null` | Badge icon. Defaults to `KumoIcons.warningFill` when `destructive`; without it a non-destructive dialog has no badge. |
| `size` | `KumoDialogSize` | `base` | |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

Returns `Future<bool>`.

## Examples

### Non-destructive confirmation

```dart
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:kumo_flutter/kumo_flutter.dart';

Future<bool> confirmPurge(BuildContext context) => showKumoAlertDialog(
      context,
      title: 'Purge everything for example.com?',
      description: 'Visitors get uncached responses until the cache warms up again.',
      confirmLabel: 'Purge cache',
    );
```

## Accessibility

Announced as an alert dialog; the title names the route. A backdrop tap does not dismiss it, so the user makes an explicit choice; Escape counts as Cancel. With `destructive`, Cancel has focus when the dialog opens.

## Motion

Same as `KumoDialog`: a 150ms fade and scale from 0.9, a cross-fade under reduced motion.

## Mobile

Full width minus 16px gutters below 768px. The two buttons wrap onto separate lines when they do not fit.

## Kumo React mapping

| Kumo prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `Dialog.Root role="alertdialog"` | built in |
| `Dialog.Title` | `title:` |
| `Dialog.Description` | `description:` |
| `Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>}` | `cancelLabel:` |
| `Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>}` | `confirmLabel:` + `destructive: true` |
| Warning badge in the title row | `icon:` / `destructive:` |
